Napoléyoni
Napoléon Bonaparte (15 Myandagaro 1769 – 5 Rusama 1821) yari umusirikare w'Ubufaransa akaba n'umunyagihugu yateye imbere mu gihe c'Impinduka y'Abafaransa. Yabaye Umwami w’Abafaransa kuva mu 1804 gushika mu 1814, yongera kuganza mu 1815 mu gihe gito. Napoléon yavukiye i Corse, yimukira mu Bufaransa mu 1779, agira umwuga w’igisirikare mu 1785. Yarashigikiye Impinduka y’Abafaransa mu 1789, maze atsinda Toulon mu 1793 n’abagumutsi i Paris mu 1795, bikamuteza imbere mu butegetsi. Mu 1796, yayoboye urugamba rwo kurwanya Abanyaotirishiya, atsinda intsinzi zikomeye. Mu 1799, yakoze Coup d’État maze aba Konsili wa mbere. Mu 1804, Napoléon yihaye ikamba ry’Umwami w’abami w’Abafaransa, akomeza kwagura ububasha bwiwe. Isenyuka ry’amasezerano ya Amiens ryatumye haba Intambara y’Ihuriro rya gatatu mu 1805, aho Napoléon yatsinze mu rugamba rwa Austerlitz, rugasambura Ubwami Bweranda. Yarongeye gutsinda Prusse mu 1806 muri Jena-Auerstedt no muri Friedland mu 1807. Mu 1808, yateye Izinga rya Ibérie, ashiraho murumuna wiwe Yozefu nka mwami wa Esupanye. Mu 1809, yatsinze Abanyaotirishiya muri Wagram. Mu 1812, yarateye Uburusiya, ariko bigasozwa n’ugusubira inyuma kw’ingabo ziwe. Mu 1813, yatsinzwe bikomeye i Leipzig, agasubizwa Elba. Mu 1815, yacitse, agaruka i Paris, agatsindwa i Waterloo, maze ajanwa mu bunyagano i Sainte Helena, aho yapfiriye mu 1821.

Yowakimu Murat
Yoachim Murat (25 Ntwarante 1767 – 13 Ukwakira 1815) yari umusirikare w'Ubufaransa wakoreye mu ntambara z'Ubufaransa na za Napoléon. Yabaye Umuganwa Mukuru wa Berg (1806-1808) n'Umwami wa Naples (1808-1815). Murat yavukiye i Labastide-Fortunière mu Bufaransa, yinjiye mu ngabo z'abagendera ku mafarasi igihe c'Impinduka y'Abafaransa. Yitandukanyije ayobowe na Napoléon Bonaparte mu 1795, agira uruhara mu guhagarika imigumuko i Paris. Mu ntambara z'Ubutaliyano no mu Misiri, yarongoye ingabo z'abagendera ku mafarasi. Mu 1799, yafashije Napoléon gufata ubutegetsi. Mu 1800, yashakanye na Caroline Bonaparte, umukwe wa Napoléon. Murat yagizwe Maréchal w’Ubwami bw’Ubufaransa, agafasha mu ntambara nka Ulm, Austerlitz, Jena, na Eylau. Mu 1806, yabaye Umuganwa Mukuru wa Berg, hanyuma Umwami wa Naples mu 1808. Yashikiranye Napoléon mu ntambara z’i Burusiya no mu Budagi, ariko yareka Grande Armée nyuma ya Leipzig kugira ngo akingire intebe y'ubwami bwiwe. Mu 1815, yaragerageje gusubira gutwara Naples ariko yatsindwa i Tolentino, agafatwa, acirwa urubanza rwo gupfa i Pizzo.

Letisiya Bonapati
Mariya-Letiziya Bonaparte (24 Myandagaro 1750/1749 – 2 Ruhuhuma 1836), azwi nka Letiziya Bonaparte, yari umugore w’icubahiro wo muri Corse, nyina wa Napoléon wa mbere. Yitwaga "Madame Mère" kubera kuba nyina w'Umwami w'abami. Mu 1764, yubatse na Carlo Buonaparte, bakabyara abana umunani. Nyuma y'urupfu rw'umugabo wiwe mu 1785, yimukiye mu Bufaransa aho umuhungu wiwe Napoléon yabaye ikirangirire mu gihe c'Impinduka. Letizia yari umuntu akomeye mu kibano c'Ubufaransa mu gihe c'Ubwami bwa mbere, azwi kubera kamere yiwe ikomeye no kugira akosho ku buzima n'akazi ka Napoléon. Inyuma y'aho Ubwami burangiriye, yamaze imyaka yiwe ya nyuma yiherereye i Roma, arindwa na Papa Piyo wa VII, gushika apfuye muri Ruhuhuma 1836.

Karolini Bonapati
Carolina Mariya Annunziata Bonaparte (25 Ntwarante 1782 – 18 Rusama 1839), azwi nka Caroline Bonaparte, yari umwamikazi w'i Naples n'umwana wa karindwi wa Carlo Buonaparte na Letizia Ramolino, mushiki wa Napoléon wa mbere. Yabaye umwamikazi w'i Naples kandi yategetse igihe umugabo wiwe atariho incuro zine mu 1812-1815. Mu mwaka w’1800, Caroline yubatse na Joachim Murat, umukuru w’ingabo, umuganwa Murat hanyuma aba Umwami wa Naples, umwe mu bajenerali ba Napoléon bahambaye kandi bazwi cane.

Karilo Buonapati
Carlo Maria Buonaparte canke Charles-Marie Bonaparte (27 Ntwarante 1746 – 24 Ruhuhuma 1785) yari umunyamategeko w'umunyakorse azwi cane ko ari se wa Napoléon Bonaparte na sekuru wa Napoléon wa gatatu . Buonaparte yabanje gufasha Pasquale Paoli mu kurwanya ingabo za Corse zishigikiye Repubulika ya Genova. Igihe Corse yabaye igice c'Ubufaransa, mu 1777, Buonaparte yabaye umuserukira ku kirimba ca Louis XVI. Nyuma y’imyaka 20 apfuye, umuhungu wiwe Napoléon yabaye Umwami w'abami w'Ubufaransa, kandi abandi bana ba Buonaparte bararonse amazina y’icubahiro kubera we.

Inzu ya Bonaparte
Inzu y’umuryango wa Bonaparte ni inzu y’abakurambere b’umuryango wa Bonaparte, iri ku nzira Rue Saint-Charles i Ajaccio, ku zinga rya Corse mu Bufaransa. Umuryango wa Bonaparte yayituyemwo kuva mu 1682 kugeza mu 1923.

Pauline Bonapati
Paula Mariya Bonaparte Leclerc Borghese (20 Gitugutu 1780 – 9 Ruheshi 1825), azwi nka Pauline Bonaparte, yari umwamikazi w'Ubufaransa n'umwamikazi wa Guastalla. Yari umwana wa gatandatu wa Letizia Ramolino na Carlo Buonaparte, na mushiki wa Napoléon wa mbere. Yarongoye Jenerali Charles Leclerc, ariko ubucuti bwabo bwarahagarariye n'urupfu rwiwe mu 1802. Pauline yubatse na Camillo Borghese, Umwami wa 6 w'i Sulmona. Umwana wiwe w’ikinege, Dermide Leclerc, yavutse mu bukwe bwiwe bwa mbere, ariko yapfuye akiri muto. Ni we wenyene mu muryango wa Bonaparte wagendeye Napoléon mu bunyagano ku gihugu ciwe, Elba.

Lusiyeni Bonapati
Lucien Bonaparte, umuganwa wa mbere w'i Canino na Musignano (21 Rusama 1775 - 29 Ruheshi 1840), yari umunyapolitike w'umufaransa. Yabaye umushikiranganji w'imbere mu gihugu kuva mu 1799 gushika mu 1800, kandi yari umukuru w'inama y'amajana atanu mu 1799. Lucien, umuhungu wa gatatu wa Carlo Bonaparte na Letizia Ramolino, yari umuvukanyi wa Napoléon Bonaparte. Nk'umukuru w’inama y’amajana atanu, yari umwe mu bagize uruhara mu gitero c’igihugu co mu 18 Brumaire, catumye Napoléon afata ubutegetsi mu Bufaransa.

Igihanga
Igihanga ni igufa rikingira ubwonko. Rigizwe n’amagufa atatu: amagufa y’umutwe, amagufa yo mu maso, n’ay’ugutwi. Ibice nyamukuru ni igihimba c'umutwe n'ic'imbere (neurocranium na viscerocranium) kirimwo ubwonko n’ibihimba nko mu maso, amatwi, izuru, n’akanwa. Ibikorwa vy’igihanga ni ugukingira ubwonko, gutanga umwanya ku maso no ku matwi kugira ngo umuntu abone neza kandi amenye aho amajwi ava. Ku bikoko bifise amahembe, igihanga gikingira mu gutanga ahashingira amahembe.

Andre Masena
André Masséna (6 Gicurasi 1758 – 4 Ndamukiza 1817), yari umukuru w'ingabo z'Ubufaransa mu Ntambara z'Impinduka n'iza Napoléon. Yari umwe mu bajenerali 18 ba mbere bashinzwe na Napoléon, akitwa "Umwana Mukundwa w’Intsinzi" kandi afatwa nk'umwe mu bajenerali bakomeye muri izo ntambara.. Masséna yarahambaye mu Ntambara y’Ihuriro rya Mbere, atsinda cane mu bikorwa vy’ingabo z’Abafaransa kandi ayoboye iterambere rikomeye mu karere ka Otirishiya, bituma haba ibiganiro vy’amahoro. Naho abandi bajenerali ba Napoléon bari barize mu mashure y’igisirikare, Masséna yashitse ku bukuru ataravyigiye. Yava mu vyo kwicisha bugufi, akagera kure ku buryo Napoléon yamwise “izina rikomeye ry'ingoma yanje.”. Uretse ivyo Masséna yaroraniwe mu ntambara, uburongozi bwa Masséna bwarafashije benshi mu bikorwa vyiwe. Abenshi mu bakuru b’ingabo b’Abafaransa bo muri ico gihe bari barongowe na we igihe kanaka. Masséna yahawe izina ry'Umwami wa Essling mu 1809. Ariko, yakoze nabi mu ntambara y’Izinga, atsindwa muri Sabugal na Fuentes de Oñoro. Napoléon yamusimbuje Auguste de Marmont, maze Masséna ntiyasubira gukorera igisirikare, ahubwo aba umukuru w’ingabo i Marseille.

Katirin Hahn
Hahn (yavutse 23 Nyakanga 1973) ni umukinyi w'umunyamerika. Yatanguye muri Crossing Jordan (2001–2007) maze amenyekana cane mu mafilime nka Uko wotakaza umuhungu mu misi 10 (2003), Umumenyeshamakuru (2004), Abavukanyi b’abahungu (2008), Turi abasenyi (2013), n’Igitunguru c’Ikirahuri (2022). Nk’umukinyi mukuru, Hahn yakinnye mu Afternoon Delight (2013), abavyeyi babi (2016) na Noweli y’abavyeyi babi (2017), hamwe na Private Life (2018). Yaragaragaye mu zindi filime nka Inzira y’Impinduka (2008), Aho Niho Nkusiga (2014), Urugendo (2015), na Kapiteni w’Igitangaza (2016). Yavuze ijwi rya Ericka Van Helsing mu Hotel Transylvania (2018–2022) na Dogiteri Octopus mu gitabo c’umugabo w’igitagangurirwa (2018). Mu televiziyo, Hahn yari afise uruhara mu biganiro vya NBC Amabarabara n’Imyidagaduro (2012–2015) na Amasanamu y’uruhererekane (2014–2019). Yakinnye mu Madamu Fletcher (2019) na Ndazi ko Ivyo Vyinshi ari Ukuri (2020). Yagaragaye nka Agatha Harkness mu WandaVision (2021) na Agatha All Along (2024). Yatowe ngo aronke igihembo ca Primetime Emmy Award, kandi ku bw’uruhara rwiwe mu Tiny Beautiful Things (2023), yararonse igihembo ca Emmy Award.

Intambara ya Lodi
Intambara ya Lodi yarwanywe ku wa 10 Rusama 1796 hagati y'ingabo z'Abafaransa zirongowe na Napoléon Bonaparte n'ingabo z'inyuma z'Abanyaotirishiya zirongowe na Karl Philipp Sebottendorf i Lodi muri Lombardie. Abarinzi b’inyuma baratsinzwe, ariko umugwi munini w’Ingabo z’Otirishiya za Johann Peter Beaulieu waronkeye umwanya wo gusubira inyuma. Ivyo vyabaye mu gihe c'Igitero c'Italiyano co mu 1796–1797.

Lebroni Yakobo
LeBron Raymone James Sr. (yavutse kw'igenekerezo rya 30 Kigarama 1984) ni umukinyi w'umupira w'amaguru w'umunyamerika w'umugwi wa Los Angeles Lakers mw'ishirahamwe ry'umupira w'amaguru (NBA). Azwi nka "King James" kandi afatwa nk'umwe mu bakinyi bakomeye mu mateka y'umupira w'amaguru, agereranywa na Michael Jordan. James yatsinze ibikombe bine vya NBA mu mikino ya nyuma kandi yatsinze igikombe ca mbere ca NBA mu 2023 hamwe na Lakers, hamwe n'imidari itatu y'inzahabu mu mikino ya Olympique. Uretse kuba ari we mukinyi wa mbere mu gutsinda ibitego vyinshi muri NBA, LeBron James afise ibihembo vyinshi: ibikombe bine vy’umukinyi w’agaciro (MVP), ibikombe bine mu mikino ya nyuma, n’ibihembo bitatu vy’umukinyi w’inyenyeri zose. Yaratowe nk’umukinyi w’inyenyeri zose incuro 20, mu mugwi wa All-NBA incuro 20 (harimwo 13 mu mugwi wa mbere), no mu mugwi w’abakinyi b’inyuma incuro zitandatu. Afise imyaka 22 yakinnye na Vince Carter, akaba ari we mukinyi akuze kuruta abandi muri NBA. James yakuze akina umupira w’amaguru mu ikipe ya St. Mary muri Akron, Ohio, ahabwa ibikombe kubera ubushobozi bwo gutsinda no gutanga amapasse. Yatowe na Cleveland Cavaliers mu mwaka w'2003, ahabwa izina ry'umukinyi wa mbere w'umwaka muri NBA mu 2004. Yarongoye Cavaliers mu mikino ya nyuma ya NBA mu 2007, atwara igihembo ca NBA MVP mu 2009 na 2010. Mu mwaka w'2010, James yinjira mu ikipe ya Miami Heat mu kiganiro kidasanzwe citwa The Decision, vyateye impaka mu mateka y’imikino. James yatsinze ibikombe bibiri vya mbere vya NBA mu 2012 na 2013 akina mu ikipe ya Heat, avana ibihembo vya MVP na Finals MVP. Nyuma y'umwaka wa kane muri Heat, yahisemwo gusubira mu Cavaliers, aho yarongoye ikipe gutsinda Golden State Warriors mu mikino ya nyuma mu 2016, atanga igikombe ca mbere c'ikipe. Mu mwaka w’2018, yasinye n’ikipe ya Lakers, atwara igikombe ca NBA mu 2020. Ku wa 7 Ruhuhuma 2023, James yararengeye Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, aba umukinyi wa mbere mu gutsinda ibitego vyinshi muri NBA, akina hamwe n'umuhungu wiwe Bronny muri Lakers.

Natalie Portman
Natalie Hershlag (yavutse ku wa 9 Kamena 1981), azwi kw'izina rya Natalie Portman, ni umukinyi w'amareresi w'umunyamerika yavukiye muri Isirayeli. Afite ubuhinga bwinshi bwo gukina amasanamu kuva mu bwana, yarakinnye mu mafilime menshi, kandi yararonse ibihembo byinshi, harimwo igihembo ca Oscar n'ibihembo bibiri vya Golden Globe. Portman yatanguye gukina afise imyaka cumi n’ibiri mu filime Léon: The Professional (1994). Mu 1998, yarakinnye ku mugaragaro muri Broadway mu gikino The Diary of a Young Girl, maze yamenyekana kw’isi yose kubera akazi ke nka Padmé Amidala mu Star Wars: The Phantom Menace (1999). Yize muri kaminuza ya Harvard kuva mu 1999 gushika mu 2003, akarangiza afise impapuro z’umutsindo mu vy’ubuhinga bwo mu mutwe. N’ubwo yagabanyije ibikorwa vyiwe, yarakomeje gukina mu ntambara z'inyenyeri (2002, 2005) no mu gikino The Seagull mu 2001. Mu 2004, Portman yatsindiye igihembo ca Oscar c'umukinyi mwiza w'umufasha n’igihembo ca Golden Globe kubera akina mu mukino Closer. Yakinnye Evey Hammond muri V for Vendetta (2005), Anne Boleyn muri The Other Boleyn Girl (2008), n’umukinyi w’umupira w’amaguru mu Black Swan (2010), ivyo vyatumye atsindira igihembo c'umukinyi mwiza. Mu 2011, yakinnye mu No Strings Attached, hanyuma mu 2016, yabaye Jacqueline Kennedy mu Jackie, agatsindira igihembo ca gatatu ca Oscar. Portman yarakinnye nka Jane Foster muri Thor (2011), Thor: The Dark World (2013), na Thor: Love and Thunder (2022), akaba umwe mu bakinyi bahembwa amahera menshi kw'isi. Mu 2021, yarakoze kandi arakina mu nkuru y’uruhererekane Kigarama (2023). Portman ayoboye filime ngufi Eva (2008) n’ikiganiro Inkuru y’urukundo n’umwiza (2015). Ni umunyagihugu abiri wa Isirayeli na Amerika, umuvugizi w’uburenganzira bw’ibikoko n’ibidukikije. Yarongowe n’umuhinga mu vy’ugutamba Benjamin Millepied kuva mu 2012 gushika mu 2024, bavyaranye abana babiri.

Umuco
Umuco (/ˈkʌltʃər / KUL-chər) ni iciyumviro gishiramwo inyifato, inzego, n'amategeko dusanga mu mibano y'abantu, hamwe n'ubumenyi, ukwizera, ubugenegene, amategeko, imigenzo, ubushobozi, inyifato n'ingeso z'abantu muri iyo migwi. 1\. Imico kama akenshi ikomoka mu karere kanaka.Abantu bararonka umuco w'ukwigisha imico n'imigenzo y'abantu, ivyo bikaba bibonekera mu mico kama itandukanye y'igihugu. Itunganywa ry'itunganywa ry'imico kama y'imico kama mu kibano; Ni nk'ubuyobozi bw'inyifato, inyifato, imvugo n'inyifato runtu mu bihe, ivyo bikaba vyuvuga ko ari akarorero k'ukwitega ibintu mu kibano. Gusa iyo umuntu ahuye n'ingorane z'amagara y'abantu ashobora kugira ingorane nk'uko umuntu umwe avyifatamwo ashobora kuvyifatamwo neza mu bijanye n'ihindagurika ry'ibihe, kubera ko ata nyishu zijanye n'ihindagurika ry'ibihe. 2.Mu migenzo y'ikirundi, umushingantahe atorwa nk'umuntu umwe, Umushingantahe ni umuntu afise kamere kanaka kandi ategerezwa kuvuga ukuri ico ari co cose. Ni umuntu w'ukuri, uwutarambirwa, atari imborerwa, mu majambo make mu butungane ni akarorero mu kibano. Mu misi iheze, mu gihe hari umuntu yabuze imbuto, babwirwa ngo bagende kumushingantahe azibahe.umushingantahe Umushingantahe ategerezwa kandi kwigenga, ivyo bikaba bisobanura ko umuntu adashobora gufuta umucanwa naho yoba avuga ukuri, kuko ubugoyagiri bwiwe buramushira mu biturire. Umyshingantahe akingira umupfakazi n'impfuvyi akarenganyo, ahanini ni Ubuntu (humanism), umugenzo mwiza, utunganye.

Umugabo w'umuvugizi
Dushimirimana Eric, azwi cane kw'izina ryiwe ry'urukino Spoks Man (yavutse kw'igenekerezo rya 15 Ndamukiza mumwaka w'1992), ni umurundi w'umuririmvyi n'umwanditsi w'indirimbo, umunyamakuru w'ibiganiro n'umumenyeshamakuru w'amakuru muri Dushi Entertainment. == Ubuzima bwa kera n'inyigisho == Spoks Man yavutse kw'igenekerezo rya 15 Ndamukiza 1992, i Bujumbura, uwahoze ari umurwa mukuru w'Uburundi . Yakuriye mu muryango w’abagatolika, amara igice kinini c’umwana wiwe i Bwiza, kimwe mu bice bikundwa cane muri Marie de Bujumbura, aho yateye intambwe za mbere mu bijanye n’umuziki. Mu mwaka w'1993, Spoks Man yatanguye gutamba kugira ngo aronke amahera mu mabarabara no mu bibanza vy'imico kama, yakozwe n'umugwi w'umuziki w'abanyakongo (wahora witwa Zairian ). Mu mwaka w'2006, Spoks Man yarashikirije umuhinga mu bijanye n'indirimbo Jeremy Production, uwo na we amuha ikibanza co gukoreramwo ijwi ryiwe n'umuziki wiwe, na we aca amukorera indirimbo "Warambaniye" na "Umwana". Haciye imyaka itatu, igihe Jerem Production yagenda, Spoks Man yari yacitse intege cane mu bijanye n’umuziki wiwe. Mu cizigiro co kuronka umuyobozi, yaciye afata ingingo yo kwamamaza amashirahamwe y’igihugu y’itumanaho, harimwo abiri ya Ucom mu 2009 n’iyindi ya Smart Communications mu 2010. Mu nzu y'indirimbo yitwa High Level Record mu mwaka w'2011, Spoks Man yarasohoye indirimbo yitwa "Iherezo ryiza" n'amasanamu yiwe yakozwe na Johnny B wo muri Mira Mira Film. Kumwe n'abandi baririmvyi benshi b'Abarundi, bafatanije mu ndirimbo yiwe yitwa «Abamenyesh might». Mu mwaka w’2012, yaciye aba umucuraranzi w’amadisiki muri studio yiwe nshasha yitwa High Vision Studio, mu karere ka Bujumbura ka mu buraruko bwitwa Mutanga-Nord. Kubera urukundo rwinshi rw'umuziki, Spoks Man yarasohoye indirimbo "Ndatemutse" irimwo abaririmvyi 19th na Dj Preeze 36, ariko yari nziza cane. Iyi ndirimbo yakozweko mu nzu y’indirimbo yitwa High Level Record hamwe na Dj Goz imbere y’uko isohoka ku mugaragaro muri Ruheshi 2013. Haciye ukwezi kumwe, yongera gukora amasanamu y'indirimbo "Ndatemutse" ari kumwe na Johnny B, iyo ndirimbo ikaba yarakunzwe cane mu Burundi, hanyuma n'indirimbo yiwe "Burundi" aca atsindira igihembo ca Isanganiro co mu 2013, gitunganirizwa buri mwaka na Radio Isanganiro, cashinzwe mu 2002. Kuva mu mwaka w’2014, Spoks Man yarasohoye izindi ndirimbo zitari nke, zimwe muri zo zifatanije n’abandi baririmvyi bazwi cane bo mu Burundi. Uwo kwezi kwa munani yaranditse ku ndirimbo imwe na Mkombozi, « Siko nabisanze »; mbere yasohotse ku ndirimbo "Nzobiki murikazoza" ya Ayo Lizer, ubu ari ku kigo ca Tanzaniya WCB Wasafi ari kumwe n'umuhinga mu vy'umuziki wa bongo fleva Diamond Platnumz Mu mwaka w’2017, yarahevye umwuga wiwe w’umuziki, yihebera umwuga w’itangazamakuru. Ubu Spoks Man ni umumenyeshamakuru wa Top10, B-News y’ikinyamakuru c’abikorera ku giti cabo citwa Best Entertainment Televiziyo (BeTV), gifise icicaro gikuru i Bujumbura.Bujumbura, Burundi. == Diskogarafi == === Alubumu === * Ndakumbuye Iwacu ** 2017: Ndakumbuye iwacu ** 2017: Mbega? ** 2017: Amahera ** 2016: Umuselibateri ft. Big Fizzo
Mugani Désiré, yavutse 25 mukakaro 1978 i Bwiza, mu ntara ya Bujumbura, azwi kw'izina ry'urukino Big Fizzo, ni umurundi w'umucuraranzi , umunyamideri, umuririmvyi, umuririmvyi-umwanditsi w'indirimbo, umuhinga mu vyo gukora indirimbo n'umunyamigambi , . Ni we yashinze ishirahamwe ry'umuziki ryitwa BantuBwoy .À son retour à Bujumbura, entre 1990 et 1993, il commence à pratiquer la danse. Il rejoint le groupe Nigga soul comme danseur et une année plus tard, comme vocaliste. == Inkuru y'ubuzima == === Ubwana n'uburezi === Big Fizzo yavutse kw'igenekerezo rya 25 Nyakanga 1978 i Bwiza, akarere ka Bujumbura, igisagara kinini kuruta ibindi vyose mu Burundi ( umurwa mukuru w'ubutunzi w'igihugu n'uwahoze ari umurwa mukuru wa politike gushika mu . Yakuriye mu ntara ya Makamba mu Burundi bwo mu bumanuko, ihuriye ku mupaka na Tanzaniya, kandi yari afise akosho, ico gihe, k’umuziki w’Abakongo n’uw’Abatanzaniya . Agarutse i Bujumbura, hagati y’umwaka w’1990 n’uw’1993, yaratanguye kwimenyereza gutamba. Yaje mu mugwi Nigga soul nk’umuvyinyi, haciye umwaka, aba umucuraranzi w’indirimbo. == Ubuzima bw'umuziki == === 1997 - 2008 : Intango y'umwuga === Mu mpera z'imyaka ya 90, amaze gusohora umuziki wiwe wa mbere mu mugwi Nigga soul, Mugani Désiré yaciye afata ingingo yo gutangura umuziki wiwe wenyene. Yavumbuwe na Kidum Kibido, umuhinga mu vy’ubuhinga bw’amasanamu w’Umurundi aba muri Kenya, amuha amasezerano yo gukora iyo filime. Muri Nyakanga 2001, yasohoye indirimbo yiwe ya mbere yitwa Farious, indirimbo yitwa Mbarira . Iyo ya nyuma iririmbwa mu kirundi (ururimi rwiwe kavukire), iramufasha kuja mu birori vyo mu bisagara bitari bike vyo mu Burundi. Yasohoye indirimbo yiwe ya kabiri n’iya gatatu , mu ntango z’umwaka w’2002. Mu mwaka w'2008, Big Fizzo yatangaje ko azosohora urukurikirane rwiwe rwa mbere rwitwa " Jewe " rurimwo indirimbo 17. Ariko rero, mu ndirimbo zimwe zimwe yarafatanije n’abaririmvyi b’Abarundi batari bake nka Lolilo, Channy Queen na Kidum Kibido. Iyi alubumu yasohotse muri Nyakanga 2009 ifise indirimbo 17 zose hamwe . === 2009 - 2017 : Ukuroranirwa kw'isi yose === Mu mwaka w'2009, ubuzima bwiwe bwarahindutse cane . Big Fizzo yarakoranye n’abaririmvyi bo kw’isi yose nka Tom Close muri uwo mwaka nyene ku ndirimbo yitwa Baza. Kandi ku wa 12 Ruheshi 2015, indirimbo Indoro irimwo abaririmvyi babiri b'abanyarwanda Charly na Nina yarasohotse ku ncuro ya mbere ku mbuga ngurukanabumenyi no ku maradiyo . Inyuma y’aho iyo migenderanire iherutse gutera imbere, yaratumiwe gukora igiterane mu gikombe c’umupira w’amaguru c’ibihugu vya Afirika (CHAN) cabereye i Kigali (umurwa mukuru w’u Rwanda ) muri Mukakaro na Ruhuhuma 2016. Big Fizzo akora indirimbo yiwe ya kabiri yitwa Fizzology . : yasohotse muri Ruheshi 2017 ifise amazina 23 kandi yaronse ikete ry'icubahiro ry'umukozi mwiza w'umwaka na Perezida wa Repubulika Pierre Nkurunziza . Agiye mu rugendo rwo kumenyekanisha urukurikirane rwiwe aciye mu bisagara bitandukanye vyo mu Burundi. Muri Nyakanga 2017, yabaye intumwa y’ishirahamwe “Una mano per la speranza onlus” ryashinzwe mu 2014 mu Butaliyano kugira ngo ritere imbere abana bafise ubumuga bwo mu mutwe. === 2017 - ubu : Imyidagaduro ya BantuBwoy === Ku wa 21 Ntwarante 2017, Big Fizzo yatanguje ishirahamwe ryitwa BantuBwoy Entertainment rikaba ari ryo shirahamwe ry'umuziki w'Uburundi rifise icicaro i Bujumbura . Mu ntumbero yo guteza imbere umuziki w'Uburundi, yasinye n'abaririmvyi bo mu gihugu nka Double Jay, Kirikou Akili, Elly's Bwoy, Drama T, Msamaria na Jolis . Muri 2020, Big Fizzo yasohoye Desideratus na Legendary mu gihe c'imyidagaduro ya BantuBwoy, indirimbo zibiri zirimwo indirimbo 37, zirimwo indirimbo nka SUGUA mu 2019 na Kokota mu 2020 zarimwo Double Jay na Kirikou Akili, harimwo n'aba Drama T. == Diskogarafi == === Alubumu za studio === * 2009 : Umuyuda * 2017 : Ivy'amazi * 2020 : Ivyifuzo * 2020 : Inkuru z'imigani === Indirimbo === * 2001 : Mbarira * 2002 : Sitapenda tena * 2003 : Nsigare . * 2002 : Mambo juu ya mambo * 2006 : Niwanyemera * 2007 : Sinoguhisha * 2007 : Sinarinzi * 2008 : Garuka * 2009 : Baza * 2009 : Mporeza muto * 2009 : Munyana * 2009 : Urukumbuzi * 2009 : Umechokoza nyuki * 2011 : Nataka wajuwe * 2013 : Soso * 2013 : Ndakumisinze * 2013 : Bajou * 2014 : Ubusa * 2014 : Izina ryanje ni nde * 2015 : Indoro * 2016 : Warabibonye ft. 19th
Florian Iteka bazi caane kwitazirano 19th yavukiye i Bujumbura, mu Burundi ni umuririmvyi w’Uburundi azwi cane kubera ingabirano yiwe y'ukuririmba umudiho wa hip-hop, rap, na afrobeat. 19th ni umuhungu wa Domitille Kiramvu, umumenyeshamakuru w’I burundi azwi cane. Uyu muririmvyi yamenyekanye canecane mu muziki w’Uburundi no hanze y’igihugu. == Ubuzima bwiwe == Yavutse kandi akurira i Bujumbura, 19th yavutse mu mwaka w'igihumbi n'amajana icenda na mirongo icenda na kane (1994)https://www.musicinafrica.net/fr/directory/19th, yakuze akunda imico n’ubuhinga, kandi vyari bifise ico bimwigisha. Nyina, Domitille Kiramvu, umukenyezi rurangiranwa mu mwuga wo kumenyesha amakuru. Akiri muto, yakunda cane umuziki maze amenyekana biciye ku ndirimbo yiwe yitwa "El Captain" (2012), yamenyekanye ku bakunzi ba hip-hop n'abandi bose. Yaciye asohora izindi ndirimbo nka "Bandit", "2013", "NZURA", n’izindi, bituma agira ikibanza gikomeye mu mwuga w’umuziki w'uburundi. == Umwuga wiwe mu muziki == Ubu 19th aba mu gihugu c'Ububiligi, aho abandanya kwagura umwuga wiwe mu muziki no gukorana n’abandi baririmvyi b’abarundi. Nk’izi ndirimbo zikurikira : * "NDIYEMERA" hamwe na Eazy Boy, * "NDATEMUTSE" hamwe na Spoksman, * "IVYO BITO" hamwe na Stylozoff. Ivyo bikorwa yakoranye n'abandi birerekana ingene yitaho cane guteza imbere umuziki w’Uburundi ngo uronke ijambo ku rwego mpuzamakungu. == Ubuhinga n'ivyatumye amenyekana == 19th afise uburyo budasanzwe bwo kuvanga imidiho ya hip-hop igezweho n’umuziki w’Afrika, akongera akavuga ubuzima bwiwe hamwe n’ibigeragezo vya misi yose. == Indirimbo ziwe zizwi cane == * El Capitain * Bandit * 2013 * Family * Hip Hop * Heat * Nzura == Izo yakoranye n'abandi == * Ndatemutse ft Spoksman * Ndiyemera ft Eazy Boy * Ivyo Bito ft Stylozoff * Umuziki ft SBM Diandry === inkomoko ===

Berry Music
Ndemeye Bertrand, azwi kw'izina ry'umuziki wiwe nka Berry Music, ni umuririmvyi n’umwanditsi w’indirimbo nziza wo mu Burundi. Yavukiye i Bujumbura, akaba azwi cane kubera umuziki wiwe w’imvange uhuriza hamwe Afrobeat, Afropop, na R&B;, bigashimwa n’abakunzi b’umuziki haba mu gihugu imbere no mu karere ka Afurika y’Ubuseruko. == Biographie == Berry Music yakuriye mu muryango hamwe nabo bavukana bakaba baranamukundira urugendo rw’umuziki wiwe. Umuririmvyi wicitegererezo ciwe akaba ari Jean Pierre Nimbona (Kidumu) hamwe n’abandi b’iki gihe. Umurima w'ibijumbu
Umurima w’ibijumbu ni agace k’isi ndimwa karimwemwo "ibijumbu" bivuye ku bimera (mucongereza sweet potatoes). Ibintu nyamukuru ku murima w’ibijumbu: 1\. Isi ndimwa: hakunze kuba harimwo ishwagara (lime) kandi ifise amazi ahagije ariko ataretsemo amazi menshi. 2\. Gutera: Ibijumbu biterwa hakorejwe imibuto (imivyuka) ishirwa mw'isi ndimwa. 3\. Gucunga: Bisaba kurindwa ivyonyi. 4\. Isarura (iyimbura): Ibijumbu bisarurwa ( vyimbugwa) nyuma y’amezi 3–5, bitewe n’ubwoko. Akamaro k'ibijumbu: \- Ibijumba biribwa nk’ibiribwa nyamukuru ( mbumbarugo). \- Birimwo isukari karemano (carbohydrates), indemamubiri, n’ivyunyunyu. Akamaro k'amazi ku murima w'ibijumbu mu ncamake: Afasha ibijumbu gukura neza no kwaguka. Atuma imizi y'ibijumbu ifata intungamubiri zo mu butaka. Arinda ibijumbu kwuma mu gihe c'izuba. Yongera umwimbu n'ubwiza bw'ibijumbu. Muri rusangi, amazi ni ngirakamaro kugira ibijumbu bikure neza kandi bitange umwimbu mwiza.

Umunyota
Umunyota ni ivu risigara nyuma yo guturira ibintu nk'ibiti, ivyatsi, cangwa ibishishwa vy’ibirimwa n'ibindi. Umunyota ufise akamaro kenshi mu buzima bwa buri munsi, cane cane mu mumitumba ( muburimyi n'ubworozi) . Ngako akamaro k’umwavu: 1\. Gufumbira isindimwa: Umwavu ufasha kongera ivyunyunyu mw'isindimwa (potassium, calcium). 2\. Kurwanya udukoko mu bitegwa – Bawushira ku bigori, ibijumbu n'ibindi bitegwa kugira ngo wirukane udukoko. 3\. Isuku mu rugo – Usukura ibikoresho nk’ibyuma, utubindi, n’inkono. 4\. Kurwanya aside (acidité) mu butaka – Ubuso burimo aside nyinshi bushobora kunanirwa kwera; umwavu urabugabanyiriza. 5\. Ubuvuzi bwa kavukire – Aho hambere bawukoresha nk’ifu yo gusiga ku ahavyimba cangwa inkovu. Icitonderwa: Nubwo ufise akamaro, sivyiza kuwushira kuri buri gitegwa kuko ushobora kwica ibimera bimwe iyo urengeje urugero.

Ngivyo ibintu nyamukuru kugirango uwumenye: == 1.Uburyo utegurwa: == \- Usabwa kuba ufise ahantu hari amazi menshi cangwa bishoboka kuhazana amazi (imigende itemba, ibishanga, ibidenderi). \- Umurima ushobora gucibwa ibibanza (amasuka) kugira ngo amazi atononekara. == 2. Ivyo umurima w’umuceri ukenera: == \- Amazi menshi: Umuceri umera neza mu mazi (akenshi utera mu buryo bwitwa "paddy fields"). \- Ifumbire: Nk’iy’ibirungo (ifumbire mvaruganda cangwa karemano). \- Izuba: Rirakenewe kugira ngo umuceri ukure neza. == 3. Igihe co kuwurima: == \- Haterwa imbuto mu karima gato, hanyuma hakimara igihe c’ukwezi 1–1.5, bimurwa bigaterwa mu murima munini w’amazi. \- Gusarura bimara hafi amezi 3–5 bitewe n’ubwoko bw’umuceri. == 4. Umwimbu: == \- Iyo witaweho neza, umurima umwe ushobora gutanga umusaruro ( umwimbu) mwinshi cyane.

Gukuraho akamoto kabi
Gukuraho akamoto kabi kumubiri bitegwa umuntu ariko nyamukuru ico wokora mu gihe wipfuza gukuraho ako kamoto kabi? Kwoga kenshi gashoboka nimiburiburi kabiri kumusi na cane mu kwaha no hagati y'amaguru, no mubirenge hagati mu mano ukoreshe isabuni; Kunywa amazi kenshi kuko bituma icuya kiba dilué akamoto kabi kakagabanuka; Irinde kurya cane inyama n'imfungurwa zirimwo ibirungo vyinshi,irya zimota cane gabanya Koresha cane indimu mu kwoga kuko acide iri mu ndimu irica utu bactéries twinshi yikoreshe cane mukwaha no kumubiri; Ambara impuzu itanga akayaga kuko iyafata cane umubiri itera ivyuya; Kumesa impuzu no guhinduranya. Kwoga (gusukura umubiri n’amazi n’isabuni) bifise akamaro kanini cane mu gukuraho akamoto kabi ku mubiri: Gukuraho ibyuya n’umwanda: ibyuya iyo bimaze igihe ku mubiri bivanga n’udukoko two ku ruhu bigatera akamoto kabi. Kwoga birabikuraho. Kurandura udukoko two ku ruhu: bacteries zitera impumuro mbi ziba ku mubiri zirasukurwa n’isabuni n’amazi. Gusukura amavuta y’umubiri: uruhu rusanzwe rukora amavuta; iyo atabaye menshi ashobora gutera impumuro mbi. Gutanga isuku y’uruhu: kwoga bituma uruhu rumera neza kandi rugahumura neza. Gutuma wumva umeze neza: umuntu yogejwe yumva afise isuku n’ukwihweza neza mu bantu. Mu ncamake, kwoga ni uburyo nyamukuru bwo gukuraho akamoto kabi no kugumana isuku y’umubiri.

Amavya
Amavya ni imyanya yibanga y’imbere y’umugabo ibika intanga ngabo (sperme). Mu ndimi zimwe, bayita amabya. Ngivyo ibintu nyamukuru kuri yo: 1\. Ico akora: \- Akora intanga ngabo zikoreshwa mu gutera inda. \- Akora kandi hormone yitwa testostérone ifasha mu kugira ibimenyetso vy’ubugabo (nk’ijwi rinini, imisatsi ku mubiri, imikura y’imyanya ndangagitsina). 2\. Aho aherereye: \- Akunze kuba mu gice cy’inyuma cy’imyanya ndangagitsina, mu gasozi kitwa scrotum. 3\. *Kurinda amavya:* \- Kwambara impuzu itagufata cane. \- Kwirinda gukubitwa cangwa guhungabanywa. \- Guhorana isuku no kwivuza hakiri kare niba harimwo uburibwe, kuvyimba, cangwa impinduka idasanzwe.

Isima
Isima yo kubaka inzu ni ifu y'umuhondo w'ibikoresho biva mu mazi, ibuye n'ishwagara (limestone), ikoreshwa mu bwubatsi. Bayita kandi simu cangwa cement. Ibintu nyamukuru kuri yo: 1\. Ivyo isima ikora: \- Ikoreshwa mu gukora beton (concrete) n’ifu y’iturika. \- Ifatanya n’umusenyi n’amazi, bigatanga urusyo rukomeye rwifashishwa mu kwubaka impome, gukora fondasiyo, n’ibindi. 2\. Ubwoko bwa sima: \- Portland cement – ikoreshwa cane ku isi yose. \- Sima ya hydraulic – ifata n’iyo yahuye n’amazi. \- Sima ya blanc – ikoreshwa ahatari hakeneye ibara rikomeye. 3\. *Uko ikoreshwa: \- Ivangwa n’umusenyi n’amazi mu rugero runaka. \- Bishobora kongerwamo amabuye kugira ngo habe *beton* yo gusakara cangwa gukora fondasiyo. 4\. *Kubika neza:* \- Ntigomba gufatwa n’amazi itarabikwa, kuko yohita yinonekara. \- Ibikwa ahantu humutse kandi hakingiye.

Ubuzima bw'umweranda Lorenti

Muri Hongriya, barabonye Lorenti akirije umusalaba mu minwe aravyurira umwete n'ubutwari abasirikare b'abakristu. Niho rero Papa Gregori w'icumi yahava amurungika ngo aje kumuserukira mu nama nkuru y'Ekleziya gatolika yabereye i Lyon mu Bufransa, muri yo bakaba bashaka kurondera uburyo abo mu Bulaya bw'ubuseruko n'abo mu burengero bosubiza hamwe... Yahwereye mu gihe nyene iryo koraniro ryariko riragirwa. Mu bitabu yanditse, yashimikiye ku nyigisho za Ogustino mweranda zitubwira ko ingabirano Imana iduha zifise ikibanza kinini mu buzima rukristu, akatwumvisha kandi ko uwugutegera nk'uko bikwlye ivy'lmana. Frère Gille yamubwiye ati: «Mwebwe abahinga murahiriwe kuko lmana ibaha ingabirano nyinshi zo gutahuza ivy'ijuru, ariko nka twebwe ibijuju ubona twomara iki ?» Ni ho Bonaventura yamwishura ati : «Ingabirano y'agakura Imana itanga ni iyifasha abantu bose kuyikunda ». Yaranditse ati : « Uwuhanga amaso Kristu yabambwe akabigirana ukwemera, akamwitura, uwo rero barasangira guhimbaza Pasika n'ukuvuga ko yitwaza umusalaba akajabuka ikiyaga gitukura».

Akamaro k'Ibigori
Ibigori bifitiye umubiri wacu akamaro nka bimwe mu bigize ifunguro ry'ibanzeIbigori ni bimwe mu biterwa ngengabutunzi bikunzwe kandi bikoreshwa cane muri Afurika no mu Burundi cane. Uretse kuba ari igiterwa c’ibanze ku mfungurwa za benshi, ibigori bifise n’akamaro gakomeye ku buzima, ku bukungu ndetse no kw'iterambere rusangi ry’igihugu. 1\. Inyungu ku buzima: Ku bijanye n’ubuzima, ibigori birimwo ntungamubiri zitandukanye. harimwo fibre ifasha mu gukumira ingwara zo mu mara. Ibigori binarinda ingwara nka kanseri y’amara , kandi bikarinda kuvyibuha birenzurugero kuko bituma umuntu yumva ahaze igihe kirekire. Uretse ivyo, ibigori birimwo kandi vitamin B, karisiyumu na magnesium – vyose bifasha umubiri gukora neza. 2\. Inyungu mu butunzi: Mu butunzi, ibigori ni igiterwa cinjiza amafaranga ku barimwii benshi. Biroroshe kurima kandi vyera kare. Umwimbu w’ibigori ushobora kugurishwa ku masoko atandukanye yaba ay'imbere mu gihugu canke mu mahanga. Ibi bituma bigira uruhara runini mu guteza imbere imibereho y’abenegihugu. 3\. Ikoreshwa ry'ibigori mu bundi buryo: Hagiye gutunganywa ifu y’ibigori yujuje intungamubiri izakoreshwa mu kugaburira abanyeshuri - Kigali TodayIbigori kandi birakorwamwo ibiribwa bitandukanye birimo ifu ya kawunga, ibisuguti ndetse n’ibinyobwa kavukire. Mu bworozi, ibigori birakoreshwa nkimfungurwa nkakarore nkabatunze inkoko .Muri rusangi, ibigori ni igiterwa c’akamaro cane mu buzima bw’abenegihugu, mu gutuma habaho iterambere rirama ndetse no mu guteza imbere inganda n’uburimwi. Kuvyitaho no kubirima neza ni ukuziganya mu buzima bw’ejo haza.

Ubukozi bw'ikibi bw' abagore

Insiguro Ubukozi bw’ikibi bukorwa n’abagore burimwo ibikorwa bitandukanye nk’ugukubita, ubukazi bwo mu rugo, guhohotera mu vyiyumviro hamwe n’ibindi bikorwa vy’ivyaha. Bushobora gukorerwa uwo bubana, abana, abandi bagore canke abandi bantu bose. Ubwoko bw’ubukazi Ubukazi bw’umubiri Burimwo gukubita, gukomeretsa canke ikindi cose cangiza umubiri w’uwundi muntu. Ubukazi bwo mu vyiyumviro Burimwo gutuka, gutera ubwoba, gukoresha amayeri yo kuganza uwundi no kumufata nabi mu mutima. Ubukazi mu bubano bw’abubatse Hari aho abagore bashobora kuba ari bo bakora ubukazi mu bubano bw’abubatse, naho bitavugwa cane. Ubukazi butaziguye Bugaragarira mu bikorwa nk’ugusebanya, gukumira uwundi mu bandi canke gukwiragiza ibihuha. Ibituma bubaho Hari ibintu bitandukanye bishobora gutuma habaho ubu bukazi: Imvo z’imibano n’imigenzo Kuba uwabikoze yarigeze guhura n’ubukazi Ingorane zo mu mutwe Ubukene canke ubuzima bugoye Gukoresha ibiyayuramutwe (inzoga n’ibindi) Imibare n’ubushakashatsi Ubushakashatsi mu vy’ivyaha no mu mibano bwerekana ko abagore badakunda kwijukira cane ubukazi bukomeye ugereranije n’abagabo. Ariko rero, baraboneka mu bwoko bumwe bumwe bw’ubukazi, cane cane mu muryango canke mu makimbirane y’abantu bafitaniye imigenderanire. Uko bubonwa mu kibano Akenshi ubukazi bukorwa n’abagore burirengagizwa canke bukabonwa ukundi bitewe n’ivyiyumviro rusangi vy’uko umugore ategerezwa kuba umunyamahoro. Khalid ibn al-Walid
Khalid ibn al-Walid (yitavye Imana mu 642 CE), azwi kandi nka Sayf Allah al-Maslul (Inyota ya rurema yashijwe), yari umugaba w’ingabo w’umu-Arabu rurangiranwa mu bihe vy’intsinzi z’idini rya Isilamu mu kiyerekezo c’ikinjana ca karindwi. Azwi kwi ntsinzi zidasanzwe mu ntambara zirenga 50 atigeze atsindwa na mwe, ivyo bikaba vyaratumye Ubwami bwa Isilamu (Rashidun Caliphate) bwaguka cane ku ngoma ya ba Caliph Abu Bakr na Umar ibn al-Khattab. ==Ubuzima bwiwe bwa mbere no gukwira mw’idini== Yavukiye mu muryango ukomeye w’aba Banu Makhzum mu muryango w’aba Quraysh i Maka. Mu ntango, Khalid yararwanije Umuhanuzi Muhammad, aho mbere yagize uruhara rukomeye mu ntsinzi y’aba Quraysh ku rugamba rwa Uhud (625 CE). Yakwire mw’idini rya Isilamu mu mwaka wa 627 nka 629 CE, maze kuva ico gihe akoresha ubuhinga bwiwe bw’intambara mu gushigikira leta nshasha ya Isilamu. ==Igikorwa ciwe mu gisirikare n’intsinzi== Igikorwa ca Khalid kirangwa n’ubuhinga budasanzwe bwo gutera vuba no gukoresha amayeri yo gutera ubwoba abansi. Inyuma y’urupfu rwa Muhammad, yaraye imbere intambara za Ridda (intambara zo kugarura abari bava mw’idini), ahuza amashyamba ya kure y’Abarabu munsi y’Ubwami bwa Isilamu. Intsinzi ziwe zikomeye kuruta izindi zabaye mu gihe co kwigarurira Ubwami bwa Peresi (Sassanid) n’Ubwami bwa Byzantine muri Siriya. Ingamba zikomeye zirimo: * Urugamba rwa Firaz (634 CE): Intsinzi ikomeye ku ngabo zihurikiye hamwe z’aba Byzantine n’aba Sassanid. * Urugamba rwa Yarmouk (636 CE): Irufatwa nk’imwe mu ntambara zikomeye mu mateka y’isi, aho uburongozi bwa Khalid bwatumye ingabo za Byzantine zitsindwa bikomeye, bituma ingoma yabo muri Siriya ihagarara. ==Umurage n’Urupfu== Khalid ashimirwa gushinga umutwi w’ingabo z’indanyi (mubarizun) no gukoresha abasirikare bagendera ku mafarasi vuba mu kumenya no gutera aho umwansi adakomeye. Huhande y’intsinzi ziwe, Caliph Umar yaje kumukura mu mabanga kugira abantu ntibibaze ko intsinzi ziva ku muntu umwe aho kuva ku Mana. Khalid yitavye Imana mu 642 CE i Homs muri Siriya. ==Ibitabo vyakoreshejwe== # Akrām, A. I. (2004). The sword of Allah: Khalid bin al-Waleed, his life and campaigns. Maktabah. # Donner, F. M. (2014). The early Islamic conquests. Princeton University Press. # Kennedy, H. (2007). The great Arab conquests: How the spread of Islam changed the world we live in. Da Capo Press. # Nicolle, D. (1994). Yarmuk 636 AD: The Muslim conquest of Syria. Osprey Publishing.

Umar ibn al-Khattab
Umar ibn al-Khattab (c. 584–644 CE) yari we Caliph wa kabiri mu bami ba Rashidun akaba n’umwe mu bategetsi b’Abayisilamu bafise ububasha n’icubahiro gikomeye mu mateka. Kubera ko yari umugenzi wa hafi w’Umumenyeshakanda Muhammad, yimye ingoma mu mwaka wa 634 CE asubiriye Abu Bakr. Ku ngoma yiwe, ubwami bwa kiyisilamu bwaguze imbibi ku rugero rutigeze rubaho, butsinda ubwami bwa Byzantine n’ubwa Sassanid, yongera ashinga inzego z’ubutegetsi n’amategeko bishingiye ku nkingi za Isilamu. ==Ubuzima bwiwe bwa mbere n’ukwinjira muri Isilamu== Umar yavukiye mu gisagara ca Maka mu muryango w’aba Banu Adi mu rwaruka rwa Quraysh. Mu ntango, yararwanyije Isilamu bimwe bikomeye, ariko yaje guhinduka mu mwaka wa 616 CE. Ico kintu cibonekeza nk’ihinduka rikomeye ryahaye inguvu n’intege abayisilamu ba mbere. Kubera inkomezi ziwe n’ubushizi bw’amanga, yabaye umuhanuzi mukuru wa Muhammad, hanyuma aza no kuba umuhanuzi wa Caliph wa mbere, Abu Bakr. ==Ingoma yiwe n’intsinzi z’intambara== Ingoma ya Umar (634–644 CE) yaranzwe n’ukwagura intara z’abayisilamu mu buryo bwihuta cyane. Abajenerali biwe, canne cane Khalid ibn al-Walid na Amr ibn al-As, batsinze intara za Mezopotamiya, Peresiya, Misiri, Palesitina, na Siriya. Mu mwaka wa 637 CE, Umar ubwiwe yagiye muri Yeruzalemu kwakira iryo sangwa ry’ico gisagara mu mahoro, yizeza abakristu n’ibibanza vyabo vyeranda gukingirwa. ==Amavugurura mu butegetsi== Yari azwi ku zina rya Al-Faruq ("Uwutandukanya iciza n’ikibi"). Umar yari umuyobozi azi kwunganya neza ibintu. Yashizeho uburyo bwa Diwan bwo kugumya inyandiko za Leta n’uburyo bwo gufasha abanyagihugu, yongera atanguza ikirangaminsi ca Hijri. Yashizeho abacamanza (qadis) yongera akomeza inama y’abahanuzi (Shura) kugira ngo ubutegetsi bwame bugenda neza. ==Ururupfu n’iragi ryiwe== Umar yishwe mu mwaka wa 644 CE n’umushumba w’umu-Peresi yitwa Piruz Nahavandi, igihe yari ari imbere mu masengesho mu gisagara ca Madina. Yashyinguwe mu musigiti wa Al-Masjid an-Nabawi iruhande rwa Muhammad na Abu Bakr. Aracyabonwa nk’umuntu w’iteka mu idini rya Sunni kubera ubutungane bwiwe, kwubaha Imana, n’ubuzima bworoshe yabayemo. ==Reference== # Madigan, P. (2026). Umar ibn al-Khattab. In The Encyclopedia of Islamic History (Vol. 4, pp. 112–128). Academic Press. # Donner, F. M. (1981). The Early Islamic Conquests. Princeton University Press. # Hourani, A. (2013). A History of the Arab Peoples. Belknap Press.

Ikiyaga Tanganyika
Ikiyaga Tanganyika == Intangamarara == Ikiyaga Tanganyika ni kimwe mu biyaga binini kandi birimwo amazi meza biri kw’isi. Giherereye mu Buseruko bwa Afrika, kikaba gisangiwe n’ibihugu bine ari vyo: Uburundi, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, Tanzaniya na Zambiya. Ni ikiyaga gifise akamaro kanini mu buzima bw’abantu, mu butunzi, mu buhinga bwo gutwara abantu n’ibintu, no mu kubungabunga ibinyabuzima. Kizwi kandi ko kiri mu biyaga vya kera cane kw’isi, kuko abashakashatsi bavuga ko kimaze imyaka ibihumbi n’ibihumbi kibayeho, kikaba kiri mu karere kazwi nka “Great Rift Valley”. == Aho giherereye n’ukuntu kimeze: == Ikiyaga Tanganyika giherereye mu Buseruko bwa Afrika, mu kibanza citwa “Rift Valley”, ahantu hari imisozi n’imitumba vyatewe n’ihindagurika ry’isi. Gifise uburebure burenga kilometero 600 (600Km), kikaba kiri mu biyaga birebire cane kw’isi. Ubujakuzimu bwaco burenga 1400 metres, bigatuma kiba kimwe mu biyaga vyimbitse kurusha ibindi vyose biri kw’isi. Ku ruhande rw’Uburundi, Ikiyaga Tanganyika gikora ku ntara za Bujumbura Mairie, Bujumbura Rural na Rumonge, aho kibera isoko ikomeye y’ubuzima ku banyagihugu. == Amateka y’Ikiyaga Tanganyika: == Abashakashatsi bavuga ko Ikiyaga Tanganyika cabayeho kuva kera cane mu mateka y’isi, kikaba kiri mu biyaga vya kera vyahoraho kuva kera. Mu bihe vya kera, ico kiyaga cari gifise akamaro mu nzira z’ubudandaji hagati y’abanyagihugu bo mu karere kaco. Abantu bakoresheje ico kiyaga mu gutwara ibintu n’abantu bakoresheje ubwato butandukanye bw’imbaho. Mu gihe c’ubukoloni, ico kiyaga carakomeje kuba ikintu gihambaye mu bijanye n’ubwikorezi n’ubudandaji hagati y’ibihugu vyahurira kuri co. Uburebure, ubujakuzimu n’ukuntu giteye == Ikiyaga Tanganyika gifise: == Uburebure burenga 600 km Ubwaguke butandukanye bushobora kugera kuri 50–70 km Ubujakuzimu burenga 1400 m Ibi bituma kiba kimwe mu biyaga bifise amazi menshi cane kw’isi. Amazi yaco arimwo umwihariko kuko arimwo umunyu muke cane, bigatuma abenshi babona ko ari amazi meza kandi akwiye gukoreshwa mu buzima bwa buri musi. == Ibinyabuzima bibamwo: == Ikiyaga Tanganyika gifise ibinyabuzima vyinshi cane, cane cane amafi adasanzwe ataboneka ahandi kw’isi. Hari ubwoko bw’amafi burenga 300 bwemewe n’abashakashatsi, kandi bwinshi muri bwo buboneka gusa muri ico kiyaga. == Ibinyabuzima birimwo: == Amafi yo mu bwoko bwa cichlids Ingona zitandukanye Utunyabuzima two mu mazi tudashobora kuboneka ahandi Ibi bituma ico kiyaga kiba ikibanza gihambaye cane mu bijanye n’ubushakashatsi ku binyabuzima. == Akamaro k’Ikiyaga Tanganyika == === 1. Uburovyi === Ikivu Tanganyika ni isoko rikomeye y’amafi ku banyagihugu. Abantu benshi babeshwaho n’uburovyi, bakabona amafaranga n’ivyokurya bivuye kuri ico kiyaga. Amafi ava muri ico kiyaga aragurishwa mu masoko ya Bujumbura n’ahandi mu gihugu, bigatuma agira uruhara mu butunzi bw’igihugu. === 2. Ubwikorezi === Abantu bakoresha ico kiyaga mu gutembera hagati y’ibihugu bihana imbibe na co. Amato atwara abantu n’ibintu ku buryo bworoshe kandi butekanye mu bice bimwebimwe. === 3. Amazi n’ubuzima === Ikiyaga Tanganyika gifasha mu gutanga amazi akoreshwa n’abantu baba ku nkengera yaco. Naho amazi atanywa atunganijwe, agira akamaro mu bikorwa bitandukanye vy’ubuzima bwa buri musi. === 4. Ingenzi === Ikiyaga Tanganyika kirakwegakwega ba mukerarugendo benshi kubera ubwiza bwaco, imisozi igikikuje, n’ibibanza vyiza vyo kuruhukirako. Mu Burundi, ahantu nko mu Rumonge na Bujumbura harazwi kubera ubukerarugendo bushingiye kuri ico kiyaga. === 5. Ubushakashatsi === Abashakashatsi bakoresha Ikiyaga Tanganyika mu kwiga ibijanye n’ihindagurika ry’isi, ibinyabuzima, n’ukuntu amazi abaho mu biyaga binini. Akamaro mu butunzi bw’Uburundi == Mu Burundi, Ikiyaga Tanganyika gifise uruhara rukomeye mu butunzi: == Gitanga akazi ku barovyi benshi Gituma haba isoko ry’amafi i Bujumbura n’ahandi Gishigikira ubucuruzi buciriritse n’ubunini Giteza imbere ubukerarugendo Giteza imbere ubwikorezi bwo mu mazi == Ingorane zihari == == Naho gifise akamaro kanini, Ikiya Tanganyika kirafise ingorane zitandukanye: == === 1. Uburovyi bw'indenza rugero === Abantu bariko bararoba amafi menshi cane, bigatuma amafi amwe amwe agabanuka. === 2. Ukwandura kw’amazi === Imyanda iva mu bisagara n’amahinguriro ishobora kwanduza ico kiyaga. === 3. Ihindagurika ry’ibihe === Ihinduka ry’ibihe rishobora kugira ico rihinduye ku buzima bw’amafi n’urugero rw’amazi. === 4. Gukoresha uburyo budakwiye bwo kuroba === Hari abakoresha imitego itemewe, bikonona ibinyabuzima. Ingene gikingirwa Hafashwe ingingo zitandukanye mu gukingira ikiyaga Tanganyika: Gushiraho amategeko agenga uburovyi Kurwanya kwanduza amazi Gukangurira abanyagihugu kubungabunga ibidukikije Gushigikira uburovyi burama (sustainable fishing) Akamaro kaco mu buzima bw’abanyagihugu == Abantu benshi baba ku nkengera y’ico kiyaga babeshwaho na co ku musi ku musi. Gitanga: == Ibiribwa (amafi) Akazi Ubucuruzi Amahoro y’ubuzima kubera ibidukikije vyiza == Muncamake == Ikiyaga Tanganyika ni kimwe mu biyaga bikuru vy’isi gifise akamaro kanini mu buzima bw’abantu, mu butunzi no mu binyabuzima. Kukibungabunga ni igikorwa ca bose kugira ngo kizogume kibera isoko ry’ubuzima ku bihugu bigihana imbibe no ku bisekuru bizovuka.

Uruzi Nyabukongoro
URUZI NYABUKONGORO: == AMATEKA, AKAMARO N’URUHARE RWARWO MU BUZIMA BW’ABANYA MURAMVYA == Uruzi rwa Nyabukongoro ni rumwe mu migezi mito ariko ifise akamaro kanini mu buzima bw’abantu n’ibidukikije vyo mu ntara ya Muramvya mu Burundi. Uru ruzi ruzwi cane mu mateka y’aho ruherereye, mu mibereho y’abanyagihugu, no mu gutuma isindimwa buguma bwiyongera kubera amazi yarwo atembera mu misozi itandukanye. == 1. AHO URUZI NYABUKONGORO RUHEREREYE N’UKO RUGENDA == Uruzi rwa Nyabukongoro ruca mu misozi myiza y’intara ya Muramvya. Ruraca mu bice bitandukanye birimwo: Umusozi wa Remera Umusozi wa Murambi Umusozi wa Muramvya Umusozi wa Musagara Umusozi wa Masango Ayo matongo y’imisozi arangwa n’uburimyi n’imvura nyinshi igafasha uruzi kuguma rufise amazi mu bihe vyinshi vy’umwaka. Uruzi Nyabukongoro ruvuka mu misozi mito, rukagenda ruterera mu bice bitandukanye, rugakomeza rujana amazi yarwo mu bindi bice. Mu nyuma, amazi yarwo yisuka mu rundi ruzi runini bita Mucece, aho amazi yarwo akomeza urugendo rwerekeza mu yindi migezi minini y’igihugu. == 2. AKAMARO K’URUZI NYABUKONGORO == Uruzi Nyabukongoro rufise akamaro kanini mu buzima bwa buri munsi bw’abanyagihugu baba hafi yarwo. === a) Amazi ni ubuzima bwa buri munsi === Abantu baba mu bice rucamwo barukoresha mu bikorwa bitandukanye vya buri munsi nko: Kumesa impuzu n’ibikoresho Kuvomera ibitungwa Gukoresha mu mirimo yo murugo Amazi yarwo, iyo ayunguruwe neza, ashobora no gukoreshwa mu kunywa. === b) Uburimyi === Uruzi Nyabukongoro ni isôko rikomeye ry’amazi afasha uburimyi. Abarimyi barukoresha mu: Kuvomera imirima y’ibigori, ibiharage, imboga n’ibindi birimwa Gutuma isi ndimwa iguma imeze neza Gufasha ibiterwa gukura neza mu bihe vy’izuba === c) Ibidukikije n’ibinyabuzima === Ku nkengero z’uruzi Nyabukongoro habamwo ibiti n’ibimera bitandukanye bifasha: Kwirinda inkukura Gutuma amazi aguma asukuye Gutunga ibikoko vyo mu mazi nk’amafi n’utundi tunyabuzima == 3. URUHARE RW’URUZI MURI KAHISE == Muri kahise k'aho ruherereye, uruzi rwa Nyabukongoro rwari rufise n’akamaro kadasanzwe mu buzima bw’imico n'imigenzo y'ubwami. Hari inkuru z’abasokuru zemeza ko kera, inka z’umwami zajayo kunywa amazi y’uruzi rwa Nyabukongoro. Ibi vyerekana ko uru ruzi rwari rufise agaciro kanini, atari ku banyagihugu gusa, ariko no ku muryango w’ubwami. Uruzi rwari rufatwa nk’ahantu heza, hasukuye kandi hafise amazi meza y’ibitungwa y’agaciro nk’inka z’umwami. Ibi bituma Nyabukongoro ruba uruzi rufise n’agaciro k’umuco n’amateka, si amazi gusa ahubwo n’inkomoko y’ivyari bihambaye mu buzima bwa kera. == 4. IBIBAZO URUZI RUSHOBORA GUHURA NAVYO == Naho rufise akamaro kanini, uruzi Nyabukongoro rushobora guhura n’ibibazo bitandukanye: Isuri iterwa no gucibwa kw’amashamba ku nkengero zarwo Ukwandura kw’amazi kubera imyanda canke ibikorwa vy’abantu Kurimira hafi cane y’uruzi bigatuma inzira yarwo ihinduka Imyuzure mu bihe vy’imvura nyinshi Ibi bibazo bishobora gutuma uruzi rudakora neza nk’uko bikwiye. == 5. UKO URUZI RWOKINGIRWA == Kugira ngo uruzi rwa Nyabukongoro rukomeze gufasha abantu n’ibidukikije, hari ingingo zikwiye gufatwa: Gutera ibiti ku nkengera zarwo Kwirinda guta imyanda mu mazi Kwirinda kurima cane hafi y’uruzi Gukingira amasoko y’amazi avamwo uruzi Gukangurira abanyagihugu kurukingira == GUSOZERA == Uruzi rwa Nyabukongoro ni itunga kavukire rifise akamaro kanini mu buzima bw’abantu b'i Muramvya. Ruca mu misozi ya Remera, Murambi, Muramvya, Musagara na Masango, hanyuma rukisuka mu ruzi rwa Mucece. Rufise uruhare runini mu burimyi, mu buzima bwa buri munsi, no mu muco w’aho ruherereye, aho kera n’inka z’umwami zajayo kunywa amazi. Gukingira uruzi rwa Nyabukongoro ni gukingira ubuzima, uburimyi n’iterambere rya kazoza.

Amazi mu Mahinguriro
Amazi mu Mahinguriro (Industrial Water) Intangamarara Amazi ni kimwe mu bintu vy'ingirakamaro cane mu buzima bw’abantu n’iterambere ry’ubutunzi. Mu mahinguriro (Industrie), akoreshwa mu bikorwa bitandukanye nko gukora ibicuruzwa, gukonjesha imashini, gusukura ibikoresho, no gutunganya ibinyobwa n’ibifungurwa. Uko amahinguriro agenda ziyongera kw’isi, niko ikoreshwa ry’amazi rigenda ryiyongera, bigatera igitutu ku mazi meza n’ibidukikije.[1] Ikoreshwa ry’amazi mu mahinguriro Mu Mahinguriro, amazi akoreshwa mu bikorwa bikurikira: Gukonjesha imashini (cooling systems)[2] Gusukura ibikoresho n’ahakorerwa Gukora ibinyobwa n’ibifungurwa Gutanga ubushuhe (steam generation) Gutunganya ibikoresho vya chimie Ubwoko bw’amazi mu mahinguriro Amazi akoreshwa mu mahinguriro agabanywa uku: Amazi akoreshwa mu mahinguriro agabanywa uku: Amazi meza (process water) Amazi y’amahinguriro (industrial water) Amazi y’imyanda (wastewater)[3] Ingaruka z’amazi y’imyanda Iyo amazi y’amahinguriro atatunganijwe neza ashobora: Kwanduza inzuzi n’ibiyaga Kwonona ibinyabuzima vyo mu mazi Guteza indwara ku bantu Kwanduza isi ndimwa n’amazi yo kunywa Kugabanya ubuziranenge bw’ibidukikije[4] Uko amazi atunganywa Amazi y’imyanda atunganywa hakoreshejwe: Kuyungurura (filtration) Imiti isukura (chemical treatment) Uburyo bw’ibinyabuzima (biological treatment) Ibitegwa bimwebimwe (treatment plants)[5] Akarorero k’u Burundi Mu Burundi, amazi akoreshwa cane mu mumahinguriro y’ibinyobwa n’ayandi mahinguriro ari mu bisagara binini nka Bujumbura. Hari intambwe igenda ifatwa mu gutunganya amazi y’imyanda no kuyasubiza mu bidukikije mu buryo butekanye, cane cane mu kurinda: Ikibanza c’amazi c’Ikidengeri Tanganyika Inzuzi zifatiye ku buzima bw’abantu Ubuzima bw’abanyagihugu baba hafi y’amahinguriro Ibiharuro (Statistics) Ubushakashatsi mpuzamakungu bwerekana ko: Hafi ya 80% y’amazi y’imyanda kw’isi yose asubira mu bidukikije atatunganijwe neza[4] Amahinguriro atwara hafi ya 20% y’amazi meza akoreshwa kw’isi[2] Mu bihugu biri mu nzira y’amajambere, igice kinini c’amazi y’amahinguriro ntigitunganywa uko bikwiye[1] Ibi birerekana ko ikibazo c’amazi y’amahinguriro ari ikibazo c’isi yose gisaba inyishu zihuse. Akamaro ko gutunganya amazi Gukingira ubuzima bw’abantu Gukingira ibidukikije Kugabanya iyononekara ry’amazi Guteza imbere iterambere rusangi (sustainable development)[5] Inyishu zishoboka Gushiraho amategeko akomeye agenga amahinguriro Gukoresha ubuhinga bugezweho bwo gutunganya amazi Gusubira gukoresha amazi (water recycling) Kugabanya imiti ihumanya Kwigisha abakozi ku kamaro k’isuku y’amazi INCAMAKE NO GUSOZERA Amazi mu mahinguriro ni ishingiro ry’iterambere ry’ubutunzi, ariko kandi ni isoko rikomeye ry’ihumana ry’ibidukikije iyo atakoreshejwe neza. Mu gihe isi iriko irondera iterambere riramba, ni ngombwa ko amahinguriro yose ashira imbere uburyo bwo gutunganya no gusubira gukoresha amazi.[5] Gukingira amazi si itegeko ry’amahinguriro gusa, ahubwo ni iya bose: leta, abikorera, n’abanyagihugu. Muri kazoza hasukuye haterwa n’ingingo dufata uyu musi. Amazi: Soko ry'ubuzima muri Afurika
Amazi: Soko ry'Ubuzima muri Afurika Intangamarara Amazi ni umutungo karemano w'agaciro kanini kandi afise uruhara ntangere mu buzima bw'ibinyabuzima vyose. Nta muntu, igikoko canke igiterwa gishobora kubaho igihe kirekire kidafise amazi. Muri Afurika, amazi ni ishingiro ry'iterambere ry'ubutunzi, imibano n'ibidukikije. Akoreshwa mu kunywa, mu burimyi, mu bworozi, mu mahinguriro, mu gutwara abantu n'ibintu hamwe no mu gutanga umuyagankuba. N'ubwo umugabane wa Afurika ufise ibiyaga binini, inzuzi nyinshi n'amasoko atandukanye y'amazi, abantu benshi baracafise ikibazo co kutaronka amazi meza kandi ahagije. Kubera iyo mpamvu, amazi afatwa nk'itunga rikwiye kubungabungwa kugira rishobore gufasha iterambere rirama ry'ibihugu vya Afurika. Kahise k'Akamaro k'Amazi muri Afurika Kuva kera, abantu bo muri Afurika bubatse ubuzima bwabo hafi y'amasoko y'amazi. Imiji myinshi ya kera yubatswe ku nkengera z'inzuzi n'ibiyaga kugira abantu bashobore kuronka amazi yo kunywa no gukora ibikorwa vyabo vya minsi yose. Mu Misiri ya kera, Uruzi Nil rwabaye inkingi y'iterambere ry'ubwami bw'Abanyamisiri. Amazi yarwo yarafasha mu kuvomera imirima no gutuma habaho umwimbu mwinshi ndetse uhagije. No mu bindi bice vya Afurika, inzuzi nka Congo, Niger na Zambezi zarafashije abantu guteza imbere uburimyi, ubworozi n'ubudandaji. Amasoko y'Amazi muri Afurika Afurika ifise amasoko menshi y'amazi arimwo: Inzuzi Umugabane wa Afurika urimwo inzuzi zikomeye cane ku rwego rw'isi, harimwo: \- Uruzi Nil, rufatwa nk'ururerure kuruta izindi nzuzi zo kw'isi. \- Uruzi Congo, rufise amazi menshi cane muri Afurika. \- Uruzi Niger. \- Uruzi Zambezi. \- Uruzi Limpopo. Izo nzuzi zifasha mu burimyi, ubworozi, uburovyi, gutwara abantu n'ibintu hamwe no mu gutanga umuyagankuba. Ibiyaga Afurika irafise ibiyaga binini birimwo: \- Ikiyaga Victoria. \- Ikiyaga Tanganyika. \- Ikiyaga Malawi. \- Ikiyaga Turkana. Ivyo biyaga ni amasoko y'amazi meza, uburovyi n'ubukerarugendo (kwakira ingenzi). Amazi yo mu kuzimu Mu turere twinshi twumagaye, abantu bifashisha amariba n'amasoko y'amazi yo mu kuzimu kugira baronke amazi yo kunywa no gukoresha mu buzima bwa minsi yose. Akamaro k'Amazi mu Buzima bw'Abantu Amazi ni ngirakamaro ku magara y'abantu. Umubiri w'umuntu ugizwe ahanini n'amazi, kandi uyakenera kugira ukore neza. Amazi afasha: \- Gutwara intungamubiri mu mubiri. \- Kugenzura ubushuhe bw'umubiri. \- Gukuraho imyanda iva mu mubiri. \- Gukingira indwara ziterwa n'isuku rike. Kubura amazi meza birashobora gutera indwara zitandukanye nka kolera, tifoyide n'indwara zo gucibwamwo. Akamaro k'Amazi mu Burimyi Uburimyi ni umwe mu miryango y'ubutunzi ikomeye muri Afurika. Abantu benshi babeshwaho n'uburimyi. Amazi afasha mu: \- Kuvomera imirima. \- Kongera umwimbu. \- Kugabanya ingaruka z'ukwuma. \- Guteza imbere uburimyi bwa kijambere. Mu bihugu vyinshi vya Afurika, imigambi yo kuvomera imirima iriko iratezwa imbere kugira haboneke ibifungurwa bihagije. Akamaro k'Amazi mu Bworozi Ubworozi bushingiye cane ku mazi. Inka, impene, intama n'ibindi bikoko bikenera amazi kugira bibeho kandi bitange umwimbu mwiza. Mu turere tw'ibahari n'ubugaragwa, ukuronka amazi ku bitungwa ni kimwe mu bibazo bikomeye vyugarije aborozi. Amazi n'Iterambere ry'Ubutunzi Amazi afise uruhara runini mu guteza imbere ubutunzi bw'ibihugu vya Afurika. Amahinguriro Amazi akoreshwa mu: \- Gutunganya ibifungurwa. \- Gukora ibinyobwa. \- Gukonjesha imashini. \- Gusukura ibikoresho. Amahinguriro menshi ntiyoshobora gukora neza ata mazi ahagije afise. Ubukerarugendo (kwakira ingenzi) Ibiyaga, amasumo n'inzuzi bikwega ingenzi ziva hirya no hino kw'isi. Nk'akarorero, amasumo ya Victoria ari hagati ya Zambia na Zimbabwe ni kimwe mu bibanza bikwega ingenzi nyinshi muri Afurika. Umuyagankuba Amazi akoreshwa mu gutanga umuyagankuba biciye ku ngomero zubatswe ku nzuzi. Ivyo bifasha mu guteza imbere amahinguriro, amashure, amavuriro n'ibikorwa vy'ubudandaji. Amazi n'Ihindagurika ry'Ibihe Ihindagurika ry'ibihe ririko riragira ingaruka zikomeye ku masoko y'amazi muri Afurika. Mu bice bimwe, haribonekeza ukwuma gukomeye, mu bindi bice hakaboneka imyuzure ikomeye. Izo ngaruka zishobora: \- Kugabanya umwimbu w'ibiterwa. \- Gutuma ibikoko bipfa kubera ubukene bw'amazi. \- Kwonona ibikorwa vy'iterambere ry'abayagihugu. \- Guteza ibura canke ubukene bw'ibiribwa. Ingorane zijanye n'Amazi muri Afurika N'ubwo Afurika ifise amazi menshi, haracari ingorane nyinshi zirimwo: \- Ukutaronka amazi meza yo kunywa. \- Iyanduza ry'inzuzi n'ibiyaga. \- Ukwiyongera kw'abantu. \- Ihindagurika ry'ibihe. \- Ibikorwa vy'iterambere ry'abanyagihugu bidahagije. \- Ugusesagura amazi. Mu bice bimwe vya Afurika yo munsi y'Ubugaragwa bwa Sahara, abagore n'abana bakora urugendo rurerure buri musi baja kuvoma amazi. Uburyo bwo Kubungabunga Amazi Kubungabunga amazi ni ngombwa kugira ibisekuru vy'ubu n'ivy'ejo bishobore kuyaronka. Bimwe mu vyokorwa ni: \- Gukingira amasoko y'amazi. \- Gutera ibiti no kubungabunga amashamba. \- Kwirinda kwanduza inzuzi n'ibiyaga. \- Gukoresha amazi neza. \- Kwubaka ibikorwa vy'iterambere vy'amazi. \- Guteza imbere uburezi ku bijanye no kubungabunga ibidukikije. Incamake no Gusozera Amazi ni soko ry'ubuzima muri Afurika kandi afise uruhara runini mu buzima bw'abantu, uburimyi, ubworozi, ubutunzi n'ibidukikije. N'ubwo umugabane wa Afurika ufise umutungo munini w'amazi, haracari ibibazo vy'ukutayaronka neza no kutayakoresha mu buryo bubereye. Kubungabunga amazi no kuyacungera neza ni imwe mu nzira zihambaye zoshobora gufasha Afurika gushika ku majambere y'ukuri no ku mibereho myiza y'abayibamwo.

Ikoreshwa ry'amazi mu Mahinguriro
== Intangamarara == Amazi ni kimwe mu bikoresho nyamukuru bikoreshwa mu buzima bwa buri muntu wese no mw'interambere ry’isi yose. Mu mahinguriro (industries), amazi mu Mahinguriro afise akamaro kanini cane gose kuko afasha mu bikorwa bitandukanye birimwo gukora ibidandazwa, gukonjesha amamashini, gusukura ibikoresho no gutanga inguvu nk'umuyagankuba zikoreshwa mu bikorwa bimwe bimwe. Mu gihe iterambere ry’amahinguriro rikomeza kwiyongera, n’ikoreshwa ry’amazi naryo riragenda ryiyongera cane, ivyo bigatuma hakenerwa imigambi yo kuyabungabunga no kuyakoresha neza mugihugu. == Kahise k’ikoreshwa ry’amazi mu mahinguriro == Kuva kera, amazi yarafashije abantu mu bikorwa vy’ubushakashatsi bitandukanye. Mu bihe vya kera, yarakoreshwa mu gusya ibintu hakoreshejwe inguvu z’amazi (water mills). Mu gihe c’ihinduka ry’amahinguriro (Industrial Revolution) ryo mu kinjana ca 18, amazi yabaye isoko nyamukuru ry’inguvu mu gukoresha amamashini y’amahinguriro. Mu kinjana ca 20 no mu ca 21, ikoreshwa ry’amazi ryaraguwe n’iterambere ry’ubuhinga, aho amazi atagikoreshwa gusa nk’inguvu, ahubwo anakoreshwa mu gutunganya ibinyobwa, imiti, impuzu, n’ibindi bicuruzwa bitandukanye. == Akamaro k’amazi mu mahinguriro == === Amazi afise uruhara runini mu mahinguriro: === Gutunganya ibicuruzwa: amazi ni ikintu nyamukuru mu gukora ibinyobwa, ibifungurwa n’imiti. Gukonjesha amamashini: afasha kugabanya ubushuhe bwinshi mu mamashini akora, bigakinga kwononekara. Gusukura ibikoresho: amazi akoreshwa mu gusukura imashini n’ahakorera ibikorwa kugira habe isuku. Gukora umwuka canke umuhisha ushushe (vapeur): ukoreshwa mu gutanga inguvu mu mahinguriro amwe amwe. Gutwara no gutandukanya ibintu: mu mahinguriro amwe, amazi afasha gutwara canke gutandukanya ibikoresho mu nzira y’ikorwa. == Ubwoko bw’amahinguriro akoresha amazi menshi == === Hari amwamwe mu mahinguriro akenera amazi menshi kurusha ayandi: === Amahinguriro y’ibinyobwa: nk’ay’ukora inzoga n’imitobe. Amahinguriro y’ibifungurwa: guteka, gusukura no gutunganya ibifungurwa. Amahinguriro y’impuzu (textile industry): akoreshwa mu gusiga amarangi no gusukura impuzu. Amahinguriro y’imiti: amazi akoreshwa mu kuvanga no gutunganya imiti. Amahinguriro y’inguvu (ingomero): aho amazi akoreshwa mu gukora umuyagankubai (hydroelectric power). Mu Burundi, akarorero keza ni BRARUDI, aho amazi ari ikintu nyamukuru mu gukora ibinyobwa bitandukanye. == Ikoreshwa ry’amazi mu mahinguriro yo mu Burundi == Mu Burundi, amahinguriro akoresha amazi mu bikorwa bitandukanye, cane cane mu gukora ibinyobwa, mu gutunganya ibifungurwa, no mu bikorwa bisaba inguvu. Ariko igihugu kiracafise ikibazo co kubura amazi meza ahagije n’ukubungabunga amazi asanzwe akoreshwa. Uko ubutunzi n’iterambere ry’amahinguriro bimeze birerekana ko hakenewe imigambi ikomeye yo gukingira amazi no kuyakoresha neza kugira ngo iterambere ribandanye ritabangamiye ndetse n'ibidukikije navyonyene bitabangamiwe. === Ingaruka z’ikoreshwa nabi ry’amazi === Naho amazi ari ngirakamaro, kuyakoresha nabi mu mahinguriro birashobora guteza ibibazo bikomeye: Kwanduza inzuzi n’ibiyaga kubera amazi yanduye ava mu mahinguriro. Kugabanuka kw’amazi meza abantu bakoresha. Kwangirika kw’ibinyabuzima vyo mu mazi (fish, plants). Ingorane z’ubuzima ku bantu baba hafi y’amahinguriro. Imiryango mpuzamakungu nka United Nations irahimiriza ibihugu gukoresha neza amazi no kurinda ibidukikije. Gutunganya amazi yanduye Amahinguriro agezweho akoresha uburyo bwo gutunganya amazi yanduye imbere yo kuyasubiza mu bidukikije. Ivyo birimwo: Kuyungurura amazi (filtration) Kuyasukura hakoreshejwe imiti (chemical treatment) Kuyakonjesha canke kuyapima ubuziranenge Gusubira kuyakoresha mu bikorwa bidahambaye (recycling) Ibi bifasha kugabanya ihumana ry’ibidukikije no kuziganya amazi. Uburyo bwo kubungabunga amazi Kugira amazi agume ahari ku b’igihe kirekire, hakenewe ingamba zikurikira: Kugabanya ikoreshwa ry’amazi adakenewe. Gusubira gukoresha amazi amaze gutunganywa. Gukoresha ubuhinga bugezweho bwo kuziganya amazi. Gusana aho amazi aseseka mu mahinguriro. Guhugura abakozi ku kamaro ko kuziganya amazi. Ibitigiri n’amakuru ngirakamaro Nk’uko amakuru atangwa n’imiryango mpuzamakungu nka UNESCO abivuga, inganda zikoresha hafi 20% y’amazi akoreshwa kw’isi, kandi iyi namba iriko iriyongera uko inganda zigenda ziterambere. == Incamake == Amazi ni itunga rikomeye cane mu mahinguriro kuko afasha mu bikorwa vyinshi vy’iterambere ry’ubutunzi. Ariko kubera ko atari menshi kandi atagira uko yiyongera vuba, ni ngombwa kuyakoresha neza no kuyabungabunga. Ibi bizotuma haba iterambere rirama ridahungabanya ibidukikije n’ubuzima bw’abantu. == References == UNESCO Water Reports United Nations Water Programme (UN-Water) Industrial water use studies (global environmental reports) World Bank environmental data on water usage in industries

Kumesura impuzu
== Intangamarara == Kumesura impuzu ni igikorwa co gusukura imyambaro n’inyambaro z’abantu hakoreshejwe amazi, isabune canke ibindi bisukura (detergent), kugira ngo hakurweho umwanda, ibizinga, impumuro mbi n’umukungugu. Iki gikorwa ni kimwe mu bikenewe mu buzima bwa minsi yose kuko gifasha kugumya isuku, ubuzima bwiza no kwirinda indwara ziva ku mwanda. Akamaro k’ukumesura impuzu Kumesura impuzu bifise akamaro kanini mu buzima bwa muntu. Bifasha kwirinda indwara nk’uruhu rurwaye (infection), inyo n’izindi ndwara zishobora guterwa n’umwanda. Vyongeye, impuzu zisukuye zituma umuntu agaragara neza kandi akagira isuku ihimbaye mu bantu. Mu mashure, ku kazi no mu buzima busanzwe, isuku y’impuzu ifasha mu gutanga ishusho nziza y’umuntu. Ibikoresho bikenerwa mu kumesura impuzu Mu kumesura impuzu hakoreshwa ibikoresho bitandukanye birimwo:amazi Amazi meza Isabune canke detergent Indobo canke ikidendezi Umuyonga wo kumesura (ku mpuzu zimwe zimwe) Ahantu ho kumanika impuzu Mu gihe c’ubu, hari n’imashini zo kumesura (washing machines) zifasha abantu gukora iki gikorwa mu buryo bworoshe kandi bwihuta. Uko kumesura impuzu bikorwa Igikorwa co kumesura impuzu gikorwa mu ntambwe zikurikira: Gutandukanya impuzu: Impuzu ziratandukanywa hakurikijwe ibara (umweru n’amabara) n’ubwoko bw’umwenda kugira ntizononeke. Kunyika impuzu: Zishirwa mu mazi kugira zireke umwanda n’ibizinga. Gusiga isabune: Isabune canke detergent ishirwa ku mpuzu, hakibandwa ku bibanza bifise umwanda mwinshi. Gukaraba: Impuzu zirakubagurwa canke zikarabishwa mu mazi kugira umwanda uveho. Kwoza: Impuzu zozwa mu mazi meza kugira isabune yose ivemwo. Kuzikamura: Amazi arakamurwa mu mpuzu mu buryo bwitondewe kugira ntizikononeke. Kuzumisha: Impuzu zimanikwa ku zuba canke ahantu hari umuyaga kugira zikame neza. Ubwoko bw’ukumesura impuzu Hariho uburyo bubiri nyamukuru bwo kumesura impuzu: Kumesura n’amaboko: Ubu ni bwo buryo bwa kera aho umuntu akoresha amaboko n’ibikoresho vyoroshe. Kumesura n’imashini: Ubu buryo bugezweho bukoresha imashini yo kumesura, bugafasha kuzigama umwanya n’inkomezi. Inzitizi mu kumesura impuzu Mu bihugu bimwe bimwe, abantu bashobora guhura n’ingorane nk’ukubura amazi meza, kubura isabune ihagije, canke umwanya muto wo gukora kumesura. Hari kandi n’igihe imvura ituma kumisha impuzu bigorana. Incamake Kumesura impuzu ni igikorwa nyamukuru mu buzima bwa minsi yose gifasha mu kugumana isuku n’ubuzima bwiza. Ni ngombwa ko abantu bose bamenya uburyo bwiza bwo kumesura kugira ngo barinde impuzu zabo kandi bagumane isuku ihamye mu buzima bwabo bwa buri musi.

Uruzi rwa Kanyosha
= Uruzi rwa Kanyosha = Uruzi rwa Kanyosha ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye zo mu gisagara ca Bujumbura no mu ntara ya Bujumbura mu gihugu c'Uburundi. Rurengana ruva mu bumanuko bw'igisagara ca Bujumbura maze rugasuka amazi yarwo mu Kiyaga Tanganyika. Uru ruzi rufise akamaro kanini mu buzima bw'abanyagisagara, mu bidukikije no mu bikorwa vy'iterambere. Ariko kandi, rwagiye ruhura n'ingorane zitandukanye zijanye n'isuri (inkukura), ugusenyuka kw'inkombe zarwo hamwe n'imyuzure iterwa n'imvura nyinshi. == Intangamarara == Uruzi rwa Kanyosha ni kimwe mu bikorwa vy'akamere biranga akarere ka Bujumbura. Rukaba ruva mu misozi yo hagati mu ntara ya Bujumbura, hanyuma rugatembera mu bice bitandukanye vy'igisagara ca Bujumbura mbere yo gushika mu Kiyaga Tanganyika. Mu myaka iheze, uru ruzi rwabaye ikintu c'inyigisho ku bahinga mu bidukikije kubera uruhara rwarwo mu gutwara amazi no mu guhangana n'ingaruka z'ihindagurika ry'ibihe. == Ibijanye n'ubutaka n'aho ruherereye == Inkomoko y'Uruzi rwa Kanyosha iri mu misozi yo hagati ya Bujumbura. Rurengana mu bice vya Buhonga, Muha na Kanyosha, hanyuma rugasukira mu Kiyaga Tanganyika ku ruhande rw'uburengero bwaco. Ahantu haca uru ruzi hari imitumba itandukanye, kuva ku misozi miremire gushika ku nkengera z'ikiyaga. Igice kinini c'akarere k'uru ruzi kigizwe n'imisozi ihanamye, ivyo bikaba bishobora gutuma haba isuri (inkukurea) igihe imvura iguye ari nyinshi. Abahinga bagaragaje bongera baremeza kandi ko hari ibice bishobora gushikirwa n'isenyuka ry'imisozi (glissements de terrain), cane cane aho ibikorwa vy'uburimyi n'ubwubatsi bikorwa ata buryo bwo gukingira isindimwa. == Akamaro k'Uruzi rwa Kanyosha == Uruzi rwa Kanyosha rufise akamaro mu buryo bwinshi: Rufasha mu gutwara amazi ava mu misozi ayaja mu Kiyaga Tanganyika. Ni kimwe mu bice vy'ibinyabuzima bifasha kubungabunga ibidukikije vyo muri Bujumbura. Amazi yarwo arakoreshwa mu bikorwa bitandukanye vy'uburimyi n'ubworozi mu bice bimwe bimwe. Rufasha mu gutuma isi ndimwa imera neza mu biyaya rucamwo. Ikiraro c'abanyamaguru kimanitse cubatswe hejuru yarwo mu 2021 carafashije kworohereza uruja n'uruza rw'abanyagihugu hagati ya Busoro na Kinanira. == Ingorane zihari == Naho rufise akamaro kanini, Uruzi rwa Kanyosha ruhura n'ingorane nyishi zitandukanye. Mu gisagara ca Bujumbura, inkombe zarwo zaragiye zisiduka mu bihe bitandukanye, zigasenyura amazu no guteza ubwoba abahaba. Gucukura canke kwimba umusenyi, amabuye n'amagaraviya bidaciye mu mategeko vyatumye inkukura yiyongera mu bice bimwe bimwe. Imyuzure iterwa n'imvura nyinshi hamwe n'ukwiyongera kw'amazi y'Ikiyaga Tanganyika na vyo nyene vyarabonetse ko bishobora gutuma uru ruzi rurenza urugero rw'amazi rusanzwe rutwara, ivyo bikabangamira ibikorwa vy'abanyagihugu. == Kubungabunga uru ruzi == Leta y'Uburundi hamwe n'inzego zitandukanye zagiye zishira mu ngiro imigambi yo gukingira inkombe z'uru ruzi. Muri iyo migambi harimwo gutera ibiti ku nkengera zarwo, kubaka ibikingirizo vy'inkukura no kugenzura ibikorwa vyo gukura ibikoresho vy'ubwubatsi mu ruzi. Ivyo bikorwa bigamije kugabanya ingaruka z'inkukura no kubungabunga ibidukikije vy'akarere. == Raba kandi == Kiyaga Tanganyika Bujumbura Uruzi rwa Mubarazi Urutonde rw'inzuzi z'Uburundi == Ivyanditswe vyifashishijwe == References Kubwimana, A., AIT Brahim, L., Bousta, M. & Dewitte, O. (2018). Landslides susceptibility assessment using AHP method in Kanyosha watershed (Bujumbura-Burundi). MATEC Web of Conferences. "Kanyosha River", English Wikipedia. Office Burundais de l'Urbanisme, de l'Habitat et de la Construction (OBUHA), raporo ku nzuzi zo mu gisagara ca Bujumbura.

Uruzi rwa Mugere
== Intangamarara == Uruzi rwa Mugere ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye zo mu burengerazuba bw'Uburundi. Ruherereye mu ntara ya Bujumbura Rural, rugaca mu misozi yegereye Ikiyaga Tanganyika mbere yo kwisuka muri ico kiyaga. Uru ruzi rurazwi cane kubera isumo rya Mugere, rimwe mu bibanza bikurura ba mukerarugendo (ingenzi) benshi mu Burundi. Uruzi rwa Mugere rufise uruhara runini mu kubungabunga ibidukikije, mu guteza imbere uburimyi no mu gutanga amazi akoreshwa n'abanyagihugu bo mu micungararo yarwo. == Inkomoko n'Inzira y'Uruzi == Uruzi rwa Mugere rutangurira mu misozi miremire iri mu bumanuko bw'igisagara ca Bujumbura. Amazi yarwo akomoka ku mvura igwa muri ako karere no ku masoko atandukanye ava mu misozi ya Congo-Nile Divide. Mu rugendo rwarwo, uru ruzi rucamwo ibiyaya n'imisozi myinshi, rugakora ahantu h'ubwiza karemano bwinshi mbere yo gushika ku Kiyaga Tanganyika. Inzira y'uru ruzi irangwa n'ubumanuko butandukanye butuma amazi yarwo yihuta cane mu bice bimwebimwe, ivyo bikaba vyaratumye havuka amasumo n'ibibanza vyiza bikwega ingenzi. == Isumo rya Mugere == Kimwe mu bice bizwi cane vy'Uruzi rwa Mugere ni Isumo rya Mugere, riri hafi y'igisagara ca Bujumbura. Iri sumo rifise uburebure bunini kandi amazi yarwo amanuka ava ku rutare runini, agatanga ahantu hakaranga hakundwa n'abashitsi n'abakunda ibidukikije. Hari inkuru zivuga ko umusomyi n'umushakashatsi w'umudagi Richard Kandt yigeze kugendera ako karere mu ntango z'ikinjana ca 20, bigatuma Isumo rya Mugere riba kimwe mu bibanza vy'amateka n'ukwakira ingenzi mu Burundi. == Akamaro k'Uruzi rwa Mugere == === Amazi y'Abanyagihugu === Uruzi rwa Mugere rutanga amazi akoreshwa n'abanyagihugu mu bikorwa vya minsi yose birimwo kunywa, guteka, kwiyuhagira no kuvomerera imirima. === Ubworozi n'Ubworozi bw'Amafi === Ababa hafi y'uru ruzi barukoresha mu kuvomera ibitungwa no mu bikorwa bijanye n'ubworozi bw'amafi mu bibanza bimwebimwe. === Ukwakira ingenzi === Kubera Isumo rya Mugere n'ubwiza bw'ibidukikije birukikije, uru ruzi rufise uruhara runini mu guteza imbere ubukerarugendo (kwakira ingenzi). Ba mukerarugendo baratemberera ako karere kugira bihweze amasumo, ibimera n'ibibonekaho nk'inyoni n'ibindi binyabuzima. === Ubuhinga bw'Ubuhinzi === Amazi y'uru ruzi afasha mu kuvomerera imirima, cane cane mu bihe vy'izuba. Ivyo bituma umwimbu w'ibiterwa wiyongera cane kandi bigafasha mu kurwanya ubukene bw'ibiribwa. == Ibidukikije n'Ibibazo Bihari == Nk'izindi nzuzi nyinshi zo mu Burundi, Uruzi rwa Mugere rurashobora guterwa n'ingorane z'inkukura iterwa n'ikorwa ry'uburimyi ku misozi ihanamye, ugutemwa kw'amashamba hamwe n'ihindagurika ry'ibihe. Inkukura ituma isindimwa n'amabuye bitwarwa n'amazi bikaja mu ruzi, bikagabanya ubwiza bw'amazi kandi bikagira ingaruka ku binyabuzima biharangwa. Kubungabunga ibidukikije vyo muri ako karere ni kimwe mu bintu bihambaye kugirango uru ruzi rukomeze gutanga akamaro karwo ku bantu no ku bidukikije. == Akamaro mu Mico n'Amateka == Uruzi rwa Mugere n'Isumo ryarwo bifise ikibanza kidasanzwe mu mico no mu mateka y'Uburundi. Mu myaka myinshi iheze, ako karere karabaye ahantu hagenderwa n'abashakashatsi, abanyeshure n'ingenzi bifuza kumenya ibijanye n'imiterere y'igihugu c'Uburundi. == Raba kandi == * Ikiyaga Tanganyika * Uruzi rwa Kanyosha * Uruzi rwa Rusizi * Ubukerarugendo mu Burundi == Inyandiko zifashishijwe == # Institut Géographique du Burundi (IGEBU). # Ministère de l'Environnement, de l'Agriculture et de l'Élevage du Burundi. # Études hydrologiques sur les bassins versants du Burundi. # Publications sur la géographie et les ressources naturelles du Burundi. # Rapports sur le tourisme et les sites naturels du Burundi.

Uruzi rwa Bodo
== Uruzi rwa Bodo == Infobox (Incamake yihuta) Izina: Uruzi rwa Bodo (Bodo River) Igihugu: Nigeria Intara: Rivers State Akarere: Gokana Amazi: Niger Delta Ubwoko: Uruzi / Imigezi y’ibishanga Akamaro: Uburobyi, amazi yo gukoresha, ubukungu bw’abaturage Ibibazo bikomeye: Gucafuzwa na peteroli (oil pollution) == 1. Intangamarara == Uruzi rwa Bodo ni uruzi ruherereye mu gihugu ca Nigeria, mu karere ka Gokana muri Rivers State. Ni rumwe mu migezi ikomeye igize uruherekane rw’amazi rwo muri Niger Delta, akarere kazwi cane ku migezi myinshi, ibishanga n’ubutunzi bw’amafi. Uruzi rwa Bodo rufise akamaro kanini ku buzima bw’abanyagihugu bo mu micungararo yarwo, kuko rukoreshwa mu kuroba, mu kuronka amazi, no mu bikorwa vy’ubutunzi n'ubuzima bwa minsi yose. == 2. Aho ruherereye (Geography) == Uruzi rwa Bodo ruherereye mu gice co hasi c’igihugu ca Nigeria, ahitwa Niger Delta. Ako karere karangwamwo: ibishanga binini imigezi myinshi ihuza amazi isi itose cane imvura nyinshi ku mwaka Uruzi ruva mu rusobe rw’iyindi migezi mito mito n’amazi n’ibishanga, rugahurira hamwe n’ayandi mazi y’akarere ka Niger Delta. == 3. Uko uruzi rumeze == Bodo River si uruzi runini cane nk’imigezi minini yo mu bindi bihugu, ariko ni uruzi rufise ubuzima bwinshi bwo mu mazi. Amazi yarwo ahinduka uko ibihe bigenda: mu gihe c’imvura, amazi ariyongera cane mu gihe c’izuba, amazi aragabanuka Rurimwo ibinyabuzima bitandukanye nk’amafi n’ibimera vyo mu mazi == 4. Akamaro k’Uruzi rwa Bodo == === 4.1 Uburobyi === Uburovyi ni isoko nyamukuru y’ubuzima ku banyagihugu benshi. Amafi ava muri urwo ruzi agurishwa ku masoko, agafasha imiryango kuronka amafaranga n’ibifungurwa. === 4.2 Amazi yo gukoresha === Abantu bo mu micungararo bakoresha amazi y’uruzi mu: kwoza ibikoresho vyarivyo vyose guteka (n’aho rimwe na rimwe bisaba kuyayungurura) ibikorwa vyo mu rugo === 4.3 Ubutunzi bw’akarere === Uruzi rufasha mu: kudandaza amafi guteza imbere ibikorwa vy’uburobyi gutanga akazi ku bantu benshi baherereye mu karere rurimwo === 4.4 Ibinyabuzima === Uruzi rwa Bodo rutunze: amafi atandukanye ibimera vyo mu myonga inyoni ziba hafi y’amazi == 5. Uruhare mu bidukikije == Uruzi rwa Bodo ruri mu gice ca Niger Delta, aho ibidukikije bifise akamaro kanini cane ku binyabuzima. Rufasha: kugumiza ibinyabuzima mu buzima bwavyo gutuma imyonga ikora neza kugumiza urusobe rw’amazi ruringanije == 6. Ibibazo vy’ibidukikije == === 6.1 Gucafuzwa na peteroli === Kimwe mu bibazo bikomeye cane ni isuka rya peteroli (oil spills) ryagiye ribaho muri Niger Delta. Ibi vyateye: gucafura kw’amazi gupfa kw’amafi gusenyuka kw’ubuzima bwo mu mazi === 6.2 Kugabanuka kw’amafi === Kubera gucara kw’amazi: amafi yaragabanutse uburobyi bwaragoye kurushaho == 6.3 Ingaruka ku buzima bw’abantu == Abantu bamwe bakoresha amazi yacafuye bashobora kugira: indwara z’urukoba ingorane z’amagara zijanye n’amazi mabi ubukene kubera kugabanuka kw’uburovyi === 6.4 Uwangiritse ku bidukikije === Urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima rwo muri ako karere rwagize ihinduka rikomeye, kubera ibikorwa vya muntu n’amahinguriro ya peteroli. == 7. Imibereho y’abaturage (Human activity) == Abanyagihugu bo ku nkengera ya Bodo River babayeho bishingikirije: uburovyi uburimyi buto buto (mu mwonga) ubudandaji bw’amafi imirimo ijanye n’amazi Uruzi ni isoko y’ubuzima, ariko kandi ni n’ahantu hagoye kubera ibibazo vy’iyononekara ry’ibidukikije. == 8. Ingorane z’igihe kirekire == Nimba hatagize igikorwa: amafi ashobora kugabanuka cane kurushaho amazi ashobora gukomeza kwandura imibereho y’abanyagihugu ishobora kugorana urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima rushobora gusenyuka == 9. Ibikorwa bishoboka vyo gukingira uruzi == Hariho ibikorwa bishobora gufasha: kugenzura isuka rya peteroli gusukura ibice vyanduye guteza imbere uburyo bwo kuroba bukurikije amategeko kwigisha abanyagihugu kubungabunga ibidukikije gufasha ibikorwa vy’iterambere rirama kandi ryegereye abanyagihugu (sustainable development) == 10. Incamake == Uruzi rwa Bodo ni kimwe mu bigize ubuzima bw’abanyagihugu ba Gokana muri Rivers State, Nigeria. Nubwo rufise akamaro kanini mw'iterambere, mu bidukikije no mu buzima bwa minsi yose, rwahuye n’ibibazo bikomeye vy’iyononekara ry’ibidukikije, cane cane isuka rya peteroli muri urwo ruzi. Kurubungabunga ni ngombwa kugira ngo ruzogume rutanga akamaro ku b’ubu n’abazokurikira muri kazoza. == 11. Uruzi rwa Ruvubu
= Uruzi rwa Ruvubu = Uruzi rwa Ruvubu ni rumwe mu nzuzi nini kandi zikomeye zo mu Burundi. Ruri mu ruhererekane rw'inzuzi zigaburira uruzi rwa Nil biciye ku ruzi Akagera. Ruvubu rurazwi cane kubera uburebure bwarwo, akamaro karwo mu buzima bw'abanyagihugu, no kuba rukikuje ibidukikije bifise ibinyabuzima bitandukanye. Uru ruzi kandi ni rwo rwahaye izina Pariki y'Igihugu ya Ruvubu, imwe mu mapariki manini kandi akomeye mu Burundi. == Intangamarara == Ruvubu ni uruzi runini rutembera mu bice vyinshi vy'Uburundi. Rukomoka mu misozi yo mu buraruko bw'igihugu rugaca rwerekeza mu buseruko no mu buraruko bushira ubuseruko mbere yo guhura n'uruzi Akagera. Kubera uburebure bwarwo n'ubwinshi bw'amazi rutwara, Ruvubu rufatwa nk'urwozi runini kuruta izindi nyinshi zo mu gihugu. Mu mateka y'ubushakashatsi ku ruzi rwa Nil, Ruvubu rwarafashwe nk'imwe mu nzira z'amazi zigira uruhara mu gushikana amazi muri Nil, uruzi rurerure kuruta izindi muri Afrika. == Inkomoko n'Inzira == Uruzi rwa Ruvubu rukomoka mu misozi yo mu buraruko bw'Uburundi, hafi y'intara za Kayanza na Ngozi. Ruva muri ako karere kagizwe n'imisozi miremire n'imvura nyinshi, rugaca runyura mu bibaya no mu mashamba yo hagati mu gihugu. Mu rugendo rwarwo, Ruvubu rwakira amazi ava mu yindi nzuzi n'utugezi twinshi. Amaherezo rugenda rugana mu buseruko bw'Uburundi aho ruhurira n'uruzi Akagera, na rwo rugaca rugaburira Nil. Uburebure bwa Ruvubu bugereranywa hagati ya kilometero 300 na 400 bivanye n'uburyo bwo kubupima n'inzira amazi afata. == Ibidukikije == Mu nkengera za Ruvubu haboneka amoko menshi y'ibimera n'ibikoko. Uru ruzi rubamwo amafi atandukanye, ingona, imvubu n'ibindi binyabuzima vy'amazi. Ibibaya bikikije uru ruzi birafise akamaro kanini mu kubungabunga ibidukikije no mu kurwanya isuri. Muri ivyo bibaya harimwo ibiti, ivyatsi n'ibindi bimera bifasha kugumya ubutaka no kurinda amazi guhumanywa. == Pariki y'Igihugu ya Ruvubu == Pariki y'Igihugu ya Ruvubu ni imwe mu mapariki akomeye yo mu Burundi. Yashinzwe mu mwaka wa 1980 kugira ngo irinde ibinyabuzima n'ibidukikije biri mu kibaya ca Ruvubu. Iyo pariki ibamwo inyamaswa zitandukanye zirimwo imvubu, imbogo, impala, inguge, ingona n'ubwoko bwinshi bw'inyoni. Ni ahantu h'ingenzi mu bikorwa vy'ubukerarugendo no mu bushakashatsi ku bidukikije. == Akamaro k'Uruzi rwa Ruvubu == === Ubuhinga bwo Kurima === Amazi ya Ruvubu afasha mu bikorwa vy'uburimyi, cane cane mu bibaya biri hafi y'uru ruzi. Abanyagihugu bakoresha ayo mazi mu kuvomera imirima no mu bindi bikorwa vy'ubuhinzi. === Ubworozi === Aborozi bo mu turere dukikije uru ruzi bakoresha amazi yarwo mu kunywesha ibitungwa vyabo, harimwo inka, impene n'intama. === Uburovyi === Ruvubu rubamwo amafi atandukanye afasha abahatuye kuronka ibifungurwa no kwinjiza amafaranga biciye mu burovyi. === Ubukerarugendo === Pariki ya Ruvubu n'ibidukikije biyikikije bikurura abakerarugendo bava mu Burundi no mu bindi bihugu. Ivyo bifasha guteza imbere ubutunzi bw'igihugu. == Ibibazo Bibangamiye Uruzi == N'ubwo Ruvubu rufise akamaro kanini, rurashobora guhura n'ingorane zitandukanye zirimwo: * Gutemagura amashamba ari hafi yarwo; * Isuri iterwa n'ikorwa ry'uburimyi ridakingira ubutaka; * Ihumana ry'amazi rituruka ku bikorwa vy'abantu; * Ihindagurika ry'ibihe rigabanya canke rikongera amazi mu buryo budasanzwe. Kubungabunga uru ruzi ni kimwe mu bikorwa bihambaye kugira ngo rukomeze gufasha ibisekuru vya none n'ibizokurikira. == Inkomoko y'Izina == Izina Ruvubu ryaturutse ku jambo ry'Ikirundi "imvubu", kubera ko kera uru ruzi rwari rubamwo imvubu nyinshi cane. Ayo matungo ni yo yatumye akarere n'uru ruzi bironka iryo zina. == Raba kandi == * Uruzi rwa Nil * Uruzi Akagera * Pariki y'Igihugu ya Ruvubu * Uruzi Ruvyironza * Amazi yo mu Burundi == Ivyashingiweko ( Inkomoko) == # Encyclopaedia Britannica.
