Aho ruherereye n’aho rutangirira == Rukarara rutangirira mu misozi miremire n’amashyamba y’inzitane ya Nyungwe, ahantu h’imvura nyinshi n’amasoko menshi y’amazi. * Akarere: Nyamagabe * Intara: Amajyepfo y’u Rwanda * Ibidukikije: Ishyamba rya Nyungwe + ibishanga nka Kamiranzovu swamp Ayo mazi ava mu masoko mato mato, agahuza agatangura gukora uruzi rwa Rukarara. \---- == 3. Inzira Rukarara ruja == Rukarara rugira urugendo rurerure ruva mu misozi: # Rutangirira mu masoko yo mu ishyamba rya Nyungwe # Rugaca mu bibaya n’utuyira tw’amazi # Rukaja kwifatanya n’uruzi rwa Mwogo River # Mwogo na rwo rugahuza na Mbirurume # Bigakora Nyabarongo River # Amaherezo amazi ajana mu ruzi rwa Nile binyuze muri Lake Victoria system Iyi nzira yose ni yo ituma Rukarara ruba mu muryango munini w’inzuzi zigize Nile. \---- == 4. Rukarara nk’isoko rya Nile == Abashakashatsi benshi bavuga ko Rukarara ari: * isoko rya kure cane rya Nile (farthest headwater) * rimwe mu masoko nyamukuru ya Nile Blanc Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe mu 2005–2006 bwemeje ko aho Rukarara rutangirira ari ho hantu kure cane amazi ya Nile atangirira urugendo rwayo rugera ku Nyanja Mediterane. Ibi bituma Rukarara ruba uruzi rufise agaciro kadasanzwe mu geographie y’isi. \---- == 5. Ibidukikije Rukarara ruherereyemwo == Rukarara ruba mu karere gafise: * amashyamba y’inzitane ya Nyungwe * ibishanga (Kamiranzovu swamp) * imisozi miremire n’inkengero z’amazi * ibimera n’inyamaswa nyinshi Ibi bidukikije bifasha: * kubungabunga amazi * kugabanya isuri * gutuma inzuzi za Nile zidakama \---- == 6. Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Rukarara == === a) Mu bijanye n’amazi === Rukarara rufasha mu gutanga amazi agenda mu bindi bice vy’uruzi rwa Nile. === b) Mu bushakashatsi === Rukarara rikoreshwa mu: * kwiga inkomoko ya Nile * geographie y’inzuzi * climatology n’ibidukikije === c) Mu bidukikije === * rufasha kubungabunga ishyamba rya Nyungwe * rufasha ibinyabuzima byo mu mazi n’ubutaka === d) Mu bukerarugendo === Abasura Nyungwe bakunda gusura: * aho Rukarara rutangirira * ibidukikije vy’amazi * ibikorwa vya canopy walk \---- == 7. Ibibazo Rukarara ruhura navyo == Naho ari uruzi rukomeye mu mateka ya Nile, ruhura n’ibibazo: * isuri iva ku guhingura nabi * gucibwa kw’amashyamba * umwanda ushobora kwinjira mu mazi * imihindagurikire y’ibihe (climate change) Ibi bishobora kugira ingaruka kuri Nile yose. \---- == 8. Uruhare mu muryango wa Nile == Rukarara si uruzi rwonyene, ahubwo ni igice c’uruhererekane: Rukarara → Mwogo → Nyabarongo → Akagera → Lake Victoria → Nile Ibi bigaragaza ko: 👉 amazi mato atangirira mu Rwanda agira uruhare mu ruzi runini kurusha ayandi kw’isi. \---- == 9. Umusozo == Rukarara ni uruzi ruto ariko rufise agaciro kanini cane mu mateka n’ubushakashatsi bw’isi. Rufatwa nk’inkomoko ya kure cane ya Nile, kandi rufasha mu kubungabunga ibidukikije vy’akarere ka Nyungwe. Ni ikimenyetso c’uko igihugu c’u Rwanda gifise uruhare runini mu muryango w’inzuzi mpuzamakungu.

Uruzi rwa Base
URUZI RWA BASE: IMITERERE, INKOMOKO N’AKAMARO KARWO Uruzi rwa Base ni rumwe mu nzuzi nto zo mu Rwanda zigira uruhare mu urusobe rw’inzuzi zigize Nile Basin. Nubwo rutazwi cane nk’inzuzi nini, rufite agaciro kanini mu bijanye n’imiterere y’amazi, ibidukikije n’ubuzima bw’abaturage bo mu bice rucamwo. \--- 1\. Aho ruherereye Uruzi rwa Base ruherereye mu majyaruguru y’u Rwanda, cyane cyane mu turere twa: Gakenke Burera Ruca mu misozi miremire, ibibaya n’utuyira tw’amazi twinshi tw’aho hantu, ahanini harangwa n’imvura nyinshi mu bihe binini vy’umwaka. \--- 2\. Inkomoko y’uruzi rwa Base Uruzi rwa Base ntirutangirira ku isoko rimwe rinini. Ahubwo: ruturuka ku masoko mato menshi yo mu misozi ayo masoko ahurira agatanga imigezi mito iyo migezi igahurira ikakora uruzi rwa Base Ibi ni ibisanzwe ku nzuzi nyinshi zo mu Rwanda, aho amazi ava mu mvura agahurira buhoro buhoro. \--- 3\. Inzira ruja Uruzi rwa Base rugenda ruca mu nzira ikurikira: Rutangirira mu misozi yo mu majyaruguru y’u Rwanda Rukanyura mu bibaya n’imirima y’abaturage Rukakira amazi ava mu migezi mito n’amasoko atandukanye Hanyuma rugahurira n’uruzi rwa Nyabarongo Nyabarongo ni rwo ruzi runini rugize igice gikomeye c’uruhererekane rwa Nile. \--- 4\. Uruzi rwa Base mu muryango wa Nile Uruzi rwa Base ni igice c’uruhererekane rw’inzuzi rugera kuri Nile. Urwo ruhererekane ni uru: Base → Nyabarongo → Akagera → Lake Victoria → Nile Ibi bisobanura ko amazi ya Base, n’aho ari mato, amaherezo agira uruhare mu ruzi rurerire kurusha ayandi kw’isi. \--- 5\. Ibidukikije ruherereyemwo Agace ruherereyemwo karangwa na: imisozi miremire ibibaya n’imirima ibishanga bito bito imvura nyinshi Ibi bituma uruzi rwa Base rugira amazi menshi mu bihe vy’imvura, ariko rushobora kugabanuka mu gihe cy’izuba. \--- 6\. Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Base a) Amazi y’ubuhinzi Abaturage bakoresha amazi ya Base mu kuhira imyaka no gufasha amatungo. b) Kubungabunga ibidukikije Rufasha mu: kugabanya isuri kubungabunga ubutaka gufasha ibimera gukura neza c) Uruhare muri Nile Rufasha mu kongerera amazi Nyabarongo, bigatuma urusobe rwa Nile rukomeza gukora neza. \--- 7\. Ibibazo ruhura navyo Uruzi rwa Base ruhura n’ibibazo bikurikira: isuri iva ku guhinga ku misozi gucibwa kw’amashyamba umwanda uva mu midugudu kugabanuka kw’amazi mu bihe vy’izuba Ibi bishobora kugira ingaruka ku rugendo rw’amazi rugana mu nzuzi nini. \--- 8\. Umusozo Uruzi rwa Base ni uruzi ruto ariko rufite akamaro kanini mu Rwanda. Nubwo rutagaragara nk’inzuzi nini, rufite uruhare rukomeye mu muryango w’amazi ugana kuri Nyabarongo, hanyuma ukagera kuri Nile. Rugaragaza neza ko n’inzuzi nto zo mu misozi y’u Rwanda zifite uruhare runini mu bidukikije n’urusobe rw’amazi rw’isi. \---

Uruzi rwa Sebeya
== URUZI RWA SEBEYA: IMITERERE, INKOMOKO N’AKAMARO KARWO == Uruzi rwa Sebeya ni rumwe mu nzuzi z’ingenzi zo mu burengerazuba bw’u Rwanda, ruzwi cyane kubera guca mu turere twinshi, gutembera mu misozi miremire no gusohokera mu Lake Kivu hafi ya Rubavu (Gisenyi). Ni uruzi rufite akamaro mu bidukikije, mu bukungu n’iterambere ry’ingufu z’amashanyarazi mu Rwanda. \---- == 1. Aho ruherereye == Uruzi rwa Sebeya ruherereye mu: * Intara: Uburengerazuba bw’u Rwanda * Akarere: Rutsiro, Rubavu, Ngororero na Nyabihu * Rusohokera: mu Lake Kivu hafi ya Rubavu Ruca mu misozi miremire yo ku Congo–Nile divide, aho amazi aturuka agana mu byerekezo bibiri by’ingenzi by’isi. \---- == 2. Inkomoko ya Sebeya == Sebeya rutangirira mu misozi yo mu Rutsiro na Ngororero, ahanini: * mu mashyamba n’imisozi miremire * ku nkombe z’amashyamba ya Gishwati * mu masoko mato ahurira agakora uruzi Uruzi rwa Sebeya ni uruzi ruterwa n’imvura nyinshi igwa mu burengerazuba bw’u Rwanda. \---- == 3. Inzira ya Sebeya == Uruzi rwa Sebeya rugenda ruca mu nzira ikurikira: # Rutangirira mu misozi ya Rutsiro/Ngororero # Rukamanuka rugaca mu bibaya n’imirima # Rukanyura mu turere twa Nyabihu na Rutsiro # Rukagera mu karere ka Rubavu # Hanyuma rukisuka mu Lake Kivu Rugenda rutwara ubutaka (sediments) biva ku isuri yo ku misozi. \---- == 4. Uburebure n’imiterere == Uruzi rwa Sebeya: * rufite uburebure bugera hafi ku 110 km * ruca mu misozi ihanamye cyane * rufite umuvuduko mwinshi mu bice byo hejuru * rukagabanuka umuvuduko rugana ku kiyaga cya Kivu Ibi bituma rushobora gutera isuri n’imyuzure mu bihe by’imvura nyinshi. \---- == 5. Sebeya mu muryango w’inzuzi == Nubwo Sebeya rutari mu muryango wa Nile, ni uruzi ruri mu Congo Basin, kuko amazi yarwo asohokera muri: Lake Kivu → Rusizi River → Congo River → Atlantic Ocean 👉 Ibi bituma Sebeya ruba igice cy’indi sisitemu y’amazi itandukanye na Nyabarongo/Nile. \---- == 6. Ibidukikije Sebeya ruherereyemwo == Agace ka Sebeya karangwa na: * imisozi ihanamye * ubutaka bworoshye gutwarwa n’isuri * imvura nyinshi * ibikorwa by’ubuhinzi bwinshi Ibi bituma Sebeya ruba uruzi rufite ikibazo cy’isuri n’umwanda w’ubutaka. \---- == 7. Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Sebeya == === a) Amazi y’abaturage === Sebeya rukoreshwa mu: * kunywa (ahari amazi atunganywa) * kuhira imyaka * gukoresha mu ngo === b) Ingufu z’amashanyarazi === Ku ruzi rwa Sebeya hari: * ingomero nto zitanga amashanyarazi * zifasha umujyi wa Rubavu n’ahandi === c) Ubukungu === Rufasha mu: * ubuhinzi * uburobyi mu bice bya Lake Kivu * ibikorwa by’ubucukuzi buto (mu bice bimwe) === d) Ibidukikije === Rufasha mu: * gutwara amazi y’imvura * gutuma ibishanga bikora neza * gutanga ubuzima ku binyabuzima byo mu mazi \---- == 8. Ibibazo Sebeya ruhura navyo == Uruzi rwa Sebeya ruhura n’ibibazo bikomeye: * isuri ikabije iva ku misozi ihingwaho nabi * imyuzure mu bihe by’imvura nyinshi * kwangirika kw’inkengero z’uruzi * gutwarwa kw’ubutaka bwinshi mu mazi (sedimentation) * umwanda uva mu midugudu n’imijyi Ibi bituma rimwe na rimwe Sebeya rutemba amazi yanduye cyangwa yuzuye ubutaka bwinshi. \---- == 9. Umusozo == Uruzi rwa Sebeya ni uruzi rukomeye mu burengerazuba bw’u Rwanda, rugira uruhare mu buzima bwa buri munsi bw’abaturage, mu bukungu n’iterambere ry’ingufu. Nubwo ruri mu Congo Basin, rugaragaza akamaro k’inzuzi zo mu Rwanda mu iterambere ry’igihugu n’akarere. Sebeya ni uruzi rwerekana neza uko imiterere y’imisozi n’imvura bigira ingaruka ku mazi, ibidukikije n’ubuzima bw’abantu. \----

Uruzi rwa Mkulumuzi
== Intangamarara == Uruzi rwa Mkulumuzi ni rumwe mu nzuzi ziri mu buraruko bushira ubuseruko bwa Tanzaniya, mu ntara ya Tanga. Ni uruzi ruto ugereranije n’izindi nzuzi nini zo muri ako karere, ariko rufise akamaro kanini mu buzima bw’abanyagihugu, mu bijanye n’amazi, uburimyi, ibidukikije n’iterambere ry’uturere rurukikije. Uruzi rwa Mkulumuzi runyura hafi y’igisagara ca Tanga, rukaba rufasha mu gutanga amazi akoreshwa n’abanyagihugu n’ibikorwa vy’ubutunzi bitandukanye. == Inkomoko y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Mkulumuzi rutangurira mu bice vyo hagati n’imisozi mito yo mu ntara ya Tanga. Amazi yarwo akomoka ku mvura igwa muri ako karere, igahurira mu migezi mito mito igakora uru ruzi. Nta kiyaga kinini canke isoko imwe ikomeye iruvyara; ahubwo ni uruhurirane rw’imigezi mito iva mu mirima n’amayira y’amazi yo mu misozi. == Inzira y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Mkulumuzi rutembera mu ntara ya Tanga, runyura mu bice vyo mu micungararo y’igisagara ca Tanga n’imidugudu ikiranye na co. Ruca mu mirima, mu bice vy’imitumba n’ahantu hatuwe n’abantu benshi. Mu nyuma, uru ruzi rusuka amazi yarwo mu Liyonga y’Ubuhindi (Indian Ocean) hafi y’igisagara ca Tanga. == Imiterere y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Mkulumuzi rufise ibiranga bikurikira: * Ni uruzi ruto kandi rutemba buhoro mu bice bimwe. * Amazi yarwo ahindagurika bivanye n’ibihe vy’imvura. * Mu gihe c’imvura amazi ariyongera cane, rimwe na rimwe hakaba n’imyuzure mito. * Mu gihe c’izuba amazi aragabanuka cane. Inkengera zarwo zirimwo ibimera bitandukanye bifasha kugumya ubutaka no kugabanya isuri. == Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Mkulumuzi == Uruzi rwa Mkulumuzi rufise akamaro kanini ku baturage bo mu karere ka Tanga: === 1. Amazi yo gukoresha === Abanyagihugu barukoresha mu: * Kuvomera * Isuku * Guteka (hanyuma yo kuyatunganya) === 2. Uburimyi === Inkengera z’uru ruzi zifasha cane mu burimyi. Abahinzi bakoresha amazi yarwo mu kuvomera: * Imboga * Ibigori * Ibijumba * Imyumbati Ubutaka buri hafi y’uruzi burera cane kubera ubuhehere n’ifumbire iva mu bishanga. === 3. Ibikorwa vy’ubutunzi === Mu bice bimwe, amazi y’uruzi afasha: * Inganda nto nto * Gukaraba n’ugutunganya ibikoresho * Ibikorwa vyo mu miji mito === 4. Ibinyabuzima === Uruzi rufasha kubungabunga ibinyabuzima vyo mu mazi no ku nkengera zarwo, harimwo: * Amafi mato mato * Inyoni zo mu mazi * Ibimera vyo mu bishanga == Ibibazo bihari == Naho rufise akamaro, Uruzi rwa Mkulumuzi ruhura n’ingorane zitandukanye: * Uhumane ry’amazi riva mu myanda yo mu bisagara * Kwaguka kw’imijyi bituma ibidukikije bihungabana * Isuri y’ubutaka iterwa no gutema ibiti * Ugabanuka kw’amazi mu bihe vy’izuba * Gukoresha amazi mu buryo butarimwo uburongozi bwiza Ibi bibazo bituma uruzi rushobora kugabanuka mu gaciro karyo mu gihe kirekire. == Ingamba zo kurubungabunga == Hafashwe canke harasabwa ingamba zitandukanye zo kurubungabunga: * Gutera ibiti ku nkengera z’uruzi * Kugabanya imyanda ijugunywa mu mazi * Gukingira ibishanga bihurira n’uruzi * Kwigisha abaturage akamaro k’amazi meza * Guteza imbere uburyo bwo gutunganya amazi yo gukoresha == Insozero == Uruzi rwa Mkulumuzi ni uruzi ruto ariko rufise uruhara rukomeye mu buzima bw’abanyagihugu bo mu ntara ya Tanga. Rufasha mu gutanga amazi, guteza imbere uburimyi no kubungabunga ibidukikije. Kururinda no kurubungabunga ni ngirakamaro kugira ngo rukomeze gufasha ibisekuru biriho n’ibizokurikira.

Uruzi rwa Lukuledi
== Intangamarara == Uruzi rwa Lukuledi ni rumwe mu nzuzi ziri mu buseruko bushira amaja epfo bwa Tanzaniya, mu ntara ya Mtwara. Ni uruzi rufise akamaro kanini ku mibereho y’abaturage bo muri ako karere, cane cane mu bijanye n’amazi, uburimyi, ibidukikije n’iterambere ry’uturere rurukikije. Uruzi rwa Lukuledi ruzwi cane mu bice vyo mu micungararo y’igisagara ca Mtwara no mu mirima ikikije ako karere, aho rufasha mu gutanga amazi akoreshwa mu buzima bwa misi yose. == Inkomoko y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Lukuledi rutangurira mu bice vy’imitumba n’imisozi mito yo mu ntara ya Mtwara. Amazi yarwo akomoka ahanini ku mvura igwa muri ako karere, igahurira mu migezi mito mito igakora uru ruzi. Nta soko imwe ikomeye cane ifatwa nk’inkomoko y’uruzi; ahubwo ni uruhurirane rw’imigezi n’amazi ava mu butaka bwo mu micungararo y’amayira y’amazi. == Inzira y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Lukuledi rutembera mu ntara ya Mtwara, runyura mu mirima, imidugudu n’ahari iterambere ry’abantu benshi. Rugenda rugana mu buseruko gushika rusohotse mu Liyonga y’Ubuhindi (Indian Ocean). Mu rugendo rwarwo: * Rwakira amazi ava mu migezi mito yo mu misozi n’imirima. * Runyura mu bice vy’uburimyi bwinshi. * Ruca mu micungararo y’imijyi mito n’imidugudu. * Rusozerera mu nyanja y’Ubuhindi. == Imiterere y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Lukuledi rufise ibi biranga: * Ni uruzi ruto ugereranije n’inzuzi nini zo muri Tanzaniya. * Amazi yarwo ahindagurika cane bivanye n’ibihe vy’imvura. * Mu gihe c’imvura, uruzi rushobora kwaguka rugatera imyuzure mito. * Mu gihe c’izuba, amazi aragabanuka cane rimwe na rimwe. Inkengera zarwo zirimwo ubutaka burera neza mu bihe vy’imvura, ariko bushobora kugabanuka igihe habaye isuri. == Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Lukuledi == Uruzi rwa Lukuledi rufise uruhara rukomeye mu buzima bw’abaturage bo mu ntara ya Mtwara: === 1. Amazi yo gukoresha === Abaturage barukoresha mu: * Kuvomera * Guteka (hanyuma yo gutunganywa) * Isuku y’imbere mu ngo === 2. Uburimyi === Uruzi rufasha cane mu burimyi bwo mu karere ka Mtwara. Amazi yarwo akoreshwa mu kuvomera: * Imyumbati * Ibigori * Umuceri * Imboga zitandukanye Ubutaka buri hafi y’uruzi burera neza kubera ubuhehere n’ifumbire iva mu bishanga. === 3. Ubworozi === Aborozi bakoresha amazi y’uruzi mu kuvomera ibitungwa nk’inka, ihene n’intama, cane cane mu bihe vy’izuba. === 4. Ibinyabuzima === Uruzi rwa Lukuledi rufasha kubungabunga ibinyabuzima vyo mu mazi no ku nkengera zarwo, harimwo: * Amafi atandukanye * Inyoni zo mu bishanga * Ibimera bikura ku nkengera z’amazi == Ibibazo bihari == Uruzi rwa Lukuledi ruhura n’ingorane zitandukanye ziva ku bikorwa vy’abantu n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe: * Isuri y’ubutaka iterwa no gutema amashyamba * Uhumane ry’amazi riva mu myanda y’abantu * Kwaguka kw’uburimyi mu bishanga * Ugabanuka kw’amazi mu gihe c’izuba * Imyuzure mito mu gihe c’imvura nyinshi Ibi bibazo birashobora kugabanya ubushobozi bw’uruzi bwo gufasha abantu n’ibidukikije. == Ingamba zo kurubungabunga == Hafashwe canke harasabwa ingamba zitandukanye zo kurinda Uruzi rwa Lukuledi: * Gutera ibiti ku nkengera z’uruzi * Kugabanya gutema amashyamba mu micungararo y’amazi * Gucunga neza imyanda iva mu bisagara n’imidugudu * Kurinda ibishanga bihurira n’uruzi * Kwigisha abaturage akamaro k’amazi n’ibidukikije == Insozero == Uruzi rwa Lukuledi ni isoko y’ubuzima n’iterambere ku ntara ya Mtwara muri Tanzaniya. Naho ari uruzi ruto, rufise akamaro kanini mu bijanye n’amazi, uburimyi, ubworozi n’ibidukikije. Kurubungabunga ni ngirakamaro kugira ngo rukomeze gufasha ibisekuru biriho n’ibizokurikira.

Uruzi rwa Sonjo
======================== URUZI RWITWA SONJO ======================== Aho ruherereye: Ntibizwi neza / amakuru make Ubwoko: Uruzi ruto (rushobora kuba umugezi w’aho Abasonjo baba) Igihugu: Tanzania (akarere ka Loliondo/Ngorongoro bishoboka) \------------------------ “Uruzi rwa Sonjo” si izina rizwi cane mu nzuzi nini z’Afurika y’Ubuseruko mu masoko y’amakuru yemewe. Hari amahirwe ko ari umugezi muto wo mu karere Abasonjo babamwo muri Tanzania, canke izina rikoreshwa n’abanyagihugu ku mugezi w’aho hantu. Abasonjo 0 babarizwa mu bice vya Loliondo n’ahandi hafi ya Ngorongoro, aho haboneka imigezi mito mito ifasha mu buhinzi n’ubworozi. Ariko nta “Ruhome” canke “uruzi rukuru” ruzwi ku izina rya Sonjo rwemejwe mu nyandiko z’akarere. Nimba ushaka, woshobora kumbwira neza:

Uruzi rwa Njoro
Uruzi rwa Njoro Uruzi rwa Njoro ni uruzi ruherereye mu gihugu ca Kenya, mu karere k’ubuseruko bwa Afurika, mu ntara ya Rift Valley, hafi y’igisagara ca Nakuru. Rurazwi cane mu bijanye n’ibidukikije, ubuhinzi, n’akamaro kanini rufitiye abantu n’inyamanswa zo mu karere ruca. 1\. Inkomoko y’uruzi rwa Njoro Uruzi rwa Njoro rufatira inkomoko ku misozi n’amashyamba yo mu Mau Escarpment (Mau Forest), igice kizwi cane nk’isoko y’amazi menshi muri Kenya. Amazi y’imvura n’amazi ava mu mashamba ni yo atuma uru ruzi rutangura. Uruzi rwa Njoro ni uruzi rufise uburebure bugereranywa n’ibilometero hafi 60, rugaca mu duce twinshi two mu buhinzi no mu midugudu mbere yo gushika aho rusohokera. 2\. Aho ruherereye n’aho ruca Uruzi rwa Njoro ruca mu karere ka Njoro, mu ntara ya Nakuru. Ruraca mu mirima, imidugudu, n’ahantu hatandukanye harimwo ibikorwa vy’ubuhinzi n’ubushakashatsi. Mu rugendo rwarwo, uru ruzi ruca mu duce dutandukanye twa Njoro Sub-county, rukagenda rwegeranya amazi ava mu yindi migezi mito mito. 3\. Aho rusohokera Uruzi rwa Njoro rusozera urugendo rwarwo mu kiyaga ca Lake Nakuru. Iki kiyaga kizwi cane kubera ibinyabuzima vyaco, cane cane ibisiga nka flamingo, n’inyamanswa nyinshi zo muri pariki. Amazi y’uruzi rwa Njoro afise uruhara rukomeye mu kugaburira ecosystem ya Lake Nakuru. 4\. Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Njoro Uruzi rwa Njoro rufise akamaro kanini ku bantu n’ibidukikije: a) Amazi yo gukoresha Abanyagihugu bakoresha amazi y’uruzi mu kunywa, guteka, no gukora ibikorwa vya buri munsi. b) Ubuhinzi Rufasha mu kuhira imyaka, cane cane mu bice bifise imvura idahagije. Imirima ikikije uru ruzi ikura neza kubera amazi aboneka hafi. c) Ubushakashatsi n’amashure Akarere ka Njoro karimwo ibigo vy’ubushakashatsi n’amashure y’ubuhinzi nka Egerton University, bikoresha amazi y’uruzi mu bikorwa bitandukanye. d) Ibidukikije Uruzi rwa Njoro rutunga ibinyabuzima bitandukanye n’amafi, kandi rufasha mu kugumya ibidukikije vyiza mu karere. 5\. Ibibazo uruzi rwa Njoro ruhura navyo Naho rufise akamaro, uru ruzi ruhura n’ibibazo bikomeye: Kwanduzwa n’imyanda iva mu midugudu n’imirima Kwangirika kw’inkombe z’uruzi kubera guhingira hafi yarwo Gucibwa kw’amashamba mu Mau Forest, bigabanya inkomoko y’amazi Ihindagurika ry’ibihe rituma amazi agabanuka mu bihe vy’izuba Indwara ziva mu mazi mabi zishobora gufata abantu n’inyamanswa 6\. Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Njoro mu bidukikije vya Lake Nakuru Uruzi rwa Njoro ni kimwe mu nzuzi z’ingenzi zigaburira Lake Nakuru. Iyo amazi yanduye canke agabanutse, bigira ingaruka ku nyamanswa n’ibimera vyo muri pariki. Ni co gituma hari imigambi myinshi yo kurinda uruzi, harimo gutera ibiti ku nkombe zarwo no kugabanya imyanda ijugunywa mu mazi. 7\. Kurinda uruzi rwa Njoro Kugira ngo uru ruzi rukomeze kugirira akamaro ibisekuru biri imbere, harakenewe: Gusubizaho amashyamba (reforestation) mu Mau Forest Kurinda inkengera z’uruzi (riparian zones) Gukoresha amazi neza mu buhinzi Gushiraho amategeko akomeye yo kurwanya umwanda Gukangurira abanyagihugu kurinda ibidukikije 8\. Umusozo Uruzi rwa Njoro ni umutungo kamere w’ingenzi mu gihugu ca Kenya. Rufise uruhara rukomeye mu buzima bw’abantu, ubuhinzi, n’ibidukikije vya Lake Nakuru. Kururinda ni ngombwa kugira ngo rukomeze kuba isoko y’ubuzima n’iterambere mu karere.Nimba ushaka, ndashobora kandi:

Uruzi rwa Turkwel
== Uruzi rwa Turkwel == Uruzi rwa Turkwel ni uruzi ruri mu gihugu ca Kenya mu burengero bushira uburaruko. Ruvuka mu misozi ya Cherangani Hills no mu karere ka Elgeyo-Marakwet, rugaca mu ntara ya West Pokot, hanyuma rukarangira rusuka amazi yarwo mu Kiyaga ca Turkana. Ni rumwe mu migezi ikomeye ifasha mu buzima bw’abantu bo muri ako karere, cane cane mu bijanye n’ubuhinzi, amazi yo kunywa, n’inguvu z’amashanyarazi. Ku ruzi rwa Turkwel hubatswe urugomero runini ruzwi nka Turkwel Gorge Dam, rutanga amashanyarazi, rukafasha mu kugenzura imyuzure no gutanga amazi yo kuhira imirima. Naho rufise akamaro kanini, uru ruzi ruhura n’ibibazo nk’ugabanuka kw’amazi mu gihe c’izuba, isarara ry’ubutaka, n’ingaruka z’impinduka z’ikirere.

Uruzi rwa Kibuon
Uruzi rwa Kibuon ni uruzi ruto ruherereye mu burengero bwa Kenya, mu karere kagize igice c’iciyumviro c’imigezi igaburira Ikiyaga ca Victoria. Ni rumwe mu migezi mito mito igize sisitemu y’imigezi ya Nyando Basin, ikaba igira uruhara mu gutwara amazi ava mu misozi n’imitumba agana mu bibanza biri hepfo aho amaherezo yinjira mu kiyaga ca Victoria. Naho rutari runini cane, uru ruzi rufise akamaro kanini ku buzima bw’abanyagihugu bo mu bice rucamwo, cane cane mu bijanye n’ubuhinzi, amatungo, n’ibikorwa vy’amazi ya buri munsi. \---- == Aho ruva n’aho rujana == Uruzi rwa Kibuon rufise inkomoko mu bice vy’imitumba yo mu burengero bwa Kenya, aho imvura igwa ikavanga n’amasoko y’amazi yo munsi y’ubutaka ikarenga ikakora imigezi mito. Ayo mazi agenda atemba buhoro buhoro aca mu midugudu n’imirima, akinjira mu yindi migezi minini yo muri sisitemu ya Nyando River basin. Mu nzira yarwo, Kibuon ruca mu: * Imirima y’ubuhinzi (cereal crops n’imboga) * Uturere tw’imidugudu mito * Ibibanza vy’imitumba n’ahagoye gushika Amaherezo, amazi y’uruzi rwa Kibuon yinjira mu migezi minini igaburira Ikiyaga ca Victoria. \---- == Ibidukikije n’akarere ruherereyemwo == Akarere uru ruzi ruherereyemwo karangwa n’imvura idahoraho cane, ivyo bigatuma uruzi ruba ruto mu gihe c’izuba ariko rukaguka mu bihe vy’imvura nyinshi. Ibimera biri ku nkengera z’uruzi birimwo: * Ibiti n’ivyatsi bikomera ku butaka butose * Imirima y’abanyagihugu * Ibibanza vy’amazi y’icatsi (wetlands) mu bice bimwe Ibi bidukikije bifasha mu kugabanya isarara ry’ubutaka no kubungabunga amazi, naho mu bihe bimwe bishobora kwononekara kubera ibikorwa vy’abantu. \---- == Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Kibuon == === 1. Ubuhinzi === Uruzi rwa Kibuon rukoreshwa cane mu kuhira imirima. Abanyagihugu barukikije bahinga: * ibigori * ibijumba * imboga zitandukanye * ibindi bihingwa vy’imirire ya buri munsi Amazi yarwo afasha cane mu bihe vy’izuba ryinshi aho imvura iba nkeya. === 2. Amazi y’abantu n’amatungo === Rutanga amazi akoreshwa mu: * kunywa (nyuma yo kuyatunganya) * guteka * kuvomera amatungo (inka, intama, ihene) === 3. Ibidukikije === Uruzi rufasha mu kubungabunga ubuzima bw’ibinyabuzima bito bito vyo mu mazi n’inkengera zarwo, nk’amafi mato, udukoko tw’amazi n’ibimera vyo mu migezi. === 4. Ubutunzi bw’akarere === Naho rutari runini cane, rufasha mu bukungu bw’aho ruherereye binyuze mu: * ubuhinzi bworoheje * ibikorwa vy’abantu bishingiye ku mazi * gukomeza ubuzima bw’imidugudu yo mu micungararo yarwo \---- == Ibibazo n’imbogamizi == Uruzi rwa Kibuon ruhura n’ibibazo bitandukanye bigira ingaruka ku kamaro karwo: === 1. Isarara ry’ubutaka (soil erosion) === Kubera guhingura imirima hafi y’uruzi no gutema ibiti, ubutaka buratemba bukinjira mu ruzi bigatuma: * uruzi rwuzura umucanga * inzira y’amazi ihinduka * amazi agabanuka === 2. Umwanda w’amazi === Mu bice bimwe, amazi yanduzwa n’imyanda iva mu: * mirima (pesticides n’ifumbire) * amazu y’abantu * amatungo === 3. Kugabanuka kw’amazi === Mu bihe vy’izuba ryinshi, uruzi rushobora kugabanuka cane kubera: * imvura nke * ikoreshwa ryinshi ry’amazi * ihindagurika ry’ikirere === 4. Impinduka z’ikirere === Climate change ituma haba: * imvura idahoraho * imyuzure mu bihe bimwe * amapfa mu bindi bihe \---- == Ingamba zo kurubungabunga == Mu bice bimwe, hariko hashirwa imbere ingamba zo kurinda uru ruzi: * gutera ibiti ku nkengera zarwo * kugabanya gutema ibiti bidafise isubirizwa * gukoresha neza amazi mu buhinzi * kurwanya umwanda mu migezi mito * kwigisha abanyagihugu akamaro k’uruzi \---- == Umusozo == Uruzi rwa Kibuon, n’aho ari uruzi ruto, rufise akamaro kanini ku buzima bw’abanyagihugu bo mu burengero bwa Kenya. Rwifashishwa mu buhinzi, mu mazi y’abantu n’amatungo, no mu kubungabunga ibidukikije. Naho ruhura n’imbogamizi zitandukanye nk’isubirwamwo ry’ubutaka n’ihindagurika ry’ikirere, rurabandanya kuba isoko y’ubuzima mu karere rurimwo. Nimba ushaka, nokora kandi:

Uruzi rwa Nyando
= Uruzi rwa Nyando = == Intangamarara == Uruzi rwa Nyando ni rumwe mu nzuzi ziri mu gihugu ca , ruherereye mu burengerazuba bw’ico gihugu, mu ntara yaho yitwa Nyanza. Ni uruzi rufise akamaro kanini mu buzima bw’abaturage n’ubutunzi bw’ico gice kuko rufasha mu buhinzi, amazi yo kunywa, hamwe n’ibindi bikorwa vy’ubuzima bwa misi yose. Rufatwa kandi nk’imwe mu nzuzi zinjira mu sisitemu y’amazi y’Ikiyaga cya Victoria. \---- == Aho ruherereye n’inzira yarwo == Uruzi rwa Nyando rutangirira mu misozi n’udusozi two mu burengerazuba bwa Kenya, ahanini mu bice biri hafi ya Kericho na Nandi. Rukagenda rumanuka mu mibande n’imirambi, rugaca mu bibanza bitandukanye vy’ubuhinzi. Mu rugendo rwarwo, uruzi rwa Nyando: * Rukora mu bice vyo mu ntara ya Nyanza * Rukanyura hafi y’igisagara ca * Rukaza gusohokera mu kiyaga kinini ca \---- == Amashami yarwo (tributaries) == Uruzi rwa Nyando rufise n’utundi tunzuzi duto twinshi dufasha mu kurwongerera amazi. Muri two harimwo: * Inzuzi nto nto zo mu misozi ya Kericho * Imigezi iva mu mirima y’itabi n’iy’ibigori * Amazi ava mu bishanga n’udusumo two mu karere ka Nyanza Ayo mashami yose afasha gutuma uruzi rugira amazi menshi cane mu bihe vy’imvura. \---- == Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Nyando == === 1. Ubuhinzi === Uruzi rwa Nyando rukoreshwa cane mu kuvomerera imirima. Abaturage bahinga: * Umuceri * Ibigori * Ibiharage * Imboga zitandukanye Aho uruzi ruciye ni ho haba ubutaka bwiza bwo guhinga kubera amazi n’ifumbire isanzwe iva mu mwonga. === 2. Amazi yo kunywa n’imikoreshereze ya misi yose === Abantu bo mu bice rucamwo barukoresha mu: * Kunywa amazi * Gukaraba no gusukura * Gukoresha mu matungo (inka, ihene, intama) === 3. Uburobyi === Mu duce uruzi Nyando ruhurira na , haba uburobyi. Abantu baruroba amafi atandukanye afasha mu: * Kuronka ibifungurwa * Ubucuruzi * Ubutunzi bw’imiryango === 4. Ubukungu n’iterambere === Aho uruzi ruciye habaho: * Ubucuruzi bw’imyaka * Imirimo ijanye n’amazi * Iterambere ry’imidugudu n’igisagara ca Kisumu \---- == Ibibazo uruzi rwa Nyando ruhura na vyo == Naho rufise akamaro kanini, rufise n’ingorane zitandukanye: === 1. Imyuzure === Mu gihe c’imvura nyinshi, uruzi rwa Nyando rushobora kwuzura rukatera: * Gusenyuka kw’inzu * Kwimurwa kw’abantu * Kubura imyaka mu mirima === 2. Isuri (soil erosion) === Kubera gucibwa kw’amashyamba no guhingira hafi y’uruzi, ubutaka buraranduka bukaja mu mazi. === 3. Kwandura kw’amazi === Imyanda iva: * Mu buhinzi (ifumbire n’imiti yica udukoko) * Mu bisagara bituma amazi adahumana kandi agira ingaruka ku buzima. \---- == Uruzi rwa Nyando n’ibidukikije == Uruzi rwa Nyando rufasha mu kubungabunga ibinyabuzima: * Amafi atandukanye * Ibimera vyo ku nkengero z’amazi * Inyoni n’inyamaswa ziba hafi y’amazi Ariko kwangirika kw’ibidukikije biriko bigabanya ivyo binyabuzima. \---- == Ingamba zo kururinda == Mu kurinda uruzi rwa Nyando, hakorwa: * Gutera ibiti ku nkengero z’uruzi * Kugabanya guhingira hafi y’amazi * Gucunga neza imyanda iva mu bisagara * Gukingira ibishanga bikikije uruzi \---- == Umwanzuro == Uruzi rwa Nyando ni uruzi rufise akamaro kanini mu gihugu ca , cane cane mu karere k’uburengerazuba no hafi y’igisagara ca . Naho ruhura n’ibibazo nk’imyuzure n’isuri, rukomeje kuba isoko ry’ubuzima, ubuhinzi n’ubutunzi ku baturage benshi. Niba ushaka, nagukorera:

Uruzi rwa Aswa
== Intangamarara == Uruzi rwa Aswa, ruzwi kandi ku zina rya Achwa, ni rumwe mu nzuzi z’ingenzi zo mu karere k’Afurika y’Ubuseruko. Ruca mu bihugu vya na , kandi rufatwa nk’ishami rinini rigaburira amazi mu ruzi rwa Nil, cyane cyane mu gice citwa . Ni uruzi rufise akamaro mu buzima bw’abantu, mu buhinzi, mu bidukikije, no mu gutanga amazi mu bice vyumye vya Afrika y’Ubuseruko. \---- == Aho ruherereye == Uruzi rwa Aswa rutangirira mu majyaruguru y’igihugu ca , ahanini mu ntara za: * Gulu * Kitgum * Pader Rukaba ruva mu bice vy’amashyamba n’imirambi yo mu karere k’Acholi, aho amazi y’imvura n’utuyaga two mu misozi bituma habaho inkomoko y’uruzi. Nyuma yo gutangirira muri Uganda, uruzi rwa Aswa: * Rujya mu majyaruguru * Rukinjira mu gihugu ca * Rugasoza urugendo rwarwo mu kwinjira mu ruzi rwa Nil (White Nile) \---- == Inzira n’imiterere y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Aswa rufise inzira ndende igizwe n’imibande, ibibaya n’udusozi. === Ibiranga inzira yarwo === * Ruca mu bice vyumye n’ibindi bifise ibiti bike * Rukagira ibihe vy’amazi menshi mu gihe c’imvura * Rukagabanuka cane mu gihe c’izuba ryinshi * Rukora ibishanga bito bito ku nkengero zarwo Mu bice bimwe, uruzi rwa Aswa rushobora kugabanuka cane ku buryo rusa n’urwumye, ariko mu bihe vy’imvura ruca rwuzura. \---- == Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Aswa == === 1. Amazi yo kunywa n’ubuzima === Abantu bo mu bice rucamwo barukoresha: * Kunywa amazi * Gukaraba no gukora isuku * Gukoresha mu ngo Ariko kubera ko amazi adahora ari menshi, rimwe na rimwe abantu bahura n’ingorane y’ibura ry’amazi. \---- === 2. Ubuhinzi === Uruzi rwa Aswa rufasha cane mu buhinzi bwo mu bice rwicamwo, cane cane mu gihe c’imvura. Ibihingwa bihingwa hafi yarwo: * Amasaka * Ibigori * Imyumbati * Ibiharage Amazi yarwo afasha mu kuvomerera imirima mu bihe vy’izuba. \---- === 3. Uburobyi === Mu bice bimwe vy’uruzi, haba amafi make ariko afise akamaro: * Akaribwa n’abaturage * Gufasha mu mirire y’imiryango Ariko uburobyi ntiburi ku rwego runini nk’urw’uruzi runini. \---- === 4. Ibidukikije === Uruzi rwa Aswa rutunga: * Amafi * Inyoni ziba ku nkengero * Ibimera bikura mu bishanga bito Rufasha kandi mu kugumana ubusugire bw’ibinyabuzima vyo mu karere ka Acholi. \---- == Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Aswa mu sisitemu ya Nil == Uruzi rwa Aswa ni kimwe mu nzuzi zigira uruhare mu kugaburira . Uru ruhare rurimwo: * Kongerera amazi ya Nil mu bihe vy’imvura * Gufasha mu gutembera kw’amazi mu karere * Gukomeza uruja n’uruza rw’ibinyabuzima mu sisitemu ya Nil \---- == Ibibazo n’ingorane == === 1. Ukugabanuka kw’amazi === Mu gihe c’izuba ryinshi, uruzi rwa Aswa rushobora: * Kugabanuka cane * Rimwe na rimwe gukama mu bice bimwe \---- === 2. Isuri n’iyangirika ry’isi === Guca ibiti no guhingira hafi y’uruzi bituma: * Ubutaka buranduka * Isedimenti ijya mu mazi * Inzira y’uruzi ihinduka \---- === 3. Ubwiyongere bw’abantu === Abantu bimukira hafi y’uruzi bituma: * Amazi akoreshwa cane * Kwandura kw’amazi * Kugabanuka kw’ibinyabuzima \---- === 4. Imihindagurikire y’ibihe === Imihindagurikire y’ibihe (climate change) igira ingaruka: * Imvura idahinduka neza * Izuba ryinshi * Ukudahuza kw’amazi mu ruzi \---- == Ingamba zo kururinda == Hafashwe ingamba zitandukanye mu kurinda uruzi rwa Aswa: * Gutera ibiti ku nkengero z’uruzi * Gucunga neza ubutaka * Kugabanya kwangiza ibishanga * Gucunga imyanda iva mu midugudu * Gukangurira abaturage kurinda amazi \---- == Akaro karyo mu buzima bw’abaturage == Uruzi rwa Aswa rufise uruhare runini mu: * Kubeshaho abantu bo mu ntara ya Acholi * Gufasha ubuhinzi bw’imiryango myinshi * Gutanga amazi mu gihe c’izuba * Gufasha mu iterambere ry’utwo turere \---- == Umwanzuro == Uruzi rwa Aswa (Achwa) ni uruzi rufise akamaro kanini mu bihugu vya na . Naho rutari runini cane nk’inzuzi z’isi, rufise uruhara rukomeye mu buzima bw’abantu, mu buhinzi, no mu bidukikije, kandi ni kimwe mu bigaburira sisitemu ya . Niba ushaka, ndashobora kugukorera:

Uruzi rwa Pager
== Intangamarara == Uruzi rwa Pager ni rumwe mu nzuzi ziri mu buraruko bw’igihugu ca . Ni uruzi ruto ugereranyije n’inzuzi nini zo muri ako karere, ariko rufise akamaro kanini mu buzima bw’abaturage bo mu ntara ya Acholi. Uruzi rwa Pager rufatwa nk’ishami ry’uruzi rwa Aswa (Achwa), rukaba rufasha mu kugaburira amazi mu sisitemu igana ku ruzi rwa Nil. \---- == Aho ruherereye == Uruzi rwa Pager rutangirira mu buraruko bwa , mu bice biri mu karere ka Acholi, cane cane hafi y’uturere twa: * Gulu * Pader * Omoro Ruca mu mibande n’udusozi tw’ako karere, rugenda rwerekeza mu majyaruguru no mu buraruko bushira uburengero. Mu rugendo rwarwo, amazi yarwo yinjira mu ruzi rwa Aswa (Achwa River). \---- == Inzira y’uruzi rwa Pager == Uruzi rwa Pager rugira inzira irangwa n’ibi bikurikira: * Rutangirira mu bishanga n’imigezi mito yo mu ntara ya Acholi * Rukagenda runyura mu mirima y’abaturage * Rukanyura mu bibaya n’imirambi * Rukaza kwinjira mu ruzi rwa Aswa Aho ruhurira na Aswa ni ho amazi yarwo akomeza urugendo rwerekeza mu ruzi rwa Nil. \---- == Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Pager == === 1. Amazi y’abantu === Abaturage bo mu bice rucamwo barukoresha mu: * Kunywa amazi * Gukaraba no gukora isuku * Gukoresha mu ngo no mu matungo \---- === 2. Ubuhinzi === Uruzi rwa Pager rufasha mu buhinzi bwo mu karere ka Acholi: Ibihingwa bihingwa hafi yarwo: * Amasaka * Ibigori * Ibiharage * Imyumbati Amazi yarwo afasha cyane mu bihe vy’izuba ryinshi. \---- === 3. Ibidukikije === Uruzi rwa Pager rutunga ibinyabuzima bitandukanye: * Amafi mato * Inyoni ziba ku nkengero z’amazi * Ibimera vyo mu bishanga Rufasha mu kugumana ubuzima bw’ibidukikije vyo mu karere. \---- === 4. Gufasha uruzi rwa Aswa === Kubera ko Pager ari ishami ry’uruzi rwa Aswa, rugira uruhare mu: * Kongerera amazi Aswa * Gukomeza uruja n’uruza rw’amazi mu gihe c’imvura * Kugaburira sisitemu igana kuri \---- == Ibibazo uruzi rwa Pager ruhura na vyo == === 1. Kugabanuka kw’amazi === Mu gihe c’izuba ryinshi: * Urwego rw’amazi ruragabanuka * Rimwe na rimwe ibice bimwe bigakama \---- === 2. Isuri === Guca ibiti no guhingira hafi y’uruzi bituma: * Ubutaka buranduka * Isedimenti ijya mu mazi * Inzira y’uruzi ihinduka buhoro buhoro \---- === 3. Kwandura kw’amazi === Imyanda iva mu ngo n’ahandi: * Yanduza amazi * Igira ingaruka ku binyabuzima * Igabanya ubwiza bw’amazi \---- === 4. Imihindagurikire y’ibihe === Imvura idahinduka neza ituma: * Hari igihe haba imyuzure mito * Hari n’igihe haba amapfa \---- == Ingamba zo kurinda uruzi rwa Pager == Mu kurinda uruzi, hakorwa ibi bikurikira: * Gutera ibiti ku nkengero zarwo * Kugabanya guhingira hafi y’amazi * Gucunga neza imyanda y’abantu * Kurinda ibishanga bikikije uruzi * Kwigisha abaturage akamaro k’amazi \---- == Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Pager mu buzima bw’abaturage == Uruzi rwa Pager rufasha cyane mu: * Kubeshaho imiryango yo mu karere ka Acholi * Gutanga amazi mu bihe vy’izuba * Gushigikira ubuhinzi bw’imiryango myinshi * Gufasha mu kurinda ibidukikije \---- == Umwanzuro == Uruzi rwa Pager ni uruzi ruto ariko rufise akamaro kanini mu buraruko bwa . Rufasha mu buzima bw’abantu, mu buhinzi, no mu bidukikije, kandi rugira uruhare mu kugaburira uruzi rwa Aswa (Achwa), rukaba narwo rugira uruhare mu sisitemu ya . Niba ushaka, nshobora kugukorera:

Uruzi rwa Ase
Uruzi rwa Ase ni uruzi ruto ruri mu bumanuko bwa , mu ntara ya , ruri mu karere ka Niger Delta. Ni rumwe mu migezi ifasha uruzi runini rwa Niger n’ibishanga bikikuje ico gice. \---- == 1. Aho ruherereye n’akarere rurimwo == Uruzi rwa Ase ruri mu karere karangwa n’ibishanga vyinshi, imvura nyinshi n’imiyaga iva ku nyanja ya Atlantic. Ruranyura mu bice bifise: * ibishanga (swamps) * amashyamba yo mu turere tw’imvura (rainforest) * imihana mito mito y’abanyagihugu Rufitaniye isano n’uruzi rwa Niger mu buryo bw’ama-tributaries (imigezi ibufasha). \---- == 2. Ibiranga uruzi == * Uburebure: ni uruzi ruto ugereranije n’inzuzi zikuru zo muri Nigeria * Uburyo amazi atemba: buhinduka hisunzwe ibihe (igihe c’imvura n’ic’izuba) * Imiterere: rufise ibice vy’amazi atuje n’ibishanga * Ikirere: tropical humid climate (imvura nyinshi umwaka wose) \---- == 3. Ibinyabuzima bibamwo == Uruzi rwa Ase rutunze ibinyabuzima bitandukanye: * amafi atandukanye (afasha uburovyi bwo mu karere) * ibikere n’ibikoko bito bito vyo mu mazi * ibisiga n’inyoni zo mu bishanga * ibimera vyo mu mazi (aquatic plants) Ibishanga vyarwo bifasha kandi mu kubungabunga ibinyabuzima vyo muri Niger Delta. \---- == 4. Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Ase == === a) Uburovyi === Ni isoko nkuru y’ama-fish ku banyagihugu. Uburovyi ni wo mwuga w’ibanze mu miryango myinshi yegereye urwo ruzi. === b) Ubuhinzi === Amazi y’uruzi akoreshwa mu: * kuhira imirima * gutuma ubutaka buguma butose * gutuma umwimbu w’ibihingwa wiyongera === c) Gutwara abantu n’ibintu === Mu bice bimwe, uruzi rukoreshwa mu gutwara: * abantu * ibidandazwa * ibikoresho === d) Ibidukikije === Uruzi rwa Ase rufasha: * kugabanya isuri * kubika amazi mu gihe c’izuba * gutuma ibishanga biguma ari ibidukikije bifise ubuzima bwinshi \---- == 5. Ibibazo bitera uruzi == Uruzi rwa Ase ruhura n’ingaruka zitandukanye: * kwandura kw’amazi (pollution) kubera ibikorwa vy’abantu * gutemwa kw’amashyamba yo ku nkengero z’uruzi * uburovyi burenze urugero * guhinduka kw’ibihe (climate change) \---- == 6. Uruzi rwa Ase mu mibereho y’abantu == Abantu bo mu Delta State barushingira ku ruzi rwa Ase mu: * mirire (amafi) * ubucuruzi * ubuhinzi * ubuzima bwa misi yose Ni uruzi rufise uruhara runini mu bukungu bw’akarere. \---- == 7. Umwanzuro == Uruzi rwa Ase ni uruzi ruto ariko rufise akamaro kanini mu buzima bw’abantu n’ibidukikije vya Niger Delta muri Nigeria. Kurubungabunga ni ngombwa kugira rukomeze gutanga inyungu ku bisekuruza bizaza. Niba ushaka, ndashobora:

Uruzi rwa Ethiope
== Intangamarara == Uruzi rwa Ethiope ni uruzi ruri mu gihugu ca Nijeriya (Nigeria), mu ntara ya Delta State. Ni rumwe mu nzuzi zizwi cane muri ako karere kubera amazi yera cane (clear water) n’ibidukikije vyiza bikikije inkomoko yarwo. Ethiope ifatwa n’abantu benshi nk’imwe mu nzuzi zifise amazi meza cane muri Nigeria, kandi ifise akamaro kanini mu buzima bw’abanyagihugu, uburovyi, ubukerarugendo n’ibidukikije. \---- == Aho ruherereye == Uruzi rwa Ethiope ruherereye mu bumanuko bwa Nigeria, mu gice ca Niger Delta, mu ntara ya: * Delta State Rucaca mu duce dutandukanye, harimwo n’igisagara ca Abraka, kikaba kizwi cane kubera kaminuza n’ubukerarugendo bushingiye ku ruzi. \---- == Inkomoko y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Ethiope rutangura mu gace ka Umukubira w’amazi y’isoko (spring source) kari hafi ya Umuaja / Umukaba forest zone (mu bice vya Delta State). Ruca mu bihugu bibiri ari vyo Burkina Faso na Côte d’Ivoire (Ivory Coast), hanyuma rugasohokera mu Nyanja ya Atlantika. Ni uruzi ruzwi cane kubera ko runyura mu Pariki ya Comoé National Park, imwe mu mapariki akomeye mu Afrika. \---- == Aho ruherereye == Uruzi rwa Comoé rutembera mu: * Burkina Faso (aho rutangurira) * Côte d’Ivoire (aho ruca rwerekeza no gusohokera) Ruca mu bice vy’ubutaka bw’umusenyi, savana, n’amashamba y’itose. \---- == Inkomoko y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Comoé rutangurira mu buraruko bushira ubuseruko bwa Burkina Faso, mu bice vy’imisozi mito n’ubutaka bwumye kurusha epfo. Imigezi mito ihurira igakora uruzi runini rwa Comoé. \---- == Inzira y’uruzi == Inzira y’uruzi rwa Comoé: # Rutangurira muri Burkina Faso # Rwinjira muri Côte d’Ivoire # Ruca mu Comoé National Park # Rukomeza rugana mu bumanuko bwa Côte d’Ivoire # Rurasohokera mu Atlantic Ocean hafi y’akarere ka Grand-Bassam \---- == Imiterere y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Comoé rufise ibiranga bikurikira: * Rurihindagurika (seasonal river mu bice bimwe) * Amazi ariyongera cane mu bihe vy’imvura * Ruca mu savana n’amashamba * Rufise ibishanga n’ahantu h’inyamanswa \---- == Ikirere n’ibidukikije == Akarere k’uruzi rwa Comoé karangwa na: * Ikirere c’ubushuhe (tropical savanna climate) * Imvura mu bihe bimwe vy’umwaka * Ubutaka bwumye mu buraruko, butose mu bumanuko * Amashamba n’ahantu ha savana \---- == Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Comoé == === 1. Ibidukikije === * Ririnda ibinyabuzima mu Comoé National Park * Rituma habaho ecosystem ikomeye ya savana na forest mix === 2. Ubuhinzi === * Amazi akoreshwa mu kuhira imirima * Ubutaka bwo ku nkengera burumbuka === 3. Uburovyi === * Rutanga amafi ku baturage bo ku nkengera * Ni isoko y’ivyokurya === 4. Amazi y’abantu === * Akoreshwa mu ngo no mu bikorwa vya misi yose \---- == Comoé National Park == Uruzi rwa Comoé ruzwi cane kubera kunyura muri: * Pariki ya Comoé National Park (Côte d’Ivoire) ** imwe mu pariki nini muri Afrika y’Uburengero ** irimwo intare, inzovu, imbogo n’ibindi binyabuzima \---- == Ibinyabuzima == Uruzi rwa Comoé rufise: * Amafi y’inzuzi za savana * Inyoni nyinshi zo mu mazi * Inyamaswa nini (inzovu, antelopes mu pariki) * Ibimera vya savana n’amashamba y’itose \---- == Ibibazo n’imbogamizi == === 1. Kugabanuka kw’amazi === * Mu bihe vy’izuba uruzi rushobora kugabanuka cane === 2. Guhinduka kw’ikirere === * Imvura idasanzwe * Umwuzure mu bihe bimwe === 3. Gukoresha nabi ubutaka === * Ubuhinzi buteye isuri * Gutema amashyamba === 4. Kwanduzwa === * Imyanda iva mu midugudu \---- == Akamaro k’umuco == Ku baturage bo muri Burkina Faso na Côte d’Ivoire: * Uruzi rwa Comoé rufatwa nk’isoko y’ubuzima * Rujanye n’imibereho y’abantu bo mu cyaro * Rukoreshwa mu bikorwa vya misi yose \---- == Umwanzuro == Uruzi rwa Comoé ni uruzi rukomeye muri Afrika y’Uburengero, rufise uruhara runini mu bidukikije, ubuhinzi, uburovyi, n’inyamanswa za pariki ya Comoé. Bandama ruca mu gihugu cose ca Côte d’Ivoire ruva mu buraruko rugana mu bumanuko: * Rutangurira mu buraruko bwa Côte d’Ivoire * Ruca mu ntara zitandukanye zo hagati (centre) * Rukanyura hafi ya Yamoussoukro (umurwa mukuru w’igihugu) * Hanyuma rugasohokera mu Nyanja ya Atlantika hafi ya Grand-Lahou \---- == Uburebure n’ubunini == * Uburebure: hafi 800 km kugeza ku 1050 km bivanye n’amasoko atandukanye * Ni uruzi runini kurusha izindi zose mu gihugu * Rurimwo isano n’uruzi rwa Niger na Volta mu karere ka Afrika y’Uburengero \---- == Imiterere y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Bandama rugizwe n’ibice bibiri bikuru: * Bandama Blanc (White Bandama) – igice c’uruzi gitangurira mu buraruko * Bandama Rouge (Marahoué) – ishami rikomeye rifasha kwagura uruzi Iyo migezi ihurira igakora uruzi runini rwa Bandama. \---- == Inzira y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Bandama ruca mu ntara zikurikira: * Burundi bw’uburaruko bwa Côte d’Ivoire * Centre (Haut-Sassandra / Yamoussoukro area) * Sud (Grand-Lahou region) Rugira Uruzi rwa Sassandra
== Intangamarara == Uruzi rwa Sassandra ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye zo mu gihugu ca Côte d’Ivoire (Ivory Coast) mu burengero bwa Afrika. Ni rumwe mu nzuzi nini zishika ku Nyanja ya Atlantika, kandi ruri mu nzuzi 4 zikomeye zitemba ziva mu buraruko bwa Côte d’Ivoire zerekeza mu bumanuko. \---- == Aho ruherereye == Uruzi rwa Sassandra ruca mu bice bikurikira: * Burundi bw’uburaruko bwa Côte d’Ivoire * Centre (Haut-Sassandra, Soubré, Daloa area) * Sud (Sassandra town ku nyanja ya Atlantika) Rugenda ruva mu mashamba n’imisozi yo mu buraruko, rugaca mu duce tw’ubuhinzi, hanyuma rugasohokera ku nyanja. \---- == Inkomoko y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Sassandra ntirufise isoko imwe gusa, kuko ruterwa n’imigezi ibiri ikomeye: * Tiemba River * Gouan River (Bafing Sud) Iyo migezi ihurira mu misozi yo mu buraruko bushira uburengero bwa Côte d’Ivoire (hafi ya Odienné), igakora uruzi runini rwa Sassandra. \---- == Inzira y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Sassandra rugenda gutya: # Rutangurira mu buraruko bwa Côte d’Ivoire # Ruca mu mashamba n’imisozi # Rwakira imigezi myinshi (Nzo, Lobo, Davo n’iyindi) # Ruca mu karere ka Soubré # Hanyuma rugasohokera mu Gulf of Guinea (Atlantic Ocean) \---- == Uburebure n’ubunini == * Uburebure: hafi 650 km * Agace rutembamwo (basin): hafi 75,000 km² * Ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye cane mu burengero bwa Côte d’Ivoire \---- == Imiterere y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Sassandra rufise ibiranga bikurikira: * Ruca mu mashamba y’itose n’ahantu ha savana * Amazi yihuta mu duce tumwe, agaca atemba buhoro ahandi * Rufise ibishanga n’ahantu h’amazi menshi * Rwuzura cane mu bihe vy’imvura \---- == Ibibanza bikomeye kuri Sassandra == === 1. Uruzi rwa Konkouré
== Intangamarara == Uruzi rwa Konkouré ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye zo mu gihugu ca Guinée (Guinea) mu burengero bwa Afrika. Ni uruzi ruzwi cane kubera ko rufise uruhara runini mu gutanga inguvu z’amashanyarazi (hydropower) no mu bidukikije vy’akarere ka Fouta Djallon. Ruca mu misozi, amahagarara y’amazi (rapids), n’amashami y’amashamba y’itose, hanyuma rugasohokera mu Nyanja ya Atlantika hafi ya Conakry. \---- == Aho ruherereye == Uruzi rwa Konkouré ruherereye mu: * Guinée Maritime (Western Guinea) * Ruca mu ntara za Mamou, Kindia, Fria, Dubréka, Boffa * Rurasohokera mu Atlantic Ocean hafi ya Sangaréya Bay, mu buraruko bwa Conakry \---- == Inkomoko y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Konkouré rutangurira mu: * Fouta Djallon Highlands (misozi yo hagati ya Guinea) * Aho ni ahantu hazwi kuba isoko y’inzuzi nyinshi za Afrika y’Uburengero Imigezi mito mito iva muri iyo misozi ihurira igakora uruzi runini rwa Konkouré. \---- == Uburebure n’ubunini == * Uburebure: hafi 303 km * Agace rutembamwo (basin): hafi 17,000–17,500 km² * Ruri mu nzuzi zikomeye za coastal Guinea \---- == Inzira y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Konkouré rugenda gutya: # Rutangurira mu Fouta Djallon # Ruca mu misozi ifise amazi n’amazi yihuta (rapids) # Rwinjira mu bice vya Fria na Kindia # Rukomeza rugana ku bumanuko bushira uburengero # Rurasohokera mu Atlantic Ocean hafi ya Conakry \---- == Imiterere y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Konkouré rufise ibiranga bikurikira: * Amazi yihuta mu misozi (rapids na waterfalls) * Amazi ahinduka cane mu bihe vy’imvura * Ruca mu mashamba y’itose n’ibishanga * Rufise estuary (aho uruzi ruhurira n’inyanja) \---- == Ibibanza bikomeye == === 1. Garafiri Dam === * Yubatswe mu 1999 * Itanga amashanyarazi (hydroelectric power) === 2. Kaléta Hydropower Plant === * Yuzuye mu 2015 * Itanga umuriro munini ku gihugu === 3. Souapiti Dam === * Ingomero nini cane * Yagenewe kongera umusaruro w’amashanyarazi muri Guinea \---- == Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Konkouré == === 1. Ingufu z’amashanyarazi === * Ni uruzi rukomeye mu gutanga hydropower * Ingomero zarwo zitanga umuriro ku gihugu ca Guinea === 2. Ubuhinzi === * Amazi akoreshwa mu kuhira imirima * Ubutaka bwo ku nkengera burumbuka === 3. Uburovyi === * Rutanga amafi ku baturage * Ni isoko y’ivyokurya === 4. Ibidukikije === * Ririnda ibinyabuzima vyo mu mashamba y’itose * Rifise mangroves mu muryango w’uruzi (estuary) \---- == Ibinyabuzima == Uruzi rwa Konkouré rufise: * Amafi menshi (amoko arenga 90 yanditswe) * Inyoni zo mu bishanga * Inyamaswa zo mu mangrove (harimwo manatees n’amafi y’inyanja) * Amashyamba y’itose n’ibishanga binini \---- == Imiterere y’inyanja (Estuary) == Ku muryango w’uruzi: * Hari mangrove ecosystem * Ibishanga n’ibihuru vy’amazi * Ahantu habamwo inyoni nyinshi zo mu mazi * Amazi y’uruzi ahurira n’umunyu w’inyanja \---- == Ibibazo n’imbogamizi == === 1. Ingaruka z’ingomero === * Guhindura urujya n’uruza rw’amafi * Kwimura abantu (relocation) === 2. Guhinduka kw’ikirere === * Imvura idasanzwe * Umwuzure canke kugabanuka kw’amazi === 3. Kwangirika kw’ibidukikije === * Gutema amashyamba * Kwangiza mangroves === 4. Isuri n’isiduka (sedimentation) === * Ubutaka buja mu ruzi bukarwuzura \---- == Umwanzuro == Uruzi rwa Konkouré ni uruzi rukomeye cane muri Guinée, rufise uruhara runini mu nguvu z’amashanyarazi, ibidukikije, ubuhinzi n’ubuzima bw’abantu. Uruzi rwa Lofa

Uruzi rwa Logone
== Intangamarara == Uruzi rwa Logone ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye zo muri Afrika yo hagati. Ruca mu bihugu vya Chad na Cameroon, kandi ni igice gikomeye ca sisitemu y’uruzi rwa Chari–Logone, isuka amazi yayo mu Biyaga vya Chad (Lake Chad). Ni uruzi rufise uruhara runini mu buhinzi, uburovyi, n’ubuzima bw’ibidukikije mu karere ka Sahel na Sudan savanna. \---- == Aho ruherereye == Uruzi rwa Logone ruca mu: * 🇹🇩 Chad (igice kinini c’uruzi) * 🇨🇲 Cameroon (aho rutandukanya canke ruhuza ibice bimwe na Chad) Ruca mu duce tw’ubutaka bwumye (Sahel) n’ubutaka burumbuka (floodplains). \---- == Inkomoko y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Logone rutangurira muri Cameroon, mu misozi n’imigezi mito yo mu buraruko bushira ubuseruko bwa gihugu. Imigezi mito ihurira igakora uruzi runini rwa Logone. \---- == Inzira y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Logone rugenda gutya: # Rutangura mu Cameroon # Ruca ku mupaka wa Cameroon–Chad # Rwinjira mu mashyamba n’ibishanga binini (floodplains) # Ruhurira n’uruzi rwa Chari # Hanyuma rugasuka amazi mu Lake Chad \---- == Uburebure n’ubunini == * Uburebure: hafi 1,000 km * Ni kimwe mu nzuzi zikomeye zigize Lake Chad basin * Ruca mu bibanza binini vy’ibishanga (floodplains) bitwa “Yaéré” \---- == Imiterere y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Logone rufise ibiranga bikurikira: * Rurangwa n’ibishanga binini cane * Amazi yiyongera cane mu bihe vy’imvura * Ruca buhoro mu bice vyinshi * Rufise imiyoboro myinshi (channels) ihinduka \---- == Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Logone == === 1. Ubuhinzi === * Rutuma habaho rice cultivation mu bishanga * Rutanga amazi yo kuhira imirima * Ubutaka burumbuka cane mu gihe c’umwuzure === 2. Uburovyi === * Ni isoko nini y’amafi * Abaturage benshi babeshwaho n’uburovyi === 3. Ubworozi === * Amazi n’ivyatsi vyo mu bishanga bifasha inka n’inyamaswa === 4. Ibidukikije === * Ririnda ubutaka kumagara mu gihe c’izuba * Rifasha kubungabunga ecosystem ya Lake Chad basin \---- == Ibinyabuzima == Uruzi rwa Logone rufise: * Amafi menshi y’inzuzi za Sahel * Inyoni zo mu bishanga (wetland birds) * Inyamaswa zo mu bishanga (harimwo hippos mu duce tumwe) * Ibimera vyo mu floodplains \---- == Ibibazo n’imbogamizi == * Kugabanuka kw’amazi ya Lake Chad basin * Guhinduka kw’ikirere (imvura idasanzwe) * Isuri n’isenyuka ry’inkengera * Gukoresha nabi ubutaka (irrigation itagenzuwe) * Kwanduzwa n’imyanda n’ubuhinzi \---- == Umwanzuro == Uruzi rwa Logone ni uruzi rukomeye muri Cameroon na Chad, rufise uruhara runini mu buhinzi, uburovyi, ibidukikije n’ubuzima bw’abantu. Ni igice gikomeye ca Lake Chad basin, kandi rukeneye kubungabungwa kubera igabanuka ry’amazi n’ihinduka ry’ikirere. Nimba ushaka, ndashobora kugukorera:

Ikiyaga ca Chad
== Intangamarara == Lake Chad ni ikiyaga kinini giherereye muri Afrika yo hagati n’iy’Uburaruko (Sahel region). Gisangwa ku mipaka y’ibihugu bine: Chad, Cameroon, Nigeria, na Niger. Ni kimwe mu biyaga bikomeye cane mu mateka ya Afrika kubera uruhara gifise mu mazi, ubuhinzi, uburovyi n’ubuzima bw’abantu. Lake Chad si ikiyaga gifise amazi menshi ahoraho nk’ibindi biyaga binini, ahubwo kiragabanuka canke kikiyongera bivanye n’ibihe vy’imvura n’izuba. \---- == Aho giherereye == Lake Chad giherereye hagati y’ibihugu: * 🇹🇩 Chad (igice kinini c’ikiyaga) * 🇳🇬 Nigeria * 🇳🇪 Niger * 🇨🇲 Cameroon Ni igice c’uruhererekane rw’inzuzi rwa Chari–Logone basin. \---- == Inkomoko y’amazi y’ikiyaga == Lake Chad kironka amazi yacyo ahanini mu nzuzi zikuru: * Uruzi rwa Chari * Uruzi rwa Logone Izi nzuzi zizana amazi ava mu mashamba n’imvura yo muri Central Africa. \---- == Ubunini n’ihindagurika == * Mu myaka ya kera (1960s), Lake Chad cari kinini cane * Kugeza ubu, ubunini bwagabanutse cane kubera ihinduka ry’ikirere n’ikoreshwa ry’amazi Ikintu gikomeye: * Lake Chad ntigira ubunini buhoraho * Ishobora kwaguka mu bihe vy’imvura, igasubira kugabanuka mu gihe c’izuba \---- == Imiterere y’ikiyaga == Lake Chad ifise: * Ibishanga binini (wetlands) * Ibice vy’amazi meza n’amazi make * Imiyoboro y’amazi ihinduka cane * Ibishanga vyuzuye ibimera (papyrus, reeds) \---- == Akamaro ka Lake Chad == === 1. Uburovyi === * Ni isoko ikomeye y’amafi muri Sahel * Abantu amamiliyoni babeshwaho n’uburovyi === 2. Ubuhinzi === * Amazi akoreshwa mu kuhira imirima * Hahingwa umuceri, imboga, n’ibindi bihingwa === 3. Ubworozi === * Inka n’amatungo bikoresha amazi n’ubwatsi bwo ku nkengera === 4. Amazi y’abantu === * Amazi yo kunywa no gukoresha mu ngo * Ni isoko y’ubuzima ku bihugu bine bikikije ikiyaga \---- == Ibinyabuzima == Lake Chad ririmwo: * Amafi menshi (tilapia n’ubundi bwoko) * Inyoni zo mu bishanga * Inyamaswa zo mu mazi n’inkengera (harimwo hippos mu bice bimwe) * Ibimera vyo mu wetlands \---- == Ibibazo bikomeye == === 1. Kugabanuka kw’amazi === * Lake Chad ryaragabanutse cane kuva mu myaka ya 1960 * Imvura yagabanutse mu karere ka Sahel === 2. Guhinduka kw’ikirere === * Izuba rikomeye n’imvura idahagije * Umwuzure utandukanye n’imyaka ya kera === 3. Gukoresha nabi amazi === * Kuhira imirima ku rugero runini * Gukoresha amazi y’inzuzi zishira mu kiyaga === 4. Umutekano muke === * Hari ibibazo vy’umutekano mu duce tumwe (Sahel region conflicts) \---- == Umwanzuro == Lake Chad ni ikiyaga gikomeye cane muri Afrika, gifise uruhara runini mu buzima bw’abantu, uburovyi, ubuhinzi n’ibidukikije. Naho kigabanuka kubera ihinduka ry’ikirere n’ikoreshwa ry’amazi, kikiri isoko y’ubuzima ku mamiliyoni y’abantu muri Chad, Nigeria, Niger na Cameroon. Nimba ushaka, ndashobora kugukorera:

Uruzi rwa Chari
== Intangamarara == Uruzi rwa Chari (cangwa Shari) ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye zo muri Afrika yo hagati, ruca mu bihugu vya Central African Republic na Chad, hanyuma rugasuka amazi yarwo mu Kiyaga ca Chad (Lake Chad). Ni uruzi rukuru cane kuko rufatwa nk’isoko nyamukuru y’amazi ya Lake Chad. \---- == Aho ruherereye == Uruzi rwa Chari ruca mu: * 🇨🇫 Central African Republic (aho rutangurira) * 🇹🇩 Chad (igice kinini c’uruzi) * Rugeza hafi ya N’Djamena (umurwa mukuru wa Chad) Hanyuma rugahurira n’uruzi rwa Logone rugasuka mu Lake Chad. \---- == Inkomoko y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Chari ntirufise isoko imwe, ahubwo rukomoka ku nzuzi nyinshi zihurira hamwe, zirimwo: * Bahr Aouk * Ouham * Salamat * Bamingui Izi nzuzi ziva mu mashamba ya Central African Republic, zigahurira zigakora Chari River. \---- == Inzira y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Chari rugenda gutya: # Rutangura muri Central African Republic # Rwinjira muri Chad # Ruca mu bice vy’ubuhinzi n’ibishanga binini # Ruca hafi ya N’Djamena # Ruhurira n’uruzi rwa Logone # Hanyuma rugasuka amazi mu Lake Chad \---- == Uburebure n’ubunini == * Uburebure: hafi 1,400 km * Ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye mu karere ka Sahel * Rutanga igice kinini c’amazi yinjira mu Lake Chad \---- == Imiterere y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Chari rufise ibiranga bikurikira: * Ruca mu mashamba n’ubutaka bwumye bwa Sahel * Rwuzura cane mu bihe vy’imvura * Rufise ibishanga binini ku nkengera * Amazi yarwo ahinduka bivanye n’ibihe \---- == Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Chari == === 1. Lake Chad === Uruzi rwa Chari ni rwo isoko nyamukuru y’amazi ya Lake Chad. === 2. Ubuhinzi === * Rutanga amazi yo kuhira imirima * Ubutaka bwo ku nkengera burumbuka === 3. Uburovyi === * Rutunga amafi menshi * Ni isoko y’ivyokurya ku baturage benshi === 4. Ubuzima bw’abantu === * Amazi yo kunywa * Amazi yo mu ngo * Ubworozi bw’amatungo \---- == Ibinyabuzima == Uruzi rwa Chari rufise: * Amafi y’inzuzi za Sahel * Inyoni zo mu bishanga * Ibimera vyo mu floodplains * Inyamaswa zo mu mazi mu duce tumwe (harimwo hippos) \---- == Ibibazo n’imbogamizi == * Kugabanuka kw’amazi ya Lake Chad * Guhinduka kw’ikirere (imvura idahagije) * Gukoresha amazi ku rugero runini mu kuhira imirima * Isuri n’isenyuka ry’inkengera * Kwanduzwa n’imyanda n’ubuhinzi \---- == Umwanzuro == Uruzi rwa Chari ni uruzi rukomeye cane muri Afrika yo hagati, rufise uruhara runini mu kugaburira Lake Chad, ubuhinzi, uburovyi n’ubuzima bw’abantu. Ni isoko nyamukuru y’amazi y’iki kiyaga, kandi rukeneye kubungabungwa kugira ngo rugume rufasha ibisekuru bizaza.

Uruzi rwa Baro
== Intangamarara == Uruzi rwa Baro ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye zo mu karere ka Afrika y’Ubuseruko, rukaba ruherereye mu bihugu vya Ethiopia na Sudan y’Epfo. Ni uruzi rufise akamaro kanini kuko ruri mu nzuzi zigize sisitemu y’Uruzi rwa Nil (Nile River). Baro ni rwo ruzi runini mu gice ca Sobat River system, rukaba rutwara amazi menshi aturuka mu misozi ya Ethiopia. \---- == Aho ruva n’aho ruja == Uruzi rwa Baro rutangurira mu burengero bushira uburengero bwa Ethiopia, hafi y’intara ya Illubabor. Rugenda ruca mu: * mashamba n’imisozi ya Ethiopia yo mu burengero * rwinjira mu gihugu ca Sudan y’Epfo * rugahurira n’uruzi rwa Pibor, bigakora uruzi rwa Sobat River Sobat na rwo ruca rwinjira mu Nile River (Nil). \---- == Uburebure n’akarere ruhetse == * Uburebure: hafi 306 km (Baro yonyene) * Iyo harimwo amashami yayo (Baro–Akobo–Sobat system), ikagera ku buca bunini cane * Akarere ruhetse (basin) ni kamwe mu duce twinshi dutanga amazi ya Nil \---- == Inzira y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Baro rufise inzira irangwa n’ibi: === 1. Igice co hejuru (Upper Baro) === * Amazi atangura ava mu misozi ya Ethiopia * Hari imvura nyinshi * Uruzi rurihuta === 2. Igice co hagati (Middle Baro) === * Ruca mu mashamba n’ibishanga * Aha ni ho haba ibikorwa vy’uburovyi n’ubuhinzi === 3. Igice co hasi (Lower Baro) === * Rwinjira mu Sudan y’Epfo * Ruhinduka rube runini kandi rutuje * Rurangurukira muri Sobat River \---- == Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Baro == === 1. Isoko ry’amazi ya Nile === Baro ni imwe mu nzuzi zitanga amazi menshi agaburira Uruzi rwa Nil, rukaba ari rwo ruzi runini muri Afrika. === 2. Ubuhinzi === Mu bice ruca, abantu barukoresha mu: * kuvomera imirima * guhinga umuceri, ibigori n’ibindi bihingwa * gukoresha ubutaka burumbuka bwo mu bishanga === 3. Uburovyi === Ibishanga n’imigezi y’uruzi rwa Baro birimwo amafi menshi, bigafasha: * abanyagihugu mu kubona indya * ubudandaji bw’amafi === 4. Ubuhinga bw’amazi === Hari ubushakashatsi ku gukoresha amazi ya Baro mu: * kubyara amashanyarazi * guteza imbere ubuhinzi bwo kuvomerwa \---- == Imiterere y’ibidukikije == Uruzi rwa Baro ruca mu bice bifise: * amashamba y’itoto (tropical forests) * ibishanga binini (wetlands) * ibinyabuzima bitandukanye Ibishanga vya Baro bigize igice c’ingenzi ca Sudd ecosystem ihurirwako n’amazi ya Nile. \---- == Ibibazo n’ingorane == === 1. Amapfa n’imvura idahagije === Naho hari imvura mu misozi ya Ethiopia, ibihe vy’izuba biragabanya amazi. === 2. Kwandura kw’amazi === * imyanda iva mu bisagara * ibikorwa vy’ubuhinzi bikoresha imiti === 3. Gukoresha nabi ubutaka === * guhingira ku nkengera z’uruzi * gutema amashyamba === 4. Ibikorwa vy’abantu hagati y’ibihugu === Kubera ko ruca mu bihugu bibiri (Ethiopia na South Sudan), haba rimwe na rimwe ibibazo bijanye no kugabana amazi. \---- == Umwanzuro == Uruzi rwa Baro ni uruzi runini kandi rufise akamaro kanini mu sisitemu y’Uruzi rwa Nil. Rutanga amazi, rushigikira ubuhinzi, uburovyi, n’ibinyabuzima. Ariko rukenera kurindwa kugira ngo amazi yarwo n’ibidukikije vyo mu nkengera zarwo bikomeze kubaho neza. Nimba ushaka, nagukorera kandi:

Uruzi rwa Akobo
== Intangamarara == Uruzi rwa Akobo ni uruzi ruri mu karere ka Afrika y’Ubuseruko, ruca mu bihugu vya Ethiopia na Sudan y’Epfo. Ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye zigize sisitemu y’uruzi rwa Sobat, ikaza kuba imwe mu mashami akomeye atanga amazi y’uruzi rwa Nil (Nile River). Akobo ni uruzi ruzwi cane mu bishanga binini no mu mibande igoye gucamwo, kandi rufise akamaro kanini mu bidukikije no mu buzima bw’abahaba. \---- == Aho ruva n’aho ruja == Uruzi rwa Akobo rutangurira mu burengero bwa Ethiopia, mu misozi iri hafi y’intara za Gambella Region n’utundi turere two mu burengero bw’igihugu. Ruca mu nzira ikurikira: * ruva mu misozi ya Ethiopia rumanuka * rwinjira mu Sudan y’Epfo * ruhurira n’uruzi rwa Pibor * bigakora uruzi rwa Sobat River * Sobat na rwo rukinjira mu Nil (White Nile) \---- == Uburebure n’akarere ruhetse == * Uburebure: hafi 500–800 km (biterwa n’aho upima inkomoko n’amashami) * Akarere ruhetse: gahuza ibice binini vy’amashamba, ibishanga n’imisozi ya Ethiopia na South Sudan \---- == Imiterere y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Akobo rufise ibice bitandukanye: === 1. Igice co hejuru (Upper Akobo) === * Aha ni mu misozi ya Ethiopia * Amazi atemba vuba * Imvura igira uruhara runini === 2. Igice co hagati (Middle Akobo) === * Ruca mu mashamba n’ibishanga * Amazi atangura gutuza * Haba uburovyi n’ubuhinzi buto buto === 3. Igice co hasi (Lower Akobo) === * Rwinjira mu bishanga binini vya South Sudan wetlands * Ruhurira n’uruzi rwa Pibor * Haca hakorwa Sobat River \---- == Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Akobo == === 1. Igice c’uruzi rwa Nil === Akobo ni imwe mu nzuzi zitanga amazi agaburira: * Sobat River * hanyuma ikagira uruhara mu White Nile === 2. Ubuhinzi === Abantu baba ku nkengera zarwo barukoresha mu: * kuvomera imyaka mito mito * guhinga mu bishanga vyera cane === 3. Uburovyi === Ibishanga n’amazi ya Akobo birimwo: * amafi menshi * ibikoko vyo mu mazi bigafasha abantu mu ndya no mu bucuruzi buto buto. === 4. Ibinyabuzima === Akobo ni igice c’ingenzi c’ibishanga bikomeye vya Afrika, bifasha: * inyoni nyinshi zimukira (migratory birds) * inyamaswa zo mu bishanga * ibinyabuzima vyo mu mazi \---- == Ibibazo n’ingorane == === 1. Ibishanga bigoye kugerwako === * bituma iterambere ry’ingendo rigorana * hari uduce twinshi tutagira amabarabara meza === 2. Amapfa n’imvura idahinduka === * amazi ashobora kugabanuka mu bihe vy’izuba * bigira ingaruka ku buhinzi n’uburovyi === 3. Ibibazo vy’amakimbirane y’akarere === Kubera ruca mu bihugu bibiri, rimwe na rimwe: * haba ikibazo co kugabana ubutaka n’amazi === 4. Kwangirika kw’ibidukikije === * gutema amashyamba * kwagura imirima ku nkengera z’uruzi \---- == Umwanzuro == Uruzi rwa Akobo ni uruzi rufise akamaro kanini mu sisitemu y’uruzi rwa Nil, kuko rutanga amazi akomeza Sobat na White Nile. Ni uruzi rufasha ubuhinzi, uburovyi n’ibinyabuzima, ariko rukenera kurindwa kubera ibibazo vy’amapfa n’ukwangirika kw’ibidukikije. Nimba ushaka, nokuguha kandi:

Uruzi rwa Shebelle
= Uruzi rwa Shebelle (Webi Shabeelle) = Uruzi rwa Shebelle, rwandikwa kandi nka Webi Shabeelle, ni rumwe mu nzuzi nini kandi zizwi zo muri Afurika y’UburasirazuUruzi rwa Shebelle (Webi Shabeelle) \---- == Inkomoko y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Shebelle rutangurira mu misozi miremire ya Etiyopiya (Ethiopian Highlands). Aho hantu harangwa n’imvura nyinshi n’amasoko menshi y’amazi, bikaba ari vyo bituma uruzi rutangura rugira inguvu zikomeye mu ntango yarwo. \---- == Inzira rucamwo == Uruzi rwa Shebelle rutembera mu bice bikurikira: * Rutangurira mu buraruko bushira ubuseruko bwa Etiyopiya * Rukaja mu buseruko no mu bumanuko bushira ubuseruko * Rwinjira muri Somaliya, rugaca hafi y’imijyi nka Beledweyne * Rugakomeza rugana mu bumanuko rugaca mu bice vyegereye Mogadishu Mu nzira yarwo, ruja mu turere twinshi dufise ikirere gishushe kandi kumeze nk’ubugaragwa. \---- == Uburebure n’imiterere y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Shebelle rufise uburebure bungana n’ivyegeranyo vya: * Ihagaragara: hafi km 1,800 (ku bice bitandukanye vy’inyigisho) * Imiterere idasanzwe: rimwe na rimwe ntirushika ku nyanja * Rurangwa n’uko amazi yarwo ahinduka cane hisunzwe igihe c’imvura \---- == Iherezo ry’uruzi == Ikintu kidasanzwe ku ruzi rwa Shebelle ni uko: * Rimwe na rimwe rurakama imbere yo gushika ku Nyanja y’Ubuhinde * Iyo imvura ari nyinshi, rushobora kuguma rutemba rugafasha mu kuzura ibiyaga n’imigezi mito * Rimwe na rimwe, amazi yarwo ashobora kugera mu bice vyo hasi cane vya Somaliya \---- == Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Shebelle == Uruzi rwa Shebelle rufise akamaro kanini cane mu buzima bwa buri munsi: === 1. Ubuhinzi === Rufasha mu kuhira imyaka mu bice vyumye, aho abantu bahinga: * ibigori * amasaka * imboga zitandukanye * imbuto === 2. Ubworozi === Rufasha amatungo kubona amazi, cane cane inka n’ihene mu turere tw’ubugaragwa. === 3. Ubuzima bw’abantu === Abantu benshi baba hafi yarwo barukoresha mu: * kunywa amazi * gukaraba * ibikorwa vya misi yose \---- == Ibibazo vy’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Shebelle rufise n’imbogamizi: * Amazi yarwo agenda ahinduka cane (rimwe rwinshi, rimwe rukeya) * Akarere karukikije karangwa n’amapfa * Ubuhinga bwo kuhira ntiburatera imbere mu bice bimwe \---- == Umwanzuro == Uruzi rwa Shebelle ni uruzi rufise akamaro kanini mu buzima bw’abantu bo muri Etiyopiya na Somaliya. Naho rutandukanye n’izindi nzuzi kubera ko rimwe na rimwe rwuma imbere yo gushika ku nyanja, ruguma ari isoko ikomeye y’amazi, ubuhinzi, n’ubuzima mu karere karangwa n’ubushuhe n’ubugaragwa.

Uruzi rwa Jubba
= Uruzi rwa Jubba (Webi Juba) = Uruzi rwa Jubba, ruzwi kandi nka Webiga Jubba, ni rumwe mu nzuzi nini kandi z’ingenzi zo muri Afurika y’Uburasirazuba, ruva muri Etiyopiya rukanyura muri Somaliya rugasohokera mu Nyanja y’Ubuhinde. \---- == Inkomoko y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Jubba rutangurira mu misozi miremire ya Etiyopiya, aho amazi aturuka ku nzuzi zinyuranye, zirimo: * Dawa River * Ganale Dorya River Izo nzuzi zihurira ku mupaka wa Etiyopiya na Somaliya, zigatangura gukora uruzi rwa Jubba. \---- == Inzira rucamwo == Uruzi rwa Jubba rutembera mu buryo bukurikira: * Ruvuka hafi y’umupaka wa Etiyopiya na Somaliya * Rukanyura mu ntara za Somaliya zo mu bumanuko * Ruca mu turere twa Gedo, Middle Juba na Lower Juba * Rugaca hafi y’imijyi nka Doolow, Luuq, Baardheere, Bu’aale na Kismaayo * Rugasohokera ahitwa Goobweyn, hafi ya Kismaayo, mu Nyanja y’Ubuhinde \---- == Uburebure n’akamaro ka géographie == * Uburebure: hafi km 1,800 – 2,000 (hafi 1,800 km ikoreshwa kenshi mu nyigisho) * Rimwe mu nzuzi ndende zo muri Somaliya * Rufise bassin nini cane ifasha ibice binini vy’igihugu \---- == Ibiranga bidasanzwe == * Rimwe mu nzuzi zitemba umwaka wose mu karere k’ubushuhe * Rufasha ahanini mu kuhira ubuhinzi mu turere twumye * Ruri mu nzuzi zifise ubuzima bwinshi bw’inyamaswa n’ibimera \---- == Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Jubba == === 1. Ubuhinzi === Uruzi rwa Jubba rufasha cane mu kuhira imyaka mu bice vyumutse. Bahinga: * ibigori * amasaka * imbuto * imboga * imbuto z’ubuhinga (cash crops) === 2. Ubuzima bw’abantu === * Isoko y’amazi yo kunywa no gukoresha * Gukaraba no gukorera ibikorwa vya misi yose === 3. Ubworozi === * Inka, ihene n’intama bibona amazi ahagije * Bigatuma ubworozi butera imbere mu turere twa Jubba === 4. Ubucuruzi n’amateka === * Uruzi rwafashije iterambere ry’imijyi ya kera n’ubucuruzi * Rwari n’isoko y’ubuzima ku bwami bwa kera nka Ajuran Empire \---- == Ibibazo n’imbogamizi == * Amapfa ashobora kugabanya amazi * Gucibwa kw’amashyamba mu nkengero z’uruzi * Imihindagurikire y’ibihe ituma amazi adahinduka neza * Ibibazo vy’umutekano mu bice bimwe vya Somaliya \---- == Umwanzuro == Uruzi rwa Jubba ni uruzi rukomeye cane mu buzima bwa Somaliya n’akarere kose karukikije. Rufise akamaro kanini mu buhinzi, ubworozi, amazi n’iterambere ry’abantu, kandi rufatwa nk’imwe mu mitsi ikomeye y’ubuzima mu bumanuko bwa Somaliya.

Uruzi rwa Tekeze
= Uruzi rwa Tekeze (Tekezé / Setit) = Uruzi rwa Tekeze, ruzwi kandi nka Setit, ni rumwe mu nzuzi nini zo muri Afurika y’Uburasirazuba, ruva muri Etiyopiya rukanyura ku mipaka ya Eritrea, hanyuma rugasohokera muri Sudani, rukaza gusohoka mu muryango wa Nile. \---- == Inkomoko y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Tekeze rutangurira mu misozi miremire ya Etiyopiya (Ethiopian Highlands), ahantu hari ubutumburuke buri hejuru cane (bushobora kurenga metero 3,000). Aho ni ho amazi y’imvura n’amasoko atangura guterana agatanga uruzi rukomeye. \---- == Inzira rucamwo == Uruzi rwa Tekeze rutembera mu bice bikurikira: * Rutangurira mu majyaruguru ya Etiyopiya * Ruca mu ntara ya Tigray * Rukora igice c’umupaka hagati ya Etiyopiya na Eritrea * Rukanyura mu burengero bwa Etiyopiya rujya muri Sudani * Rwihurira n’uruzi rwa Atbara, hanyuma rugasohoka mu muryango wa Nile \---- == Uburebure n’akarere ruherereyemwo == * Uburebure: hafi km 608 * Agace rutemberamwo (basin): hafi km² 64,000–69,000 * Ruri mu muryango w’uruzi rwa Nile \---- == Ikibanza kidasanzwe (Geography) == Uruzi rwa Tekeze rurangwa n’ibintu bikomeye: * Ruca mu misozi miremire n’imirongo y’amabuye (canyons) * Rukora imwe mu mibande y’uruzi ndende cane kandi yimbitse muri Afurika * Mu bice bimwe, umwobo warwo urashobora kurenza metero 2,000 z’ubujyakuzimu \---- == Iherezo ry’uruzi == * Rwihurira n’uruzi rwa Atbara muri Sudani * Ayo mazi yose ashirwa mu Nile River, hanyuma akagenda gushika mu Nyanja ya Mediterane \---- == Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Tekeze == === 1. Ubuhinzi === Rufasha mu kuhira imyaka mu bice vyumye vya Etiyopiya na Sudani. === 2. Ingufu z’amashanyarazi === Ku ruzi rwa Tekeze hubatswe urugomero rwa Tekeze Dam, rutanga amashanyarazi ku gihugu ca Etiyopiya. === 3. Amazi n’ubuzima === Ni isoko y’amazi ku bantu n’amatungo mu turere twumye. === 4. Ibidukikije === Rufise ibinyabuzima bitandukanye kandi rufasha mu kubungabunga ecosystem yo mu misozi n’imisozi miremire. \---- == Ibibazo n’imbogamizi == * Imihindagurikire y’ibihe ituma amazi agabanuka canke yiyongera cane * Isuri ikomeye mu mibande y’uruzi * Gukoresha amazi mu bikorwa vy’ubuhinzi n’ingomero bishobora kugira ingaruka ku bidukikije \---- == Umwanzuro == Uruzi rwa Tekeze ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye za Etiyopiya n’akarere ka Nile. Rufise akamaro kanini mu ngufu z’amashanyarazi, ubuhinzi n’amazi, kandi rufise n’akamaro kanini mu mateka n’umuco w’akarere karwo.

Uruzi rwa Pibor
Uruzi rwa Pibor ni rumwe mu nzuzi z’ingenzi zo muri Afurika y’Uburasirazuba, ruherereye ahanini mu gihugu ca Sudani y’Epfo. Ni uruzi rugira uruhara rukomeye mu muryango w’uruzi rwa Nile, kuko rufasha kugaburira amazi y’uruzi rwa Sobat, hanyuma bigasohoka mu Nile Yera (White Nile). \---- == Inkomoko y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Pibor rutangurira mu bice vyegereye umupaka wa na . Ruvuka mu misozi n’ahantu hagwa imvura mu bihe bimwe, bigatuma uruzi rufise amazi ahindagurika hisunzwe ibihe vy’umwaka. \---- == Inzira rucamwo == Uruzi rwa Pibor rutembera mu buryo bukurikira: * Ruvuka hafi y’umupaka wa Etiyopiya * Rwinjira mu buseruko bwa Sudani y’Epfo * Ruca mu karere kazwi nka Greater Pibor Administrative Area * Rukomeza rugana mu burengero gushika ruhuye n’uruzi rwa Sobat River * Hanyuma amazi yarwo agasohoka mu Nile Yera \---- == Ibiranga uruzi rwa Pibor == * Ni uruzi rufise imihindagurikire y’amazi ikomeye * Rimwe na rimwe ruba rufise amazi menshi mu gihe c’imvura, rukongera rukagabanuka mu gihe c’izuba * Rufasha mu gukora ibishanga n’ahantu hatandukanye h’ibinyabuzima (wetlands) \---- == Uburebure n’akarere ruherereyemwo == * Uburebure bwose ntibumenyekana neza kubera inzira nyinshi z’amazi zihinduka * Ruri mu sisiteme y’uruzi rwa Nile Basin * Rufasha mu gukwiragiza amazi mu bice binini vy’ubuseruko bwa Sudani y’Epfo \---- == Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Pibor == === 1. Amazi n’ubuzima === Uruzi rwa Pibor ni isoko y’amazi ku bantu n’amatungo mu bice vyegereye uruzi. === 2. Ubworozi === Mu bice rucamwo, ubworozi bw’inka, ihene n’intama burakorwa cane, kandi amazi y’uruzi ni ngirakamaro cane. === 3. Ibidukikije === Rufasha mu kubungabunga: * ibishanga (wetlands) * ibinyabuzima bitandukanye * inyoni n’inyamaswa zo mu bishanga \---- == Ibibazo n’imbogamizi == * Amapfa n’imvura idahinduka neza * Imyuzure ishobora kwangiza imidugudu * Intambara n’umutekano muke mu bice bimwe vya Sudani y’Epfo * Guhindagurika kw’ibihe (climate change) \---- == Umwanzuro == Uruzi rwa Pibor ni uruzi rukomeye mu bidukikije vya Sudani y’Epfo, kandi rufise uruhara runini mu muryango w’uruzi rwa Nile. Naho rutaba ruzwi cane nk’izindi nzuzi nini, rufasha cane mu buzima, ubworozi n’ibidukikije mu karere karwo.

Uruzi rwa Lol
Uruzi rwa Lol ni rumwe mu nzuzi zo muri Afurika y’Uburasirazuba, ruherereye ahanini mu gihugu ca . Ni uruzi ruto ugereranije n’izindi nzuzi nini, ariko rufise akamaro mu bidukikije no mu buzima bw’abantu bo mu ntara rucamwo. \---- == Inkomoko y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Lol rutangurira mu bice vyo mu buraruko bushira uburengero bwa South Sudan, hafi y’ahantu harangwa n’imvura n’amashyamba make n’amasavana. Amazi yarwo ava mu nzuzi nto nto n’imigezi itandukanye ihurira hamwe. \---- == Inzira rucamwo == Uruzi rwa Lol rutembera mu buryo bukurikira: * Rutangurira mu buraruko bushira uburengero bwa South Sudan * Ruca mu ntara ya Western Bahr el Ghazal * Rukomeza rugana mu bumanuko bushira uburengero * Hanyuma rugasohokera mu muryango w’uruzi rwa Bahr el-Arab, umwe mu nzuzi zigize sisiteme ya Nile \---- == Ibiranga uruzi rwa Lol == * Ni uruzi ruto ugereranije n’izindi nzuzi zo muri ako karere * Rurangwa n’uko amazi yaryo ahinduka hisunzwe ibihe vy’imvura * Rimwe na rimwe ruba rufise amazi menshi mu gihe c’imvura, rukagabanuka cane mu gihe c’izuba * Ruri mu muryango munini w’uruzi rwa Nile Basin \---- == Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Lol == === 1. Amazi y’abantu n’amatungo === Uruzi rwa Lol rufasha abaturage kubona amazi yo: * kunywa * gukoresha mu ngo * amatungo (inka, ihene) === 2. Ubuhinzi === Mu bice rucamwo, rufasha mu kuhira imyaka mito mito nk: * amasaka * ibigori * imboga === 3. Ibidukikije === Rufasha mu kubungabunga: * ibishanga bito * ibimera vyo mu savana * inyamaswa zo mu karere karwo \---- == Ibibazo n’imbogamizi == * Amapfa akomeye mu bihe vy’izuba * Imvura idahinduka neza * Isuri mu bice bimwe * Ubushobozi buke bwo kubungabunga amazi \---- == Umwanzuro == Uruzi rwa Lol ni uruzi ruto ariko rufise akamaro kanini mu buzima bw’abaturage bo mu burengero bwa . Rurafasha mu mazi, ubuhinzi n’ibidukikije, kandi ruri mu nzuzi zigize sisiteme ikomeye y’uruzi rwa Nile.

Uruzi rwa Ruzizi
Uruzi rwa Ruzizi ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye zo mu karere k’Ibiyaga Binini (Great Lakes region) muri Afurika y’Uburasirazuba. Ruzizi ruva mu Ikiyaga ca Kivu, rugaca ku mipaka y’ibihugu bitatu, hanyuma rugasohokera mu Ikiyaga ca Tanganyika. \---- == Inkomoko y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Ruzizi rutangurira mu Ikiyaga ca Kivu, kiri hagati ya: * * Amazi ava mu Kivu ni yo atangura gukora uruzi rwa Ruzizi, agaca mu majyepfo. \---- == Inzira rucamwo == Uruzi rwa Ruzizi rutembera mu bice bikurikira: * Rutangurira mu Ikiyaga ca Kivu * Rukamanuka rugaca ku mupaka wa Rwanda na DR Congo * Rukanyura mu buraruko bwa Burundi * Hanyuma rugasohokera mu Ikiyaga ca Tanganyika \---- == Uburebure n’imiterere == * Uburebure: hafi km 117 * Ni uruzi rugufi ugereranije n’izindi nzuzi, ariko rufise inguvu nyinshi * Rurangwa n’aho rugwa mu marembo n’amazi amanuka vuba (rapids) \---- == Ibiranga bidasanzwe == * Ruzizi ni uruzi rufise inguvu z’amazi zishobora gukoreshwa mu mashanyarazi * Rurangwa n’aho rutemba ruvuye mu kiyaga rujya mu kindi kiyaga * Ruri mu karere karangwa n’imisozi n’ibiyaga binini \---- == Ingomero n’ingufu == Ku ruzi rwa Ruzizi hari ingomero zikomeye zitanga amashanyarazi: * Ruzizi I * Ruzizi II * Ruzizi III (iri mu mishinga y’iterambere) Izo ngomero zifasha mu gutanga amashanyarazi mu bihugu vya: * * * \---- == Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Ruzizi == === 1. Ingufu z’amashanyarazi === Ni isoko ikomeye y’ingufu z’amashanyarazi mu karere k’Ibiyaga Binini. === 2. Ubuhinzi === Amazi yarwo afasha mu kuhira imyaka mu bice vyo ku nkombe z’uruzi. === 3. Ibidukikije === Rufasha mu: * kubungabunga ibinyabuzima vyo mu mazi * gutuma ibiyaga bibiri bifitanye isano y’amazi === 4. Ubuzima n’iterambere === Rufasha mu: * kunywa amazi * uburobyi mu kiyaga ca Tanganyika * iterambere ry’imijyi yo hafi yarwo \---- == Ibibazo n’imbogamizi == * Isuri mu bice ruca * Guhindagurika kw’amazi hisunzwe imvura * Gukenera imishinga myinshi yo kurinda ibidukikije * Imihindagurikire y’ibihe (climate change) \---- == Umwanzuro == Uruzi rwa Ruzizi ni uruzi rukomeye mu karere k’Ibiyaga Binini, rufitaniye isano ikomeye n’ibiyaga vya Kivu na Tanganyika. Naho ruba rugufi, rufise akamaro kanini mu mashanyarazi, ubuhinzi n’iterambere ry’ibihugu vya Rwanda, Burundi na DR Congo.

Uruzi rwa Lukuga
Uruzi rwa Lukuga ni uruzi rudasanzwe kandi rufise akamaro kanini mu karere k’Ibiyaga Binini (Great Lakes region) muri Afurika y’Uburasirazuba. Ni rwo ruzi rusohora amazi y’Ikiyaga ca Tanganyika rugatwara ayo mazi mu ruzi rwa Congo. \---- == Inkomoko y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Lukuga rutangurira ku nkengero y’Ikiyaga ca Tanganyika, ahanini mu gihugu ca: * Iyo urwego rw’amazi mu kiyaga ruzamutse, ni ho uruzi rwa Lukuga rutangura gutemba. \---- == Inzira rucamwo == Uruzi rwa Lukuga rutembera mu buryo bukurikira: * Rutangurira mu burengero bw’Ikiyaga ca Tanganyika * Ruca mu ntara za Tanganyika (DR Congo) * Rukomeza rugana mu buraruko bushira uburengero * Hanyuma rugasohokera mu Uruzi rwa Lualaba, arirwo rutangura Uruzi rwa Congo \---- == Ibiranga uruzi rwa Lukuga == * Ni uruzi rudasanzwe kuko rutemba rimwe na rimwe (intermittent influence) hisunzwe urwego rw’amazi mu Tanganyika * Rurafasha gusohora amazi y’iki kiyaga gishaje cane (imwe mu biyaga vyimbitse ku isi) * Rurangwa n’inguvu z’amazi mu bice bimwe vy’amakoni n’amanuka \---- == Uburebure n’imiterere == * Uburebure: hafi km 350 (biterwa n’aho bipimirwa) * Rurangwa n’aho ruca mu mashyamba n’imisozi mito * Ruri mu sisiteme y’uruzi rwa Congo Basin \---- == Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Lukuga == === 1. Gusohora amazi y’Ikiyaga ca Tanganyika === Lukuga ni rwo ruzi rwonyene rusohora amazi ya Tanganyika mu bindi bice. === 2. Ubworozi n’ubuhinzi === Amazi yarwo afasha mu: * kuhira imyaka * ubworozi mu turere rucamwo === 3. Uburobyi === Mu bice vyo hafi yarwo, harakorwa uburobyi bufise akamaro mu buzima bw’abaturage. === 4. Ibidukikije === Rufasha mu: * kugenzura urwego rw’amazi mu Tanganyika * kubungabunga ibinyabuzima vyo mu mazi \---- == Ibibazo n’imbogamizi == * Guhindagurika kw’amazi y’Ikiyaga ca Tanganyika * Isuri mu bice rucamwo * Gukenera kurindwa kugira ngo urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima rubeho neza * Imihindagurikire y’ibihe \---- == Umwanzuro == Uruzi rwa Lukuga ni uruzi rudasanzwe cane mu karere k’Ibiyaga Binini, kuko rufasha gusohora amazi y’Ikiyaga ca Tanganyika mu muryango w’uruzi rwa Congo. Naho rutaba rurerure cane, rufise akamaro kanini mu bidukikije, uburobyi n’imiterere y’amazi y’akarere.

Uruzi rwa Luvua
ni uruzi runini ruherereye mu gihugu ca Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo (RDC), mu karere k’ubuseruko. Ni rumwe mu migezi ikomeye ifasha mu gutanga amazi y’uruzi runini rwa Congo, kandi rufite akamaro kanini mu bidukikije, ubuhinga bwo gutwara abantu n’ibintu, hamwe n’ubuzima bw’abaturage bo muri ako karere. \---- == 1. Inkomoko y’uruzi rwa Luvua == Uruzi rwa Luvua rutangura ku iyaga rya Mweru (Lake Mweru), iri ku rubibe hagati ya RDC na Zambiya. Amazi y’iryo yaga niyo asohokamwo agatangura gukora uruzi rwa Luvua. Iyi nkomoko ituma Luvua ruba uruzi rufise isoko ikomeye y’amazi aturuka mu biyaga n’imvura igwa muri ako karere. \---- == 2. Aho rugeze n’aho rujya == Uruzi rwa Luvua rutembera rwerekeza mu buraruko, rugaca mu ntara ya Haut-Katanga mu gihugu ca RDC. Rugenda rugaburira uruzi rwa Lualaba, ari rwo rutangurirako uruzi rwa Congo. Iyo Luvua rugeze ku Lualaba, rufasha kongereza amazi menshi yinjira muri sisitemu y’uruzi rwa Congo, rumwe mu migezi minini kw’isi. \---- == 3. Uburebure n’akarere ruherereyemwo == Naho uburebure nyabwo bushobora guhinduka bivanye n’inyishu zitandukanye, uruzi rwa Luvua ruri mu migezi miremire yo muri RDC. Ruciye mu: * ibibaya, * imisozi mito mito, * n’ahantu hari amashyamba n’ibiti vyinshi. Aka karere karangwa n’ubutaka burumbuka kubera imyuzure y’uruzi. \---- == 4. Imiterere y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Luvua rufise: * amazi atemba ku muvuduko utandukanye bivanye n’ibihe, * ibice bifise amazi menshi mu gihe c’imvura, * n’ibice bitari bike birimwo amabuye n’umusenyi. Rufasha kandi mu gukora ibiyaga bito bito n’imiyoboro y’amazi isanzwe ikoreshwa n’ibinyabuzima. \---- == 5. Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Luvua == === 5.1 Mu bidukikije === * Rutuma habaho ubuzima bw’ibinyabuzima vyinshi (amafi, inyoni, n’ibindi). * Rufasha mu kubungabunga uruzitiro rw’ibimera n’amashyamba. * Rutanga uburumbuke bw’ubutaka ku nkengero zarwo. === 5.2 Mu buzima bw’abantu === * Ni isoko y’amafi ku baturage bo mu karere. * Rukoreshwa mu kuvomerera imyaka. * Rimwe na rimwe rukoreshwa mu gutwara ibintu ku nzuzi nto nto zijana narwo. === 5.3 Mu buhinga bw’amazi === * Ruri mu migezi igaburira uruzi rwa Congo, rumwe mu migezi ifise akamaro kanini mu isi. * Rutanga umusanzu mu kugenzura urugero rw’amazi mu karere. \---- == 6.
