Ibidukikije n’ibibazo bihari == Nka migezi myinshi yo muri Afurika, uruzi rwa Luvua ruhura n’ibibazo bitandukanye: * Gucibwa kw’amashyamba ku nkengero zarwo * Isenyuka ry’ubutaka (erosion) * Ihindagurika ry’ibihe rituma amazi yiyongera canke agabanuka * Udukoko n’umwanda ahantu hatandukanye Ibi bibazo bishobora kugira ingaruka ku buzima bw’abantu n’ibinyabuzima. \---- == 7. Akamaro mu mateka n’iterambere == Akarere uruzi rwa Luvua ruherereyemwo karigeze gukoreshwa mu: * guhanahana ibidandazwa hagati y’uturere two muri RDC, * uburovyi bwari isoko y’ubuzima, * n’imirimo y’ubuhinzi ku nkengero zarwo. N’ubu rukiri ingenzi mu buzima bwa buri munsi bw’abaturage bo muri Haut-Katanga. \---- == 8. Umwanzuro == Uruzi rwa Luvua ni uruzi rukomeye mu sisitemu y’imigezi ya . Rutanga umusanzu ukomeye mu bidukikije, mu bukungu bw’abaturage, no mu kugaburira amazi y’uruzi rwa Congo. Kubera akamaro karwo, ni ngombwa kubungabunga ibidukikije birugose kugira ngo rukomeze gufasha ibisekuruza biri imbere. Niba ushaka, nagukorera kandi:

Uruzi rwa Ituri
Uruzi rwa Ituri River ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye zo mu buraruko bushira ubuseruko bwa Democratic Republic of the Congo. Ni uruzi rufise uruhara runini cane mu gukora uruzi runini ruzwi kw’izina rya Aruwimi, hanyuma rugasohokera mu Congo River. \---- == 1. Aho ruherereye n’akamaro k’izina == Uruzi rwa Ituri ruherereye mu karere kazwi nka Ituri Province, kari mu buraruko bushira ubuseruko bwa RDC. * Izina “Ituri” riva ku ruzi nyene * Rwatanze izina kuri Ituri Province * Ruca mu Ituri Rainforest, rimwe mu mashamba manini ya Congo Basin \---- == 2. Aho ruva n’aho rujana == Uruzi rwa Ituri rutangura mu misozi iri hafi y’ikiyaga ca Lake Albert mu ntara ya Haut-Uélé. Inzira yarwo: * Rutangura mu migezi mito mito yo mu misozi * Ruca mu bice vya Mongbwalu, Irumu na Komanda * Rwunguruka mu mashamba manini ya Ituri Forest * Rurasuka muri Nepoko River * Hanyuma rugakora uruzi rwa Aruwimi River (ku Bomili) Nyuma Aruwimi ni yo yisuka muri Congo River. \---- == 3. Uburebure n’imiterere == * Uburebure: hafi 650 km * Ni uruzi rurekure kandi ruca mu mashamba manini * Rurangwa n’udusumo (rapids) n’ahantu amazi yihuta * Rufise amazi menshi cane mu bihe vy’imvura \---- == 4. Ituri Rainforest == Uruzi rwa Ituri ruca mu Ituri Rainforest, ishamha rinini cane rifise: * Ubuso burenga 63,000 km² * Ibiti n’ibimera vyinshi vya tropique * Inyamaswa nyinshi (okapi, inkende, inyoni, n’izindi) * Akarere kamwe mu bibanza bikomeye vya biodiversity kw’isi Iri shamba rifashwa cane n’uruzi mu gutanga amazi n’ubuzima ku binyabuzima. \---- == 5. Uruhare mu gukora Aruwimi River == Uruzi rwa Ituri ni rwo runini rwose rutuma havuka Aruwimi: * Ituri + Nepoko River = Aruwimi River * Iyi ni inzira ikomeye itwara amazi ava mu mashamba y’imbere ya Congo * Aruwimi nayo ni imwe mu nzuzi zinjira muri Congo River \---- == 6. Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Ituri == === 6.1 Ubuzima bw’abantu === Abantu baba ku nkengera barukoresha: * mu kuroba ifi * mu gutwara ibintu n’amato mato * mu gukoresha amazi ku mirima mito === 6.2 Uburovyi === * Ifi zo mu ruzi ni isoko y’ifunguro n’ubudandaji === 6.3 Ibidukikije === * Rufasha mu kugumana ubukonje bw’ishamba * Rugira uruhara mu gucunga amazi ya Congo Basin \---- == 7. Amateka == Uruzi rwa Ituri rwaramenyekanye cane mu gihe c’abashakashatsi n’abakoroni: * rwarakoreshwa mu gushika mu mashamba ya Congo atari yarashikwako * rwavuzwe mu nyandiko za Stanley n’abandi bashakashatsi ba Afurika yo hagati * rwari inzira y’ingenzi yo gutahura imbere mu Congo Basin \---- == 8. Ibibazo n’imbogamizi == * Ishamba rinini rituma kugenzura uruzi bigorana * Uduseke tw’udusumo (rapids) dutuma ubwikorezi bugorana * Indwara n’ukutagerwaho neza mu bice bimwe * Impinduka z’ibihe (climate change) zishobora kugabanya canke kwongera amazi \---- == 9. Umwanzuro == Uruzi rwa Ituri ni uruzi runini kandi rukomeye mu bidukikije vya Congo Basin. Ni rwo rutuma havuka Aruwimi, kandi rufise uruhara runini mu: * kubungabunga Ituri Rainforest * gutanga amazi n’ibifungurwa ku bantu * gutuma ibinyabuzima vyinshi bibaho * gufasha mu mikorere y’inzuzi za Congo

Uruzi rwa Lomami
Uruzi rwa ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye zo mu gihugu ca , ruherereye mu gice co hagati n’ico mu bumanuko bwa Congo Basin. Ni uruzi rurekure, ruca mu mashamba manini ya tropique, kandi rufise uruhara runini mu bidukikije no mu mibereho y’abantu baba ku nkengera zarwo. \---- == 1. Aho ruherereye n’inzira yarwo == Uruzi rwa Lomami rutangura mu mashamba y’imvura ari hagati ya RDC, mu ntara ziri nk’Haut-Lomami n’utundi turere two hafi. Inzira yarwo: * Rutangura mu migezi mito mito yo mu mashamba * Ruca mu ntara za Haut-Lomami, Tanganyika n’ibindi bice vy’ishamba * Rukomeza rugana mu buraruko bushira uburengero * Rurasuka muri Lomami ni rumwe mu nzuzi zifasha cane mu kugaburira amazi Congo River ava mu mashamba y’imbere. \---- == 2. Uburebure n’imiterere == * Uburebure: hafi 1,500 km (mu bipimo bitandukanye) * Ruca mu mashamba manini ya Congo Basin * Rurangwa n’udusumo (rapids) mu bice bimwe * Rufise imigezi myinshi irukomokako * Amazi yarwo yongera cane mu bihe vy’imvura Imiterere yarwo ituma rutaba uruzi rworoshe kugenderwako n’amato manini, ariko rufasha amato mato n’uburovyi. \---- == 3. Ibidukikije n’ibinyabuzima == Uruzi rwa Lomami ruca mu gice gifise biodiversity nyinshi cane. Mu nkengera zarwo haraboneka: * ibiti binini vya tropique * inyamaswa nka inkende, ingwe, n’inyoni nyinshi * amafi menshi atandukanye * ibice bimwe birimwo ibinyabuzima bitaramenyekana neza Hari kandi Lomami National Park, isanzwe ifise ibinyabuzima bidasanzwe kandi bikingiwe. \---- == 4. Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Lomami == === 4.1 Ubuzima bw’abantu === Abantu baba ku nkengera barukoresha: * mu kuroba ifi * mu gukoresha amazi mu mirima mito mito * mu gutembera n’amato mato === 4.2 Ubwikorezi === * Naho atari inzira nini y’amato, rufasha cane mu bice bidafise amabarabara * Amato mato ni yo akoreshwa cane === 4.3 Ubuhinga n’ubushakashatsi === * Ni uruzi rukomeye mu kwiga ibidukikije vya Congo Basin * Rukoreshwa mu bushakashatsi ku nyamaswa n’ibimera vya tropique \---- == 5. Amateka n’ugushakashaza == Lomami rwaramenyekanye mu bihe vy’abashakashatsi b’abakoroni: * rwakoreshwa mu gushika mu mashamba y’imbere ya Congo * rwafashije mu gushushanya amakarata ya Congo Basin * rwari inzira y’ingenzi mu ngendo zo gutahura Afurika yo hagati Mu gihe ca vuba, akarere karwo karashimwa cane kubera ubudasa bw’ibinyabuzima. \---- == 6. Ibibazo n’imbogamizi == * Ishamba rinini rituma kugenzura uruzi bigorana * Uduseke tw’udusumo dutuma ubwikorezi bugorana * Gutema amashyamba mu bice bimwe * Impinduka z’ibihe (climate change) zishobora guhindura urwego rw’amazi * Kutagerwako neza mu bice bimwe vy’imbere \---- == 7. Akamaro mu bidukikije vya Congo Basin == Lomami ni igice gikomeye ca system ya Congo Basin: * rifasha gutwara amazi menshi ava mu mashamba * rifasha kugumana ubukonje bw’ishamba rinini * rifasha kubungabunga ecosystem nini ya Afurika yo hagati * rifasha mu guhuza imigezi mito mito na Congo River \---- == 8. Umwanzuro == Uruzi rwa Lomami ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye kandi zitari zimenyerewe cane ariko zifise akamaro kanini mu bidukikije vya Congo Basin. Ruca mu mashamba manini, rutanga ubuzima ku binyabuzima vyinshi, kandi rufasha abantu baba mu bice bitagerwako vyoroshe.

Uruzi rwa Lualaba
Uruzi rwa ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye cane zo mu gihugu ca , kandi ni rwo rufatwa nk’isoko nyamukuru y’uruzi rwa Congo. Mu bindi vyose, Lualaba ni igice co hejuru (upper course) c’uruzi rwa . \---- == 1. Akamaro k’izina n’aho ruherereye == Izina “Lualaba” rikoreshwa mu gice co mu bumanuko bwa RDC, cane cane mu ntara ya Haut-Katanga na Lualaba Province. * “Lualaba” ni uruzi rumwe mu nzuzi zifise amateka akomeye mu gutahura Congo Basin * Ruzwi nk’isoko nyamukuru ya Congo River * Ruca mu turere dufise amabuye y’agaciro menshi \---- == 2. Aho ruva n’aho rujana == Lualaba rutangura mu misozi iri hafi y’akarere ka Katanga Plateau (mu bumanuko bwa RDC). Inzira yarwo: * Rutangura mu migezi mito mito yo mu misozi ya Katanga * Ruca mu ntara za Haut-Katanga na Lualaba * Rurengana n’ibiyaga n’imigezi myinshi * Rwinjira mu bice vy’udusumo twinshi (rapids) * Hanyuma rugakomereza rugana mu buraruko, aho ruhinduka Congo River \---- == 3. Lualaba ni isoko ya Congo River == Ibi ni kimwe mu bintu bikomeye cane: * Lualaba ni source headstream ya Congo River * Iyo ruvanywe aho, amazi yarwo akomeza kuzamuka mu majyaruguru * Hanyuma rufatanya n’indi migezi rugakora uruzi rwa Congo Ni co gituma Lualaba ifatwa nk’intango ya sisitemu yose ya Congo River. \---- == 4. Uburebure n’imiterere == * Uburebure: hafi 1,800 km (bitewe n’aho bipimirwa) * Ruca mu bice vyose: imisozi, ibibaya n’ishamba * Rurangwa n’udusumo twinshi n’imigende yihuta * Rimwe na rimwe rufise ibiyaga bitoya n’udusumo twinshi * Amazi yarwo akomoka ku mvura nyinshi yo mu karere ka tropique \---- == 5. Imiterere y’ibidukikije == Lualaba ruca mu bice bitandukanye: * Mu bumanuko: ibibaya n’imisozi (savanna + mining zones) * Mu buraruko: ishamba rinini rya tropique * Biodiversity nyinshi: amafi, inyoni, n’inyamaswa zo mu mazi Rifasha guhuza ibidukikije vy’imisozi n’ivyo mu mashamba. \---- == 6. Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Lualaba == === 6.1 Ubwikorezi === * Rimwe na rimwe rukoreshwa mu gutwara abantu n’ibintu * Ariko rapids nyinshi zituma ubwikorezi bugorana === 6.2 Amabuye y’agaciro n’ubutunzi === * Ruca mu karere gakize kuri copper na cobalt * Ni ingenzi mu bikorwa vy’ubucukuzi muri Katanga === 6.3 Uburovyi === * Ifi nyinshi zitanga ifunguro ku baturage === 6.4 Ingufu (hydro potential) === * Rufise ubushobozi bunini bwo gutanga amashanyarazi * Hari imigambi y’ingomero z’amashanyarazi mu karere karwo \---- == 7. Amateka n’ubushakashatsi == Lualaba rwaragize uruhara rukomeye mu mateka: * Mu kinjana ca 19, abashakashatsi nka Henry Morton Stanley bararukoresheje mu gushakisha isoko ya Congo * Hari igihe bitazwi neza ko Lualaba ari yo Congo ya hejuru * Nyuma vyaramenyekanye ko ari yo intango nyamukuru ya Congo River \---- == 8. Ibibazo n’imbogamizi == * Udusumo twinshi (rapids) dutuma ubwikorezi bugorana * Ubucukuzi bw’amabuye bushobora kwonona ibidukikije * Gutema amashyamba mu bice bimwe * Impinduka z’ibihe zigira ingaruka ku rugero rw’amazi * Ibikorwa vy’abantu bishobora guhindura inzira y’uruzi \---- == 9. Akamaro muri Congo Basin == Lualaba ni urufatiro rwa sisitemu yose ya Congo River: * ni rwo rutanga amazi menshi ya Congo * rugira uruhara mu guhuza imisozi, ibibaya n’ishamba rinini * rufasha mu kugabanya ubushuhe n’imvura mu karere * ni ishingiro ry’ubuzima bwa Congo Basin yose \---- == 10. Umwanzuro == Uruzi rwa Lualaba ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye cane muri Afrika, kuko ari rwo rutangura uruzi rwa Congo. Rufise uruhara runini mu bidukikije, mu butunzi (copper/cobalt region), no mu mateka y’ubushakashatsi bwa Afurika yo hagati.

Uruzi rwa Kwango
Uruzi rwa ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye zo mu karere ka Afurika yo hagati, ruca mu bihugu bibiri ari vyo na . Ni uruzi runini rufise uruhara rukomeye mu gukora uruzi rwa Kasai, rujana amazi mu ruzi rwa Congo. \---- == 1. Aho ruherereye n’inzira yarwo == Kwango rutangura mu bumanuko bwa Angola, mu misozi n’ibibaya bifise imvura nyinshi. Inzira yarwo: * Rutangura mu ntara za Angola (plateau yo mu bumanuko bushira ubuseruko) * Ruca hafi canke rugakora nk’umupaka hagati ya Angola na RDC mu bice bimwe * Rwinjira mu gihugu ca RDC mu burengero * Rurasuka muri Kasai nayo ni imwe mu nzuzi zikomeye zinjira muri . \---- == 2. Uburebure n’imiterere == * Uburebure: hafi 1,100 km (mu bipimo bitandukanye) * Ruca mu mashamba ya tropique hamwe n’ibibaya vya savanna * Rurangwa n’imigezi myinshi n’udusumo (rapids) * Amazi yaryo ariyongera cane mu bihe vy’imvura * Rimwe na rimwe ruca mu bice bigoye kugenderwako \---- == 3. Ibice ruhekeranye na byo == Kwango ruca mu turere twinshi: === Mu Angola === * Ibibaya vy’ubuhinzi * Ishamba rya tropique mu bice bimwe * Imidugudu mito mito ku nkengera === Mu RDC === * Ishamba rinini riri mu burengero bwa Congo * Ibice vy’uguhinga n’uburovyi * Uturere two mu ntara ya Kwango (yahawe izina n’uruzi) \---- == 4. Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Kwango == === 4.1 Uburovyi === * Ifi zo mu ruzi ni isoko y’ifunguro ku baturage benshi * Ubu ni bumwe mu buryo nyamukuru bwo kwibeshaho === 4.2 Ubuhinzi === * Amazi y’uruzi akoreshwa mu kuvomera imirima * Ibibaya vy’uruzi bifise ubutaka burumbuka === 4.3 Ubwikorezi === * Amato mato akoreshwa mu gutwara abantu n’ibintu * Ariko rapids zituma ubwikorezi bugorana mu bice bimwe === 4.4 Ibidukikije === * Rukomeza ubuzima bwa ecosystem ya Kasai basin * Rufasha mu kugumana amazi n’ubukonje mu karere \---- == 5. Uruhare muri sisitemu ya Congo Basin == Kwango ni igice c’ingenzi mu “drainage system” ya Congo: * Kwango → Kasai River → Congo River * Rutanga amazi menshi ava mu bumanuko bwa Afrika yo hagati * Rufasha guhuza ibidukikije vya Angola na Congo \---- == 6. Ibinyabuzima n’ibidukikije == Mu nkengera za Kwango haboneka: * amafi menshi atandukanye * inyoni zo mu mazi * ibiti n’ibimera vya tropique * inyamaswa zo mu mashamba (inkende, n’ibindi) Ibice bimwe biracyafise ibidukikije bitaragerwako cane n’abantu. \---- == 7. Amateka n’akamaro k’abantu == * Uruzi rwarakoreshwa kuva kera mu buzima bw’abanyagihugu * Rwafashije mu kwagura ubuhinzi n’imidugudu * Mu bihe vy’ubukoloni rwarakoreshwa nk’inzira y’ugushika mu bice vy’imbere * Izina “Kwango” ryahaye n’intara ya Kwango Province muri RDC \---- == 8. Ibibazo n’imbogamizi == * Uduseke tw’udusumo (rapids) dutuma ubwikorezi bugorana * Gutema amashyamba mu bice bimwe * Impinduka z’ibihe zishobora guhindura urwego rw’amazi * Guhumana kw’amazi mu bice vyegereye imidugudu \---- == 9. Umwanzuro == Uruzi rwa Kwango ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye zifasha mu gutanga amazi muri sisitemu ya Congo Basin. Ruca mu bihugu bibiri, Angola na RDC, kandi rufise uruhara runini mu: * uburovyi * ubuhinzi * ibidukikije * no mu gukora uruzi rwa Kasai, rujana amazi muri Congo River

Uruzi rwa Ogooué
Uruzi rwa Ogooué River (ruzwi kandi nka Ogowe) ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye cane mu burengero bwa Afurika yo hagati, cane cane mu gihugu ca Gabon. Ni rwo ruzi nyamukuru rwa Gabon kandi rufatwa nk’imwe mu nzuzi nini zifise amazi menshi ku isi. \---- == 1. Aho ruherereye == Ogooué ruca mu bihugu bibiri: * Gabon (igice kinini cane c’inzira yarwo) * Igice gito ca Republic of the Congo Rutwara amazi ava hafi mu gihugu cose ca Gabon, bityo rufatwa nk’uruzi rufata hafi igihugu cose (drainage system nini). \---- == 2. Aho ruva n’aho rujana == * Inkomoko: mu misozi ya Chaillu Massif (hafi ya Congo) * Ruca mu buraruko bushira uburengero bwa Gabon, hanyuma rugahindukira rugana mu burengero n’ubumanuko * Rurasuka mu nyanja ya Atlantique hafi ya Port-Gentil 👉 Inzira nyamukuru: Chaillu Mountains → Gabon inland → delta → Atlantic Ocean \---- == 3. Uburebure n’imiterere == * Uburebure: hafi 900–1,200 km * Ni uruzi runini cane rufise amazi menshi (high discharge) * Ruca mu mashamba y’imvura (rainforest) hafi yose * Rufise ibice birimwo ibishanga n’udusumo (rapids) * Rukora delta nini mbere yo gushika mu nyanja \---- == 4. Ibice ruhekeranye na byo == Ogooué ruca mu ntara nyinshi za Gabon: * Haut-Ogooué * Ogooué-Ivindo * Ogooué-Lolo * Moyen-Ogooué * Ogooué-Maritime \---- == 5. Ibidukikije (Ecology) == Ogooué ni uruzi rufise biodiversity ikomeye cane: * Ishamba rinini rya tropique * Amafi menshi atandukanye * Inyamaswa nka ingona zitatu z’Afurika (Nile crocodile, dwarf crocodile, slender-snouted crocodile) * Ibishanga n’amashyamba yegereye amazi Ni kimwe mu bibanza bikomeye vya ecosystem muri Afurika yo hagati. \---- == 6. Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Ogooué == === 6.1 Ubwikorezi === * Rukoreshwa mu gutwara ibiti (wood/logging transport) * Rimwe na rimwe rufasha ubwikorezi hagati y’imijyi y’imbere === 6.2 Uburovyi === * Ifi nyinshi zitunga imiryango myinshi === 6.3 Ubukungu === * Rufasha inganda z’ibiti (timber industry) * Rukora nk’inzira y’ubudandaji hagati y’imbere n’inyanja === 6.4 Ubuhinga n’iterambere === * Hari imigambi ya hydroelectricity n’ugucunga amazi \---- == 7. Amateka == * Mu kinjana ca 19, umushakashatsi Pierre Savorgnan de Brazza yararwuzuye mu bushakashatsi bwe * Rwari inzira y’ingenzi mu gushika mu gihugu c’imbere ca Gabon * Rwarafashije mu gushushanya amakarata ya Afurika yo hagati \---- == 8. Akamaro mu bidukikije vya Afurika == Ogooué ifise uruhara runini: * gutwara amazi ava mu mashamba manini ya Gabon * kubungabunga imvura n’ibihe (climate regulation) * gufasha ibinyabuzima vyinshi kubaho * kuba kimwe mu nzuzi zifise biodiversity nyinshi ku isi \---- == 9. Ibibazo n’imbogamizi == * Gutema amashyamba (deforestation) * Guhumana kw’amazi mu bice vyegereye imijyi * Impinduka z’ibihe (climate change) * Iterambere ry’inganda rishobora guhungabanya ecosystem \---- == 10. Umwanzuro == Uruzi rwa Ogooué ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye cane za Afurika yo hagati, rufise uruhara runini mu: * gukora ecosystem ya Gabon * gutanga ubuzima ku binyabuzima vyinshi * uburovyi n’ubudandaji * no kuba uruzi nyamukuru rujana amazi mu nyanja ya Atlantique

Uruzi rwa Ngounié
Uruzi rwa ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye zo mu gihugu ca , ruherereye mu burengero bwa Afurika yo hagati. Ni uruzi rufise uruhara runini mu gukora uruzi rwa Ogooué, uruzi nyamukuru rwa Gabon. \---- == 1. Aho ruherereye == Ngounié ruca mu bice vy’imbere vya Gabon: * Mu ntara ya Ngounié Province (yahawe izina n’uruzi nyene) * Ruca mu mashamba y’imvura (tropical rainforest) * Rinyura hafi y’igisagara ca Mouila * Hanyuma rurasuka muri \---- == 2. Aho ruva n’aho rujana == * Inkomoko: mu misozi n’ibibaya vyo mu bumanuko bwa Gabon * Ruca mu turere twinshi tw’ishamba n’ubuhinzi * Rujana amazi mu ruzi rwa Ogooué * Ogooué na yo igasohokera mu Atlantique Ocean 👉 Inzira nyamukuru: Ngounié → Ogooué → Atlantique \---- == 3. Uburebure n’imiterere == * Uburebure: hafi 600–700 km (mu bipimo bitandukanye) * Ruca mu mashamba manini ya tropique * Rurangwa n’udusumo (rapids) mu bice bimwe * Rimwe na rimwe rufise ibibaya binini n’amazi atemba gahoro * Ruca mu karere gafise imvura nyinshi cane \---- == 4. Ibidukikije == Ngounié ruca mu gice gifise biodiversity ikomeye: * ibiti binini vya rainforest * amafi menshi atandukanye * inyoni n’inyamaswa zo mu mazi * ibishanga n’uduce twa swamp mu bice bimwe Ni igice c’ingenzi ca ecosystem ya Ogooué Basin. \---- == 5. Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Ngounié == === 5.1 Uburovyi === * Ifi nyinshi zitunga imiryango yegereye uruzi * Ni isoko y’ifunguro rya buri munsi === 5.2 Ubwikorezi === * Amato mato akoreshwa mu gutwara abantu n’ibintu * Rimwe na rimwe rufasha mu guhuza imidugudu y’imbere === 5.3 Ubuhinzi === * Amazi yarwo akoreshwa mu kuvomera imirima * Ibibaya vyarwo birumbuka cane \---- == 6. Akamaro muri sisitemu ya Ogooué == Ngounié ni kimwe mu bigize Ogooué River system: * Ngounié → Ogooué → Atlantique * Rutanga amazi menshi ava mu bumanuko bwa Gabon * Rufasha kugumana ubuzima bw’ishamba rinini rya Gabon \---- == 7. Imibereho y’abantu == * Imidugudu myinshi iri ku nkengera * Abantu benshi bishingikiriza ku burobyi n’ubuhinzi * Ruca kandi hafi y’inzira z’ubudandaji zihuza ibice vya Gabon \---- == 8. Ibibazo n’imbogamizi == * Guhumana kw’amazi mu bice vyegereye imidugudu * Gutema amashyamba * Impinduka z’ibihe * Isuri mu bihe vy’imvura nyinshi * Ubwikorezi bugorana mu bice birimwo udusumo \---- == 9. Umwanzuro == Uruzi rwa Ngounié ni uruzi rukomeye mu gihugu ca Gabon, rufasha mu: * gukora uruzi rwa Ogooué * uburovyi n’ubuhinzi * gutunga imidugudu myinshi * kubungabunga ibidukikije vya rainforest Naho rutari runini cane nk’inzuzi zikuru z’isi, rufise akamaro kanini mu buzima bwa buri munsi bw’abaturage ba Gabon.

Uruzi rwa Kouilou
Uruzi rwa ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye zo mu burengerazuba bwa Afurika yo hagati, ruca mu gihugu ca . Ni uruzi ruzwi cane kubera imiterere yarwo irimwo imisozi, ibibaya, n’udusumo twinshi (rapids), kandi rufise akamaro kanini mu bidukikije vya Congo Basin. \---- == 1. Aho ruherereye == Kouilou ruca mu burengerazuba bwa Congo-Brazzaville: * Rutangura mu misozi n’utwo tundi turere two hagati mu gihugu * Ruca mu ntara za Niari na Kouilou * Ruca hafi y’igisagara ca Pointe-Noire * Hanyuma rurasuka mu Atlantique Ocean 👉 Rimwe na rimwe igice caryo co hejuru citwa Niari River. \---- == 2. Aho ruva n’aho rujana == * Inkomoko: mu misozi yo hagati mu gihugu (plateau ya Congo-Brazzaville) * Ruca mu bibaya n’imisozi myinshi * Rwinjira mu gice co mu bumanuko bushira uburengero * Rurasuka mu nyanja ya Atlantique hafi ya Pointe-Noire \---- == 3. Uburebure n’imiterere == * Uburebure: hafi 700–900 km (bitewe n’aho bipimirwa) * Ruca mu misozi (canyons) n’ibibaya * Rurangwa n’udusumo twinshi (rapids) * Rimwe na rimwe rufise ibice bigoye kugenderwako n’amato * Ruca mu karere gafise ibiti vyinshi vya tropique \---- == 4. Ibidukikije == Kouilou ruca mu gice gifise biodiversity ikomeye: * ishamha rya tropique (rainforest) * amafi menshi atandukanye * inyoni n’inyamaswa zo mu mazi * ibibanza vy’imisozi n’udusozi twa gorges Ni kimwe mu bice bikomeye vya ecosystem ya Congo Basin mu burengerazuba. \---- == 5. Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Kouilou == === 5.1 Uburovyi === * Ifi nyinshi zitunga imiryango yo ku nkengera * Ni isoko y’ubuzima mu bice vyinshi === 5.2 Ubwikorezi === * Rimwe na rimwe rukoreshwa n’amato mato * Ariko rapids zituma ubwikorezi bugorana === 5.3 Ubukerarugendo === * Amasumo n’udusumo birakwegakwega ba mukerarugendo * Ibibaya n’imisozi bitanga paysages nziza cane === 5.4 Ubuhinzi === * Amazi akoreshwa mu mirima yegereye uruzi * Ibibaya birumbuka mu bihe vy’imvura \---- == 6. Uruhare muri sisitemu ya Congo Basin == Kouilou si igice kinini ca Congo River system nka Kasai canke Lualaba, ariko: * gifasha mu gutwara amazi ava mu burengerazuba bwa Congo * gishigikira ecosystem yo ku nkengera ya Atlantique * gifise uruhara mu kugabanya isuri n’uguhuza ibidukikije \---- == 7. Imiterere yihariye == * gishobora kuba uruzi rufise gorges zifunze (canyons) * rufise rapids nyinshi * ruca mu bibanza bitandukanye: imisozi → ibibaya → coast * rufise ikirere ciza c’ishamba rinini \---- == 8. Ibibazo n’imbogamizi == * isuri mu bice vy’imisozi * gutema amashyamba * guhumana kw’amazi mu bice vyegereye abantu * ubwikorezi bugoye kubera udusumo twinshi * impinduka z’ibihe \---- == 9. Umwanzuro == Uruzi rwa Kouilou ni uruzi rukomeye mu gihugu ca Congo-Brazzaville, rufise uruhara runini mu: * uburovyi * ubukerarugendo * ubuhinzi * no kubungabunga ibidukikije vya tropique Ni uruzi rufise uburanga budasanzwe kubera gorges, imisozi n’amasumo bituma ruba kimwe mu nzuzi ziza cane mu karere ka Congo Basin.

Uruzi rwa Sanaga
Uruzi rwa Sanaga River ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye cane muri Cameroon, kandi ni rwo ruzi runini kurusha izindi zose muri ico gihugu. Ruca mu ntara nyinshi za Cameroon kandi rurasuka mu Atlantic Ocean (Gulf of Guinea). \---- == 1. Aho ruherereye == Sanaga ruca hagati mu gihugu ca Cameroon: * Rutangura mu misozi ya Adamawa Plateau * Ruca mu ntara za East, Centre, na Littoral * Rurangirira mu nyanja ya Atlantique hafi ya Douala \---- == 2. Aho ruva n’aho rujana == Sanaga ntirufise isoko imwe, ahubwo rukomoka ku migezi ibiri ikomeye: * Djérem River (isoko ndende kurusha izindi) * Lom River Iyo migezi ihurira, igakora Sanaga River nyene. 👉 Inzira: Djérem + Lom → Sanaga → Atlantic Ocean \---- == 3. Uburebure n’inguvu z’amazi == * Uburebure: hafi 900 km (canke 600 km ku gice nyamukuru) * Basin: hafi 132,000–140,000 km² * Ni uruzi rufise amazi menshi cane (high discharge) * Amazi yarwo ariyongera cane mu bihe vy’imvura \---- == 4. Imiterere y’uruzi == Sanaga ruca mu bice bitandukanye: * Upper Sanaga: savanna n’imisozi * Middle Sanaga: imigezi ikomeye (Mbam tributary zone) * Lower Sanaga: ishamha n’inzira igana ku nyanja Rurangwa kandi n’udusumo (rapids) n’imvura nyinshi mu karere karwo. \---- == 5. Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Sanaga == === 5.1 Ingufu z’amashanyarazi === Sanaga ni uruzi rukomeye cane mu gukora hydroelectric power: * Song Loulou Dam * Edéa Dam Ibi bigomero bitanga igice kinini c’umuyagankuba wa Cameroon. \---- === 5.2 Uburovyi === * Ifi nyinshi zitunga imiryango ibihumbi * Ni isoko y’ifunguro mu bice vyinshi \---- === 5.3 Ubuhinzi === * Amazi akoreshwa mu kuvomera imirima * Ibibaya birumbuka cane \---- === 5.4 Ubwikorezi === * Rukoreshwa mu bice bimwe, cane cane hafi ya Edéa * Ariko hari udusumo dutuma ubwikorezi bugorana \---- == 6. Ibidukikije == Sanaga ruca mu gice kiri hagati ya: * rainforest (ishamba rinini) * savanna (ibibaya vy’ibyatsi) Ibi bituma ruba uruzi rufise biodiversity itandukanye: * amafi menshi * inyoni zo mu mazi * ibiti vya tropique * inyamaswa zo ku nkengera \---- == 7. Uruhare muri ekosistema == Sanaga ni ingenzi mu bidukikije vya Cameroon: * rutanga amazi ku mashamba manini * rufasha kugumana ikirere (climate balance) * ruca hagati y’uduce tubiri tw’ibidukikije (forest + savanna) \---- == 8. Amateka n’abantu == * Rwarakoreshejwe kuva kera mu buhinzi n’uburovyi * Rwafashije iterambere ry’imidugudu minini nka Edéa na Douala region * Rwari inzira y’ingenzi y’ubushakashatsi bwa Afurika yo hagati \---- == 9. Ibibazo n’imbogamizi == * Guhumana kw’amazi mu bice vyegereye imijyi * Gutema amashyamba * Impinduka z’ibihe * Ingaruka z’ingomero (dams) ku binyabuzima * Isuri mu bihe vy’imvura nyinshi \---- == 10. Umwanzuro == Uruzi rwa Sanaga ni uruzi runini cane muri Cameroon, kandi rufise uruhara runini mu: * gutanga umuyagankuba (hydropower) * uburovyi n’ubuhinzi * ibidukikije vya rainforest na savanna * iterambere ry’igihugu cose Ni rumwe mu nzuzi z’ingenzi cane mu buraruko bushira uburengero bwa Afurika yo hagati.

Uruzi rwa Wouri
Uruzi rwa Wouri River ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye cane mu gihugu ca Cameroon, kandi ni rwo ruzi ruzwi cane kubera ko rugeze mu gisagara kinini ca Douala, ico kikaba ari port (icyambu) nyamukuru ya Cameroon. \---- == 1. Aho ruherereye == Wouri ruca mu burengerazuba bwa Cameroon: * Rutangura aho imigezi ibiri ihurira: ** Nkam River ** Makombé River * Aho bihurira ni hafi ya Yabassi * Hanyuma rujana amazi mu nyanja ya Atlantique (Gulf of Guinea) kuri Douala 👉 Ni rwo ruzi runyura mu gisagara kinini ca Cameroon (Douala). \---- == 2. Uburebure n’inzira == * Uburebure: hafi 160 km * Ruca mu bice bigufi ugereranyije n’izindi nzuzi, ariko rufise akamaro kanini * Rurasuka mu Wouri estuary, igice kinini c’amazi afitanye isano n’inyanja \---- == 3. Imiterere y’uruzi == Wouri rufise imiterere yihariye: * Ni estuary river (ruvanga amazi y’uruzi n’ay’inyanja) * Ruca mu mangrove forests (amashyamba y’amazi y’umunyu) * Ruri munsi y’ingaruka z’inyanja (tides) mu bilometero byinshi imbere * Rufise ibibanza vy’udusumo n’imigezi mito mito \---- == 4. Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Wouri == === 4.1 Ubucuruzi n’ubwikorezi === * Douala port iri ku nkengera zarwo * Ni inzira nyamukuru y’ubudandaji bwa Cameroon * Amato manini n’amato mato ararukoresha === 4.2 Uburovyi === * Ifi nyinshi mu estuary * Abaturage benshi bishingikiriza ku burobyi === 4.3 Ubuhinzi n’imibereho === * Mangrove zones zifasha ibidukikije * Amazi akoreshwa mu bikorwa vy’abantu \---- == 5. Akamaro mu mateka == Wouri ni uruzi rufise amateka akomeye cane: * Mu 1472, abagenzi b’Abanyaportugal bararubonye * Baryise “Rio dos Camarões” (uruzi rw’udusimba/crayfish) * Ayo mazina ni yo yatumye igihugu ca Cameroon cyitwa “Cameroon” \---- == 6. Ikiraro ca Wouri == * Hari ikiraro kinini gihuza Douala na Bonabéri * Ni kimwe mu bikorwa bikomeye vya engineering muri Cameroon * Gifasha traffic y’abantu n’ibintu hagati y’imijyi \---- == 7. Ibidukikije == Wouri estuary ifise ibidukikije bikomeye: * mangrove forests * ibinyabuzima vyinshi vyo mu mazi * manatee (mu bihe bimwe) * ibibanza vy’amafi n’inyoni Ariko kandi, hari ibibazo vy’umutekano w’ibidukikije kubera: * pollution * ibikorwa vy’inganda * kwaguka kw’igisagara ca Douala \---- == 8. Ibibazo n’imbogamizi == * Guhumana kw’amazi (industrial + urban waste) * Isuri mu mangrove zones * Ubwiyongere bw’abantu muri Douala * Impinduka z’ibihe n’inyanja \---- == 9. Umwanzuro == Uruzi rwa Wouri ni uruzi ruto ugereranyije n’izindi, ariko ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye cane mu bukungu bwa Cameroon kubera: * icyambu ca Douala * ubudandaji mpuzamahanga * amateka y’igihugu (izina Cameroon) * uburovyi n’ibidukikije vya mangrove

Uruzi rwa Nyong
Uruzi rwa Nyong * Igihugu: * Akarere: Afrika yo hagati (Central Africa) * Uburebure: hafi 640 km * Inkomoko: mu buraruko bushira ubuseruko bwa Cameroon (hafi ya Abong-Mbang) * Aho rwinjirira inyanja: Gulf of Guinea (inyanja Atlantika) * Akarere k’amazi (basin): ~27,800 km² (ikigereranyo) * Imijyi minini ruca mu: Abong-Mbang, Akonolinga, Mbalmayo * Sisiteme y’uruzi: amazi ashirwa mu Nyanja Atlantika \---- == Incamake == Uruzi rwa Nyong ni rumwe mu migezi minini iri mu gihugu ca Cameroon. Rurafise akamaro kanini cane mu buzima bw’abanyagihugu, cane cane mu buhinzi, kuroba amafi no gutwara abantu n’ibintu mu bice bimwe bidafise imihora myiza y’imiduga. Ruranyura mu mashamba manini cane yo muri Afrika yo hagati, aho ibinyabuzima bitandukanye biboneka. \---- == Aho ruva n’inzira ruca == === Inkomoko === Uruzi rwa Nyong ruvukira mu buseruko bwa Cameroon hafi y’akarere ka Abong-Mbang, mu karere k’amashamba y’inzitane (ishamba rya equateur). === Inzira yarwo === Kuva aho ruvuka, ruja mu burengero (westward) ruca mu: * mashamba manini ya equateur * uturere two guhingamo * ibisagara n’utujiji dutandukanye Imijyi ruca mu minini ni: * Abong-Mbang * Akonolinga * Mbalmayo Amaherezo rujana amazi yarwo mu nyanja Atlantika (Gulf of Guinea). \---- == Uruhare mu bidukikije == Uruzi rwa Nyong rufise akamaro kanini mu bidukikije kuko: * rutuma amashyamba agira ubuzima (ecosystème) * rutanga aho amafi n’ibindi binyabuzima biba * rufasha mu kugumya uburimbane bw’ikirere * rutuma ibiti n’ibimera bikura neza mu nkengero zarwo \---- == Uruhare mu buzima bw’abantu == === 1. Kuroba amafi === Abantu benshi baba ku nkengero zarwo babeshwaho n’uburobyi. Amafi ava muri Nyong ni isoko y’ibifungurwa. === 2. Amazi yo gukoresha === Rukoreshwa mu: * kunywa (mu bisagara bimwe na bimwe) * koza * kuhira imyaka === 3. Ubuhinzi === Inkengero zarwo zifise ubutaka burumbuka, buhingwamwo: * imyumbati * ibitoke * cacao na coffee mu duce twegereye amashyamba === 4. Gutwara abantu n’ibintu === Mu bice bimwe bidafise imihora myiza y’imiduga, hakoreshwa amato mato (canoës). \---- == Ikirere n’akarere kirimo == Akarere Nyong rucamwo karangwa n’ibi: * imvura nyinshi cane (ikigereranyo ca 1500–2000 mm ku mwaka) * ubushuhe buhoraho * amashyamba manini y’igitoke (tropical rainforest) Ibi bituma Nyong riba uruzi rufise amazi menshi mu bihe vy’imvura. \---- == Ibinyabuzima (écosystème) == Mu ruzi rwa Nyong habamwo: * amafi atandukanye * ingona mu bice bimwe * inyoni zo mu mazi * ibimera bikura ku nkengera z’uruzi Ni kimwe mu bice bifise ubuzima bwinshi mu karere ka Congo Basin. \---- == Ibibazo rufise == === 1. Kwanduzwa === Amazi y’uruzi aranduzwa n: * imyanda iva mu bisagara * ibimoteri vy’abantu * imiti ikoreshwa mu buhinzi === 2. Gucibwa amashyamba === Guca ibiti ku nkengero z’uruzi bituma: * isi isenyuka ijya mu mazi * uruzi rusiba buhoro buhoro (sedimentation) === 3. Guhindagurika kw’ikirere === Imvura ishobora kugabanuka canke kwiyongera bigatera: * imyuzure * canke amazi make mu gihe c’izuba \---- == Amateka == Mu bihe vya kera n’igihe c’abakoroni, Uruzi rwa Nyong rwakoreshwa nk’inzira yo gutwara abantu n’ibicuruzwa mu mashamba ya Cameroon. N’ubu ruracafise akamaro mu buzima bw’abanyagihugu bo muri ako karere. \---- == Akamaro k’ubutunzi == Uruzi rwa Nyong rutuma habaho: * uburobyi * ubuhinzi * ubuhahirane bw’abantu * ubuzima bw’ibinyabuzima mu mashamba \---- == Kurinda uruzi == Hakozwe ibigeragezo bitandukanye: * gutera ibiti ku nkengero z’uruzi * kurwanya imyanda mu mazi * kwigisha abantu gukoresha neza ibidukikije Ariko haracari ibibazo mu kurinda neza uruzi. \---- == Reba kandi == * Inzuzi zo muri Cameroon * Uruzi rwa Sanaga * Congo Basin * Uruzi rwa Dja \---- == Inyandiko n’amasoko == * FAO – amakuru ku mazi n’inzuzi zo muri Afrika yo hagati * UNESCO – Congo Basin ecosystem reports * Ministry of Water Resources Cameroon * WWF – raporo ku binyabuzima byo mu mazi ya Congo Basin * Inyigisho za kaminuza ku hydrology ya Cameroon Nimba ushaka, nokwandika:

Uruzi rwa Dja
=== Intangamarara === Uruzi rwa Dja ni rumwe mu migezi ikomeye yo muri Afurika yo hagati, ruherereye cyane mu gihugu ca Cameroun, rukaba ruri mu kibanza kinini c’amashyamba y’imvura (forêt équatoriale) agize igice c’uruzi rwa Congo. Ruzwi cane kubera uruzi rwawo rugenda ruciyemwo amayira menshi mu mashyamba atoshye, ndetse n’ukuba rufise akamaro kanini mu bidukikije no mu binyabuzima. Uruzi rwa Dja rufatwa nk’uruzi rufasha mu gutuma amashyamba ya Congo Basin abaho neza kuko rutanga amazi, rutunganya ibidukikije kandi rugafasha ibinyabuzima bitandukanye kubaho. \---- === Aho ruherereye === Uruzi rwa Dja ruturuka mu micungararo y’amajyepfo ashingiye ku gihugu ca Cameroun, hanyuma rukanyura mu karere kazwi nka Dja Faunal Reserve, ahantu harinzwe na UNESCO kubera ubutunzi bw’ibinyabuzima buhambaye. Rugenda rwerekeza mu burasirazuba no mu majepfo, hanyuma amaherezo rujya kwinjira mu ruzi runini rwa Sangha, narwo rukaba igice c’uruzi rwa Congo. \---- === Uburebure n’ukuntu rumeze === * Uburebure bwose: hafi 1,000 km (bivugwa mu bipimo bitandukanye) * Uruzi rugenda ruciye mu mashyamba y’inzitane * Rufise amayira menshi mato aruvamwo * Amazi yarwo aratemba buhoro mu bice bimwe kubera ubutaka burimo ibishanga \---- === Ibidukikije n’ibinyabuzima === Uruzi rwa Dja rufise akamaro kanini mu kubungabunga ibinyabuzima: * Amoko menshi y’inyamaswa: inguge (chimpanzees), gorillas, n’andi moko y’inyamaswa z’ishyamba * Inyoni nyinshi zo mu mashyamba y’imvura * Amafi atandukanye abaho mu mazi yaryo * Amashyamba azengurutse uruzi arinzwe cyane (Dja Faunal Reserve – UNESCO World Heritage Site) \---- === Akamaro k’uruzi === Uruzi rwa Dja rufasha mu: * Gutanga amazi ku binyabuzima n’abantu baba hafi yarwo * Kubungabunga ikirere (climate regulation) * Gufasha mu kubaho kw’amashyamba y’inzitane * Kuba isoko y’ubushakashatsi ku binyabuzima \---- === Ibyago n’ibibazo === Nubwo ruri mu karere karinzwe, uruzi rwa Dja rufite ibibazo: * Gutemwa kw’amashyamba (deforestation) * Uburobyi budakurikije amategeko * Impinduka z’ibihe (climate change) * Kwaguka kw’imyubakire y’abantu \---- === Umwanzuro === Uruzi rwa Dja ni igice gikomeye cyane c’urusobe rw’ibidukikije rwa Congo Basin. Kubungabunga uru ruzi ni ingenzi kugira ngo ibinyabuzima n’amashyamba bikomeze kubaho no mu bihe biri imbere. \---- === Amasoko (Sources) === * UNESCO World Heritage Centre – Dja Faunal Reserve * Encyclopaedia Britannica – Rivers of Central Africa * FAO reports on Congo Basin ecosystems * Cameroon Ministry of Environment publications

Uruzi rwa Kaduna
ni rumwe mu migezi ikomeye yo mu gihugu ca Nigeria, rufise uruhara runini mu gutanga amazi, ubuhinzi, n’ubuzima bw’abantu bo mu burengero n’uburengerazuba bwa hagati bwa Nigeria. Ruvugwa cane cane kubera ko ruca mu ntara ya Kaduna rugaca no mu bindi bice bitandukanye imbere mu gihugu. Izina: Uruzi rwa Kaduna Igihugu: Nigeria Uburebure: ~550 km (hafi) Isoko (source): Akarere k’amajyaruguru ya Nigeria (plateau za Jos n’inkengero zazo) Iherezo (mouth): Rwinjira mu ruzi rwa Niger Uruzi runini rwarwo: Niger River (ruvamo) Intara runyuramwo: Kaduna State n’izindi ntara zo hagati ya Nigeria Ubwoko: Uruzi runini rufasha ubuhinzi n’amazi \---- = Aho ruva n’aho rugana = Uruzi rwa Kaduna ruvira mu misozi n’ibibaya biri mu buraruko bwa Nigeria, hafi y’akarere ka Jos Plateau. Amazi yarwo atemba agenda amanuka buhoro buhoro, akinjira mu bibaya binini. Rugenda ruca mu Kaduna State, ari naho rwitiriwe, hanyuma rugakomereza urugendo rwarwo gushika aho rwinjira mu ruzi runini rwa Niger River. \---- = Uturere ruza ruracamwo = Uruzi rwa Kaduna ruca mu bice bikurikira: * Jos Plateau (isoko ry’amazi) * Kaduna State (akarere kanini karwitirirwa) * Ibibaya n’imirima minini y’ubuhinzi * Akarere kegeranye n’uruzi rwa Niger \---- = Akamaro k’Uruzi rwa Kaduna = == 1. Ubuhinzi == Uruzi rwa Kaduna ni isoko rikomeye y’amazi yo kuhira imyaka. Rukora ku: * guhinga umuceri * ibinyamisogwe (beans, groundnuts) * ibihingwa vy’ubucuruzi Amazi yarwo afasha abahinzi mu bihe vy’izuba. \---- == 2. Amazi yo kunywa n’inganda == Mu bisagara bimwe, amazi y’uruzi akoreshwa: * kunywa * gukoresha mu nganda * ibikorwa vya buri munsi \---- == 3. Uburovyi == Naho rutameze nk’imigezi minini cane y’uburovyi, rufise: * amafi atandukanye * isoko ry’ifunguro ku baturage bo ku nkengera zarwo \---- == 4. Ingufu n’iterambere == Uruzi rwa Kaduna rufasha mu mishinga y’iterambere n’ingufu z’amazi (hydrological projects), naho ingomero nini zitari nyinshi kuri rwo. \---- = Ibinyabuzima n’ibidukikije = Mu ruzi rwa Kaduna habamwo: * amafi y’amoko atandukanye * ibikoko vyo mu mazi * ibimera bikura ku nkengera z’amazi * inyoni zishaka amazi (water birds) Ariko kandi, ibidukikije vyarwo birageramiwe n’imyanda n’iterambere ridakurikije amategeko. \---- = Ibibazo ruhura na vyo = Uruzi rwa Kaduna ruhura n’ibibazo bikomeye: * kwanduzwa n’imyanda y’imijyi * isuri n’isenyuka ry’inkengera * gukoresha amazi birenze urugero * gucika intege kw’ibinyabuzima \---- = Akamaro k’umuco = Mu bice rwa ruzi rucecako, rufatwa nk’isoko y’ubuzima. Abantu barukoresha mu: * migenzo ya kera * ubuhinzi bwa kinyamuryango * ibikorwa vy’akarere \---- = Umusozo = Uruzi rwa Kaduna ni rumwe mu migezi ikomeye ya Nigeria ifasha mu buzima bwa buri munsi, ubuhinzi n’iterambere ry’ubutunzi. Kurubungabunga ni ngirakamaro kugira ngo rukomeze gufasha ibisekuruza biri imbere.

Uruzi rwa Sokoto
== Uruzi rwa Sokoto == ni rumwe mu migezi minini yo mu buraruko bushira uburengero bwa Nigeria, rufise uruhara runini mu buhinga bw’amazi, ubuhinzi n’ubuzima bw’abanyagihugu bo mu ntara zitandukanye. Ni rumwe mu migezi igize sisitemu y’uruzi rwa Niger, kuko amaherezo rwinjira mu . Izina: Uruzi rwa Sokoto Igihugu: Nigeria Uburebure: ~300–400 km (bivugwa mu nyandiko zitandukanye) Isoko (source): Amajyaruguru ashushe ya Nigeria (near Gusau / Zamfara region) Iherezo (mouth): Rwinjira mu ruzi rwa Niger Akarere runyuramwo: Sokoto State, Zamfara n’utundi duce two mu buraruko bwa Nigeria Sisitemu y’uruzi: Niger River Basin Ubwoko: Uruzi runini rw’amazi y’imvura n’imigezi y’amashami \---- = Aho ruva n’aho rugana = Uruzi rwa Sokoto ruvira mu misozi n’ibibaya byo mu buraruko bushira uburengero bwa Nigeria, cane cane mu ntara za Zamfara n’inkengero zayo. Amazi yarwo atangura ava mu migezi mito mito (tributaries), hanyuma agahurira hamwe akavamo uruzi runini. Rugenda ruca mu ntara ya Sokoto, ari naho rwitiriwe, hanyuma rugakomeza urugendo rwarwo gushika aho rwinjira mu ruzi rwa Niger. \---- = Uturere ruza ruracamwo = Uruzi rwa Sokoto ruca mu bice bikurikira: * Zamfara State (isoko ry’amashami menshi y’amazi) * Sokoto State (akarere k’ingenzi cane) * Ibibaya vy’ubuhinzi n’imirima minini * Uturere two mu buraruko bushushe bwa Sahel \---- = Imiterere y’uruzi = Uruzi rwa Sokoto rufise imiterere ijanye n’ibi: * Ruterwa n’imvura (seasonal river system) * Rurimwo amashami menshi mato mato * Rwiyongera cane mu gihe c’imvura * Rugabanuka mu gihe c’izuba rikomeye \---- = Akamaro k’Uruzi rwa Sokoto = == 1. Ubuhinzi == Uruzi rwa Sokoto rufasha cane mu buhinzi bwo mu buraruko bwa Nigeria. Amazi yarwo akoreshwa mu: * kuhira imyaka mu bihe vy’izuba * guhinga umuceri * ibinyamisogwe n’ibihingwa vyo kurya \---- == 2. Amazi y’abantu == Ni isoko rikomeye y’amazi akoreshwa: * kunywa * isuku * ibikorwa vya buri munsi mu midugudu n’igisagara \---- == 3. Uburovyi == Naho ari akarere gashushe, uruzi rufasha: * uburovyi bw’amafi y’amazi meza * gutunga imiryango yegereye inkombe zarwo \---- == 4. Ubworozi == Aborozi bo mu buraruko bakoresha amazi yarwo ku: * nka * intama * inka mu bihe vy’izuba \---- = Ibinyabuzima n’ibidukikije = Mu ruzi rwa Sokoto habamwo: * amafi atandukanye * inyoni z’amazi * ibimera bikura ku nkengera * ibikoko bito bito vyo mu bibaya Ariko ibidukikije vyarwo birageramiwe n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe n’iyongera ry’abantu. \---- = Ibibazo ruhura na vyo = Uruzi rwa Sokoto ruhura n’ibi bibazo: * kugabanuka kw’amazi mu gihe c’izuba * isuri n’isenyuka ry’inkengera * kwanduzwa n’imyanda yo mu bisagara * guhinduka kw’ibihe (climate change) \---- = Akamaro mu bukungu = Uruzi rwa Sokoto rufasha mu bukungu bwa Nigeria mu: * guteza imbere ubuhinzi bwo mu buraruko * gutanga akazi mu buhinzi n’uburovyi * gutuma imidugudu yegereye uruzi ibaho neza \---- = Umusozo = Uruzi rwa Sokoto ni uruzi rukomeye rufasha ubuzima bw’abanyagihugu bo mu buraruko bwa Nigeria, cane cane mu buhinzi n’amazi yo kunywa. Kurubungabunga ni ngombwa kugira ngo rukomeze gutanga inyungu ku bisekuruza biri imbere.

Uruzi rwa Gongola
== Uruzi rwa Gongola == ni rumwe mu migezi minini yo mu buraruko bushira ubuseruko bwa Nigeria, kandi ni ishami rikomeye ry’uruzi rwa , narwo rujya mu ruzi rwa Niger. Gongola ni uruzi rufise akamaro kanini mu buhinzi, amazi y’abantu n’ibidukikije mu turere ruracamwo. Izina: Uruzi rwa Gongola Igihugu: Nigeria Uburebure: ~531 km (hafi) Isoko (source): Muri Adamawa Plateau (ubuseruko bwa Nigeria) Iherezo (mouth): Rwinjira mu ruzi rwa Benue Sisitemu: Niger River Basin Akarere runyuramwo: Adamawa, Gombe, Yobe (inkengero), Taraba Ubwoko: Ishami rinini ry’uruzi (major tributary) \---- = Aho ruva n’aho rugana = Uruzi rwa Gongola ruvira mu misozi ya Adamawa Plateau mu buraruko bushira ubuseruko bwa Nigeria. Amazi yarwo atangura ava mu migezi mito mito n’imvura nyinshi igwa muri ako karere. Rugenda rumanuka mu bibaya n’ibibanza vyagutse, rugaca mu ntara za Adamawa na Gombe, hanyuma rugahurira n’uruzi rwa Benue. \---- = Uturere ruza ruracamwo = Uruzi rwa Gongola ruca mu bice bikurikira: * Adamawa State (isoko n’uturere twinshi two hejuru) * Gombe State (ibibaya n’ubuhinzi) * Taraba State (inkengero zimwe) * Ibibaya vyagutse vya Sudano–Sahel zone \---- = Akamaro k’Uruzi rwa Gongola = == 1. Ubuhinzi == Uruzi rwa Gongola ni isoko rikomeye ry’amazi yo kuhira imyaka. Rukora cane mu: * guhinga umuceri * ibinyamisogwe (beans, groundnuts) * ibihingwa vyo mu bihe vy’izuba \---- == 2. Uburovyi == Mu bice bimwe vy’uruzi, amazi arimwo amafi menshi atuma: * uburovyi buba isoko ry’akazi * imiryango ibona ifunguro n’icizigiro c’ubutunzi \---- == 3. Amazi yo kunywa n’ubuzima == Abanyagihugu bo ku nkengera zarwo barukoresha: * kunywa amazi * isuku * ibikorwa vya buri munsi \---- == 4. Ingufu n’imishinga y’amazi == Uruzi rwa Gongola rufise ubushobozi bwo gukoreshwa mu: * ingomero nto nto z’amashanyarazi (hydropower potential) * imishinga yo kugenzura imyuzure \---- = Ibinyabuzima n’ibidukikije = Uruzi rwa Gongola ruri mu karere gafise: * amafi menshi y’amoko atandukanye * ibisiga n’inyoni z’amazi * ibimera vyo ku nkengera * ibikoko vyo mu bibaya Ariko kandi, ibidukikije birageramiwe n’isuri n’iyongera ry’abantu. \---- = Ibibazo ruhura na vyo = Uruzi rwa Gongola ruhura n’ibi bibazo: * imyuzure (flooding) mu gihe c’imvura nyinshi * kugabanuka kw’amazi mu bihe vy’izuba * isuri n’isenyuka ry’inkengera * kwanduzwa n’imyanda n’ubuhinzi butitonze \---- = Akamaro mu bukungu = Uruzi rwa Gongola rufasha ubukungu bwa Nigeria mu: * guteza imbere ubuhinzi mu buraruko bushira ubuseruko * gutanga akazi mu burobyi n’ubuhinzi * gufasha iterambere ry’imidugudu n’amasoko \---- = Umusozo = Uruzi rwa Gongola ni ishami rikomeye ry’uruzi rwa Benue, kandi rufise uruhara runini mu buzima bw’abanyagihugu bo mu buraruko bushira ubuseruko bwa Nigeria. Kururinda ni ngombwa kugira ngo rukomeze gutanga amazi, ifunguro n’iterambere.

Uruzi rwa Hadejia
== Uruzi rwa Hadejia == ni rumwe mu migezi ikomeye yo mu buraruko bushira ubuseruko bwa Nigeria, ruzwi cane mu karere ka Sahel kubera uruhara rwarwo mu bibaya vy’ibishanga (wetlands) no mu buzima bw’ibinyabuzima. Ni rumwe mu mashami y’uruzi rwa , narwo rujya mu sisitemu y’uruzi rwa Lake Chad Izina: Uruzi rwa Hadejia Igihugu: Nigeria Uburebure: ~300 km (hafi, bivugwa bitandukanye) Isoko (source): Amajyaruguru y’ubuseruko bwa Nigeria (Jigawa / Kano uplands) Iherezo (mouth): Rwinjira mu migezi ya Komadugu–Yobe system Sisitemu: Lake Chad Basin Akarere runyuramwo: Kano, Jigawa, Yobe (inkengero) Ubwoko: Uruzi rufitaniye isano n’ibishanga (wetland river system) \---- = Aho ruva n’aho rugana = Uruzi rwa Hadejia ruvira mu misozi n’ibibaya biri mu ntara za Kano na Jigawa. Amazi y’imvura n’imigezi mito mito ni yo atuma rutangira. Rugenda rumanuka mu bibaya vyagutse, rugaca mu ntara ya Jigawa, hanyuma rugakomeza rujya mu sisitemu y’imigezi ya Hadejia–Jama’are–Komadugu Yobe, igana ku kiyaga ca Chad (Lake Chad basin). \---- = Uturere ruza ruracamwo = Uruzi rwa Hadejia ruca mu bice bikurikira: * Kano State (isoko ry’amazi) * Jigawa State (akarere kanini karwo) * Yobe State (inkengero za sisitemu yarwo) * Ibishanga n’ibibaya vya Sahel \---- = Ibishanga vya Hadejia (Hadejia–Nguru Wetlands) = Kimwe mu bintu bizwi cane kuri uru ruzi ni ibishanga binini vyitwa: * Hadejia–Nguru Wetlands Ibi bishanga ni ngirakamaro cane kuko: * bitanga aho ibikoko bibamwo * bifasha mu kugenzura imyuzure * bituma abanyagihugu babona amafi n’amazi \---- = Akamaro k’Uruzi rwa Hadejia = == 1. Ubuhinzi == Uruzi rwa Hadejia rufasha cane mu buhinzi bwo mu buraruko bwa Nigeria: * guhinga umuceri (rice cultivation) * ibinyamisogwe * imboga mu bibaya vy’amazi \---- == 2. Uburovyi == Ibishanga vyarwo bituma habaho: * amafi menshi * uburovyi bw’abaturage benshi * isoko ry’ifunguro n’ubutunzi \---- == 3. Ibinyabuzima == Akarere k’uruzi kazwi kubera: * inyoni nyinshi ziva no mu mahanga (migratory birds) * ibikoko vyo mu bishanga * biodiversity ikomeye cane \---- == 4. Amazi n’ubuzima == Amazi y’uruzi akoreshwa mu: * kunywa * isuku * ubuhinzi bwo mu ngo \---- = Ibibazo ruhura na vyo = Uruzi rwa Hadejia ruhura n’ibi bibazo: * kugabanuka kw’amazi kubera amapompage (irrigation) * ihindagurika ry’ibihe (climate change) * isenyuka ry’ibishanga * kugabanuka kw’inyoni n’amafi \---- = Akamaro mu bidukikije = Uruzi rwa Hadejia rufise uruhara runini mu: * kugenzura imyuzure * kurinda ubutaka gusenyuka * gutuma ibinyabuzima bibaho neza mu karere ka Sahel \---- = Umusozo = Uruzi rwa Hadejia ni rumwe mu migezi ifise akamaro kanini mu bibaya n’ibishanga vya Nigeria, cane cane mu karere ka Lake Chad Basin. Kurubungabunga ni ngombwa kugira ngo amafi, ibinyabuzima n’abantu bakomeze kuronka amazi n’ubuzima bwiza.

Uruzi rwa Komadugu
== Uruzi rwa Komadugu == (rukunze kwitwa Komadugu–Yobe system) ni rumwe mu migezi ikomeye yo mu buraruko bushira ubuseruko bwa Nigeria, rufitaniye isano n’uruzi rwa Hadejia n’izindi migezi mito mito. Ni igice kinini c’uruzi kigana mu sisitemu y’ikiyaga ca . Izina: Komadugu (Komadugu–Yobe River) Igihugu: Nigeria (hamwe n’inkengero za Niger mu karere ka basin) Uburebure: ~500 km (sisitemu yose ishobora kurenza) Isoko (source): Amajyaruguru ya Nigeria (Hadejia, Jama’are n’utundi duce two hejuru) Iherezo (mouth): Lake Chad basin (ibishanga n’imigezi igana ku kiyaga ca Chad) Akarere runyuramwo: Jigawa, Yobe, Borno (inkengero) Ubwoko: Sisitemu y’imigezi (river system) \---- = Aho ruva n’aho rugana = Komadugu si uruzi rumwe gusa, ahubwo ni sisitemu y’imigezi ihuriyemwo imigezi myinshi, harimwo: * Hadejia River * Jama’are River * Udushami twinshi two mu bibaya vya Sahel Iyo migezi ihurira hamwe ikavamo Komadugu–Yobe, hanyuma amazi agashikira ibishanga n’uturere two hafi ya Lake Chad. \---- = Uturere ruza ruracamwo = Komadugu–Yobe system icamwo: * Jigawa State * Yobe State * Borno State (inkengero) * Ibibaya vya Sahel (akarere k’umuco w’umusenyi n’izuba) \---- = Imiterere y’uruzi = Uruzi rwa Komadugu rufise imiterere yihariye: * Rwishingikiriza cane ku mvura (seasonal flow) * Ruragabanuka cane mu gihe c’izuba * Rwuzura mu gihe c’imvura (flood season) * Rufitaniye isano n’ibishanga binini \---- = Akamaro k’Uruzi rwa Komadugu = == 1. Ubuhinzi == Komadugu ni isoko ry’amazi rikomeye mu: * guhinga umuceri mu bibaya * ibinyamisogwe (beans, millet) * imboga zo mu bishanga \---- == 2. Uburovyi == Ibishanga vya Komadugu bitanga: * amafi menshi * akazi ku baturage bo mu micungararo * ifunguro ry’ingenzi \---- == 3. Ibishanga n’ibinyabuzima == Akarere ka Komadugu kazwi kubera: * inyoni nyinshi ziva mu bindi bihugu (migratory birds) * ibikoko vyo mu bishanga * biodiversity ikomeye cane mu Sahel \---- == 4. Amazi n’ubuzima == Amazi y’uruzi akoreshwa mu: * kunywa * isuku * ubuhinzi bw’ingo \---- = Ibibazo ruhura na vyo = Komadugu–Yobe system ihura n’ibi bibazo bikomeye: * kugabanuka kw’amazi kubera amapompage menshi * ihindagurika ry’ibihe (climate change) * kwaguka kw’ubutayu (desertification) * kugabanuka kw’ibinyabuzima n’amafi * isenyuka ry’ibishanga \---- = Akamaro mu bidukikije = Komadugu ni ngirakamaro mu: * kugenzura imyuzure mu gihe c’imvura * kubungabunga ibishanga vya Lake Chad basin * gutanga aho ibinyabuzima bibamwo * kurinda ubutaka gusenyuka \---- = Umusozo = Uruzi rwa Komadugu–Yobe ni sisitemu y’ingenzi cane mu buraruko bushira ubuseruko bwa Nigeria, ifasha mu buzima bw’abantu, ubuhinzi n’ibinyabuzima. Kubungabunga iyi migezi ni ngombwa cane kuko ifitaniye isano n’ejo hazaza h’akarere ka Lake Chad.

Uruzi rwa Rima
== Uruzi rwa Rima == ni rumwe mu migezi ikomeye yo mu buraruko bushira uburengero bwa Nigeria, rufitaniye isano n’uruzi rwa Sokoto, kandi ni kimwe mu mashami y’uruzi rwa Niger. Rima ni uruzi rufise akamaro kanini mu buhinzi, amazi y’abantu n’ubuzima bw’ibidukikije mu turere two mu Sahel. Izina: Uruzi rwa Rima Igihugu: Nigeria Uburebure: ~500 km (hafi, bivugwa bitandukanye) Isoko (source): Amajyaruguru bushira uburengero bwa Nigeria (Katsina–Zamfara uplands) Iherezo (mouth): Rwinjira mu ruzi rwa Sokoto, hanyuma muri Niger Sisitemu: Niger River Basin Akarere runyuramwo: Katsina, Zamfara, Sokoto Ubwoko: Ishami rinini ry’uruzi (tributary system) \---- = Aho ruva n’aho rugana = Uruzi rwa Rima ruvira mu bibaya n’imisozi mito ya Katsina na Zamfara mu buraruko bwa Nigeria. Amazi yarwo atangura ava mu migezi mito mito n’imvura igwa mu gihe c’imvura. Rugenda rumanuka rugaca mu turere tw’amashyamba make ya Sahel, hanyuma rugahurira n’uruzi rwa Sokoto. Ku nyuma, amazi yarwo akinjira mu ruzi rwa Niger. \---- = Uturere ruza ruracamwo = Uruzi rwa Rima ruca mu bice bikurikira: * Katsina State (isoko ry’amashami menshi) * Zamfara State (ibibaya n’ubuhinzi) * Sokoto State (aho ruhurira n’uruzi rwa Sokoto) * Ibibaya vya Sahel (akarere k’umusenyi n’izuba) \---- = Imiterere y’uruzi = Uruzi rwa Rima rufise imiterere ijanye n’ibi: * Rushingiye ku mvura (rain-fed river) * Rwuzura mu gihe c’imvura * Rukama canke rugabanuka cane mu gihe c’izuba * Rufise amashami menshi mato mato \---- = Akamaro k’Uruzi rwa Rima = == 1. Ubuhinzi == Rima ni isoko rikomeye ry’amazi yo kuhira imyaka: * umuceri * ibinyamisogwe (beans, groundnuts) * ibihingwa vyo mu Sahel (millet, sorghum) \---- == 2. Uburovyi == Mu bice bimwebimwe: * amafi ararobwa mu gihe c’imvura * atanga ifunguro ku baturage bo ku nkengera \---- == 3. Amazi yo kunywa == Abanyagihugu bo mu micungararo bakoresha amazi ya Rima: * kunywa * isuku * ibikorwa vya buri munsi \---- == 4. Ubworozi == Akarere ka Sahel gashingira cane ku: * inka * intama * impene kandi Rima ifasha mu kubona amazi mu bihe vy’izuba. \---- = Ibinyabuzima n’ibidukikije = Uruzi rwa Rima rufise ibinyabuzima birimwo: * amafi y’amoko atandukanye * inyoni z’amazi * ibimera bikura ku nkengera * ibikoko vyo mu bibaya vya Sahel Ariko biodiversity iragenda igabanuka kubera ihindagurika ry’ibihe. \---- = Ibibazo ruhura na vyo = Uruzi rwa Rima ruhura n’ibi bibazo bikomeye: * kugabanuka kw’amazi (seasonal drying) * isuri n’isenyuka ry’inkengera * kwaguka kw’ubutayu (desertification) * gukoresha amazi birenze urugero mu buhinzi * ihindagurika ry’ibihe (climate change) \---- = Akamaro mu bukungu = Rima ifasha ubukungu bwa Nigeria mu: * guteza imbere ubuhinzi bwo mu buraruko * gutanga akazi mu mirima n’uburovyi * gutuma imidugudu yegereye uruzi ibaho neza \---- = Umusozo = Uruzi rwa Rima ni kimwe mu bigize sisitemu y’uruzi rwa Sokoto–Niger, kandi rufise uruhara runini mu buzima bw’abanyagihugu bo mu buraruko bushira uburengero bwa Nigeria. Kurubungabunga ni ngombwa kugira ngo rukomeze gutanga amazi, ifunguro n’iterambere.

Uruzi rwa Ogun
== Uruzi rwa Ogun == ni rumwe mu migezi ikomeye yo mu bumanuko bushira uburengero bwa Nigeria, rufise uruhara runini mu bukungu, ubuhinzi, amazi y’abantu n’iterambere ry’ibisagara binini birugendeye. Ruzwi cane mu ntara ya Ogun State no mu micungararo y’igisagara ca Lagos. Izina: Uruzi rwa Ogun Igihugu: Nigeria Uburebure: ~480 km (hafi) Isoko (source): Akarere ka Oyo State (Plateau za Ibadan n’inkengero) Iherezo (mouth): Lagos Lagoon → Atlantic Ocean Akarere runyuramwo: Oyo, Ogun, Lagos States Ubwoko: Uruzi runini rwo mu bumanuko bwa Nigeria Sisitemu: Coastal river system (Atlantic drainage basin) \---- = Aho ruva n’aho rugana = Uruzi rwa Ogun ruvira mu misozi n’ibibaya biri mu ntara ya Oyo State, hafi y’igisagara ca Ibadan. Amazi yarwo atangura ava mu migezi mito mito n’imvura nyinshi igwa mu karere k’amashyamba n’ubuhinzi. Rugenda rumanuka ruca mu ntara ya Ogun State, hanyuma rukinjira mu bibaya bigana ku nyanja. Amaherezo rwinjira mu Lagos Lagoon, hanyuma amazi yarwo agasohokera mu Nyanja Atlantika. \---- = Uturere ruza ruracamwo = Uruzi rwa Ogun ruca mu bice bikurikira: * Oyo State (isoko ry’uruzi) * Ogun State (akarere kanini karwitirirwa) * Lagos State (inkengero za lagoon) * Ibibaya vy’amashyamba n’imirima y’ubuhinzi \---- = Akamaro k’Uruzi rwa Ogun = == 1. Ubuhinzi == Uruzi rwa Ogun rufasha cane mu: * guhinga umuceri mu bibaya vy’amazi * ibinyamisogwe * cocoa n’ibindi bihingwa vyo mu bumanuko bwa Nigeria Amazi yarwo ni ingenzi cane mu bihe vy’izuba. \---- == 2. Amazi y’abantu n’inganda == Mu bice binini birugendeye, rukoreshwa mu: * gutanga amazi y’amazu (water supply) * inganda zo mu micungararo ya Lagos * ibikorwa vy’ubucuruzi \---- == 3. Uburovyi == Mu bice bimwe vya lagoon: * amafi menshi araboneka * uburovyi ni isoko ry’akazi ku bantu benshi \---- == 4. Ubwikorezi == Mu bice biri hafi ya Lagos Lagoon: * amato mato mato arakoreshwa * gutwara abantu n’ibicuruzwa ku mazi \---- = Ibinyabuzima n’ibidukikije = Uruzi rwa Ogun rufise ibinyabuzima bitandukanye: * amafi menshi yo mu mazi y’amazi meza n’ayavanze n’inyanja * ibisiga n’inyoni z’amazi * ibimera vyo ku nkengera (mangroves mu gice ca lagoon) * ibikoko bito bito vyo mu bishanga Ariko ibidukikije birageramiwe n’imyanda y’imijyi minini. \---- = Ibibazo ruhura na vyo = Uruzi rwa Ogun ruhura n’ibi bibazo: * kwanduzwa n’imyanda y’inganda n’imijyi * isenyuka ry’inkengera z’uruzi * kugabanuka kw’amafi * imyuzure mu bihe vy’imvura nyinshi * gukoresha amazi birenze urugero \---- = Akamaro mu bukungu = Uruzi rwa Ogun rufasha bukomeye ubukungu bwa Nigeria mu: * guteza imbere ubuhinzi mu bumanuko * gutanga amazi ku bisagara binini nka Lagos * gutuma uburovyi n’ubwikorezi bwa lagoon bukora neza * gushigikira inganda n’ubucuruzi \---- = Umusozo = Uruzi rwa Ogun ni rumwe mu migezi ikomeye ya Nigeria ifitaniye isano n’iterambere ry’igihugu, cane cane mu karere ka Lagos n’inkengero zayo. Kururinda no kurubungabunga ni ngombwa kugira ngo rukomeze gufasha abantu n’ibidukikije .

Uruzi rwa Imo
== Uruzi rwa Imo == ni rumwe mu migezi ikomeye yo mu bumanuko bwa Nigeria. Ruca mu turere two mu majyepfo y'igihugu, rukagira uruhara runini mu gutanga amazi, guteza imbere ubuhinzi, uburovyi n'ubwikorezi bwo mu mazi. Uru ruzi rwinjira mu Imo River estuary, amaherezo amazi yarwo agasohokera mu Nyanja Atlantika. Izina: Uruzi rwa Imo Igihugu: Nigeria Uburebure: Hafi km 240 Isoko (source): Imisozi yo muri Iherezo (mouth): Imo River Estuary → Nyanja Atlantika (Gulf of Guinea) Akarere runyuramwo: Imo State, Abia State na Akwa Ibom State Sisitemu: Imigezi isohokera mu Nyanja Atlantika == Aho ruva n'aho rugana == Uruzi rwa Imo ruvira mu misozi yo mu karere ka Okigwe muri Imo State. Rutembera rugana mu bumanuko, ruca mu ntara za Imo na Abia, hanyuma rugashika mu gice c'inkengera z'inyanja muri Akwa Ibom State. Amaherezo rwinjira mu Imo River Estuary, amazi yarwo agasohokera mu Gulf of Guinea. == Akamaro k'uruzi == Uruzi rwa Imo rufasha cane mu: * Gutanga amazi yo kunywa no gukoresha mu ngo. * Kuhira imirima y'umuceri, imyumbati, ibitoke n'ibindi bihingwa. * Uburovyi, butunze imiryango myinshi. * Gutwara abantu n'ibintu mu bice bimwe vyegereye estuary. == Ibinyabuzima == Ku nkengera z'uruzi rwa Imo haboneka: * Amoko menshi y'amafi. * Inyoni zo mu mazi. * Ibiti vya mangrove n'ibindi bimera vyo mu bishanga. * Ibikoko bitandukanye bibaho mu mashamba yo ku nkengera z'uruzi. == Ibibazo ruhura na vyo == Uru ruzi ruhura n'ibibazo bikurikira: * Kwanduzwa n'imyanda yo mu ngo n'iy'inganda. * Isuri ku nkengera z'uruzi. * Gucibwa kw'amashyamba. * Kwononwa kw'ibidukikije kubera ibikorwa vya peteroli mu turere tumwe two hafi y'inkengera z'inyanja. == Akamaro mu bukungu == Uruzi rwa Imo rufasha mu: * Guteza imbere uburovyi. * Gushigikira ubuhinzi. * Gutanga amazi akoreshwa n'abaturage n'inganda. * Guteza imbere ubucuruzi bwo mu bice vyegereye estuary. == Umusozo == Uruzi rwa Imo ni rumwe mu migezi y'ingenzi yo mu bumanuko bwa Nigeria. Rufise uruhara runini mu bukungu, mu bidukikije no mu mibereho y'abaturage. Kubungabunga uru ruzi no kururinda kwanduzwa ni ngirakamaro kugira ngo rukomeze gutanga inyungu ku bisekuru bizokurikira.

Uruzi rwa Ouémé
== Uruzi rwa Ouémé == ni rwo ruzi rurerure kuruta ayandi yose muri . Rufise uruhara runini mu gutanga amazi, ubuhinzi, uburovyi n'ubwikorezi bwo mu mazi. Rutembera ruva mu buraruko bwa Benin rugana mu bumanuko, amaherezo rukinjira mu , hanyuma amazi yarwo agasohokera mu biciye ku muyoboro wa Cotonou. Izina: Uruzi rwa Ouémé Igihugu: Benin Uburebure: Hafi km 510 Isoko (source): Imisozi ya Atakora, mu buraruko bwa Benin Iherezo (mouth): Lake Nokoué → Atlantic Ocean Akarere runyuramwo: Atakora, Borgou, Donga, Collines, Zou, Ouémé na Atlantique Amashami akomeye: , , Sisitemu: Imigezi isohokera mu Nyanja Atlantika == Aho ruva n'aho rugana == Uruzi rwa Ouémé ruvira mu misozi ya Atakora iri mu buraruko bwa Benin. Rutembera rugana mu bumanuko, ruca mu bibaya binini vy'ubuhinzi n'uturere dutuwe n'abantu benshi. Mu rugendo rwarwo rwakira amashami menshi y'imigezi, hanyuma rukinjira muri Lake Nokoué. Amazi ava muri ico kiyaga asohokera mu Nyanja Atlantika biciye ku muyoboro wa Cotonou. == Akamaro k'uruzi == Uruzi rwa Ouémé rufise akamaro kanini mu: * Gutanga amazi yo kunywa no gukoresha mu ngo. * Kuhira imyaka nk'umuceri, ibigori, imyumbati n'imboga. * Uburovyi, butunze imiryango myinshi. * Ubwikorezi bwo mu mazi hagati y'imidugudu imwe imwe. * Guteza imbere ubukerarugendo. == Ibinyabuzima == Mu ruzi rwa Ouémé habamwo: * Amoko menshi y'amafi. * Inyoni zo mu bishanga. * Ingona n'ibindi bikoko vyo mu mazi. * Ibimera vyinshi vyo ku nkengera z'uruzi. Ibishanga n'ibiyaga bifitaniye isano na rwo ni ahantu h'ingenzi ku nyoni zimuka. == Ibibazo ruhura na vyo == Uruzi rwa Ouémé ruhura n'ibibazo bikurikira: * Imyuzure ikunze kuba mu gihe c'imvura nyinshi. * Kwanduzwa n'imyanda yo mu ngo n'iy'ubuhinzi. * Isuri ku nkengera zarwo. * Gucibwa kw'amashyamba. * Ihindagurika ry'ibihe. == Akamaro mu bukungu == Uruzi rwa Ouémé ni inkingi y'iterambere rya Benin kuko: * Rufasha ubuhinzi n'uburovyi. * Rutanga amazi ku bisagara n'imidugudu myinshi. * Rushigikira ubucuruzi bwo mu mazi. * Rufasha kubungabunga ibidukikije n'ibinyabuzima. == Umusozo == Uruzi rwa Ouémé ni rwo ruzi rurerure kandi rw'ingenzi muri Benin. Rufise uruhara runini mu bukungu, ubuhinzi, uburovyi no mu kubungabunga ibidukikije. Kubungabunga uru ruzi ni ngombwa kugira ngo rukomeze gutanga amazi n'iterambere ku banyagihugu ba Benin.

Uruzi rwa Great Scarcies
Uruzi rwa Great Scarcies ni uruzi runini rwo mu buraruko bw', hafi y'urubibe n'. Ruzwi kandi ku zina rya Kolenté mu gice kinini c'aho rutangurira muri Guinea. Ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye zisuka amazi mu Inyanja ya Atlantika, kandi rufise akamaro mu bwikorezi, uburovyi no mu mibereho y'abanyagihugu baba ku nkengera zarwo. == Inkomoko n'inzira == Uruzi rwa Great Scarcies rutangurira mu misozi yo hagati muri Guinea, rugaca rumanuka rwerekeza mu burengerazuba. Mu rugendo rwarwo rwinjira muri Sierra Leone, rugaca ruhinduka urubibe rw'ibice bimwe vy'ibihugu vyompi. Mu mpera, rwinjira mu nyanja ya Atlantika biciye mu gice c'ibishanga n'ibimera vya mangrove. == Ibiranga uruzi == * Izina: Great Scarcies (Kolenté) * Ibihugu rurimwo: na * Aho rusukira: * Ubwoko bw'uruzi: Uruzi mpuzamakungu * Ikoreshwa: Uburovyi, ubwikorezi bwo mu mazi, kuvomera no gufasha uburimyi. == Ubukungu n'akamaro == Abaturage baba ku nkengera z'uru ruzi barwifashisha mu burovyi, mu kuvomera imirima no mu ngendo z'amato mato. Mu gice cegereye aho rusukira, ibishanga vya mangrove bifasha gukingira inkengera z'inyanja no kuba indaro y'ibinyabuzima bitandukanye. == Ibidukikije == Great Scarcies rifise ibidukikije bikungahaye birimwo amafi menshi, inyoni zo mu bishanga n'ibimera vya mangrove. Ariko rirahanganye n'ingorane zirimo ugutemwa kw'amashamba, isuri n'ihindagurika ry'ibihe bishobora guhindura urugero rw'amazi. == Amateka == Mu gihe c'ubukoloni, uru ruzi rwakoreshwa cane mu gutwara abantu n'ibidandazwa hagati y'imbere mu gihugu n'inkengera z'inyanja. Akarere karwo kabaye kandi inzira y'ubudandaji hagati ya Guinea na Sierra Leone. == Incamake == Uruzi rwa Great Scarcies ni uruzi rw'akamaro kanini muri Sierra Leone na Guinea. Ruteza imbere uburovyi, uburimyi n'ubwikorezi, kandi rufise uruhara runini mu kubungabunga ibidukikije vyo ku nkengera z'Inyanja ya Atlantika. Kubungabunga uru ruzi ni ngirakamaro kugira rukomeze gufasha ubuzima n'iterambere ry'abarukikije.

Uruzi rwa Moa
Uruzi rwa Moa ni uruzi runini rwo muri no muri . Rukomoka mu misozi yo mu buseruko bwa Sierra Leone, rugaca rugira igice kinini c'urubibe hagati ya Sierra Leone na Liberia, hanyuma rukisuka mu hafi y'igisagara ca . === Incamake === * Izina: Uruzi rwa Moa * Ibihugu: Sierra Leone na Liberia * Isoko: Imisozi yo mu buseruko bwa Sierra Leone * Aho rusukira: Inyanja ya Atlantique * Uburebure: Hafi ya km 320 * Uruzi runini: Mu ruzi rwigenga rusukira ata kindi ruzi runini rwinjiyemwo. === Inzira y'uruzi === Uruzi rwa Moa rutangurira mu misozi iri mu buseruko bwa Sierra Leone, rugasiga ruca mu mashamba y'inzitane n'ibibaya vyuzuyemwo amazi. Mu rugendo rwarwo rugira igice kinini c'urubibe hagati ya Sierra Leone na Liberia. Imbere yo gushika ku nyanja, ruca mu bibaya vy'amangrove n'ibindi bibanza vy'ibinyabuzima vy'agaciro. === Akamaro === Uruzi rwa Moa rurafasha cane abaturage bo mu bice rurengamwo: * Gutanga amazi yo kunywa no gukoresha mu ngo. * Kuvomera indimo. * Uburovyi. * Gutwara abantu n'ibintu mu bwato mu bice bimwebimwe. * Gushigikira ibinyabuzima bitandukanye, harimwo amafi, inyoni n'ibikoko vyo mu mashamba. === Ibidukikije === Akarere ka Moa karangwa n'amashamba y'imvura yo muri Afurika y'Uburengero. Hari ubwoko bwinshi bw'ibimera n'ibikoko, ariko birageramiwe n'ikorwa ry'ugutema amashamba, uburimyi butagenzuwe n'ihindagurika ry'ibihe. === Inyandiko zifashishijwe === * Encyclopaedia Britannica – Moa River. * GeoNames – Moa River. * FAO – Raporo ku nzuzi zo muri Afurika y'Uburengero. * Hydrology and Water Resources of Africa.

Uruzi rwa Rokel
Uruzi rwa Rokel (ruzwi kandi nka Seli River mu gice co hasi) ni rumwe mu nzuzi nini zo muri . Rukomoka mu misozi yo mu buraruko bw'igihugu, rukanyura hagati mu gihugu, hanyuma rukisuka mu biciye mu kigobe kinini kiri hafi y'. === Incamake === Ikintu Ibisobanuro Izina Uruzi rwa Rokel (Seli River) Igihugu Sierra Leone Uburebure Hafi ya km 430 Isoko Imisozi yo mu buraruko bwa Sierra Leone Aho rusukira Inyanja ya Atlantique Ikoreshwa Amashanyarazi, uburovyi, uburimyi n'ubwikorezi === Inzira y'uruzi === Uruzi rwa Rokel rutangurira mu misozi yo mu buraruko bwa Sierra Leone, rugaca mu bibaya n'amashyamba yo hagati mu gihugu. Ruja rwegereza inkengera z'inyanja, rugahinduka ikigobe kinini kizwi nka Sierra Leone River estuary, aho amazi y'urwizi ahurira n'ay'inyanja ya Atlantique. === Akamaro mu bukungu === Rokel ni uruzi rw'akamaro kanini muri Sierra Leone: * Rutanga amazi yo kunywa no kuvomera indimo. * Rufasha uburovyi n'ubwikorezi bwo mu mazi. * Rukoreshwa mu gutanga amashanyarazi biciye ku rugomero rwa . * Rufasha mu bikorwa vy'uburimyi n'iterambere ry'abanyagihugu. === Ibidukikije === Mu bibaya vya Rokel haboneka amashyamba y'imvura, ibishanga n'ibiti vya mangrove. Aka karere kabamwo amafi menshi, inyoni zo mu mazi n'ibindi binyabuzima. Ariko rero, gutema amashamba, gucukura amabuye y'agaciro n'ihindagurika ry'ibihe birabangamira ibidukikije vy'uru ruzi. === Amateka === Uruzi rwa Rokel rwagize uruhara rukomeye mu mateka ya Sierra Leone kuva mu gihe c'ubudandaji bwo ku nkengera z'inyanja. Ikigobe c'uru ruzi cabaye kimwe mu bibanza vya mbere vyakiriye ubwato bw'abadandaza n'abashitsi bava i Buraya. === Inyandiko zifashishijwe === * * (FAO) * * Hydrology and Water Resources of Africa.

Uruzi rwa Milo
ni rumwe mu migezi ikomeye yo mu gihugu ca . Ruri mu migezi igaburira (tributary) , kandi rufise uruhara runini mu buhinzi, uburovyi n’iterambere ry’uturere rwo mu buseruko bwa Guinea.
